Abstract: Autonomous driving systems must not only interpret the current scene but also anticipate perceptual challenges such as occlusions, sparse observations, and recurring failure patterns. However, most existing LiDAR semantic segmentation methods operate in a frame-centric manner, processing each scan independently and discarding past contextual experience, which limits robustness under dynamic scene changes. We propose DREAM, a Dual-memory REAsoning framework for continual LiDAR seMantic segmentation that reframes perception as an experience-driven and anticipatory process. DREAM maintains two complementary memory banks in a strictly online setting: a latent memory that stores compact semantic abstractions of previously observed scenes, and an error memory that records representations associated with uncertain predictions. At each timestep, relevant memory entries are retrieved via cosine similarity and integrated into the feature space through a lightweight modulation mechanism, enabling the model to reinforce consistent semantic patterns while suppressing recurring failure modes. The backbone remains frozen and no past scans are replayed, ensuring computational efficiency and bounded memory growth. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale LiDAR benchmarks demonstrate that DREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with consistent improvements on dynamic and small-scale objects, highlighting the effectiveness of persistent and error-aware memory for robust long-horizon perception.

Abstract: AI-generated video of politicians can pass for real footage, and once such fakes are common, real footage can be dismissed as fake. Platforms address both problems with detectors, but whoever uploads a clip controls its pixels. Existing datasets of political video are small, show real politicians, and test no attacks. Each clip can be attacked, to hide a fake or to frame real footage. Published detectors trained on a general benchmark reach at most .781 AUC on CivicBench. Adversarial changes of 1 gray level per pixel hide nearly every generated clip from the detectors not built to resist attacks. An attack’s reach is how far it can move a clip’s score. A clip keeps its label when its margin from the threshold exceeds this reach, and we find that the reach grows almost linearly with the budget. On this basis, we propose Tau-Anchor, which fine-tunes an encoder pretrained on attacked images. It attacks real and generated clips during training and adds a margin term at its deployed threshold. It reaches .941 AUC on CivicBench. It also keeps .668 of generated clips flagged at 2 gray levels, against at most .289 for published detectors. When real clips are framed at the same 2 gray levels, Tau-Anchor’s false alarms rise only from 8% to 14%, whereas four published detectors flag nearly every framed real clip at just 1 gray level. Abstract: Perception systems often make discrete decisions: flag a hateful meme, predict whether a pedestrian will cross, detect a spoofed voice, or select the next move in a game. System-1 models, such as OneJev and Jev-Omni, read the media and return probabilities over the options in a single forward pass, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate text. Which multimodal decisions can System-1 models handle, and where do MLLMs perform better? We introduce S1Arena-MM, a benchmark that gives every model the same decision requests and scores the probabilities it returns. It contains 51,060 questions across 94 tasks with image, video, and audio input, drawn from 94 public datasets and three program-generated ones. It also includes 102 closed-loop game environments that a model plays from screenshots; in real-time mode, the game continues while the model decides. We evaluate 33 open models: 12 System-1 models and 21 MLLMs read at the answer token. On static decisions, the best System-1 model leads the best MLLM by 4.9 percentage points on images and is within one point of it on video and audio. Post-training for decisions mainly improves the probabilities: on video, a System-1 model has a lower Brier score than the MLLM that it is post-trained from in 10 of 12 pairs. With up to 2,048 thought tokens per question, the most accurate MLLMs pass the best System-1 models only slightly, and thinking raises the Brier score of most MLLMs. Closed loops separate the models: three System-1 models built on a 27B MLLM reach 22.0-33.3% progression in BALROG, and no other model exceeds 9.7% with thinking off. In real-time GameWorld, latencies of up to 1.1 s per decision cause no measurable loss of progress for System-1 models. Code and data: https://github.com/zhaoyang02/S1Arena-MM.

Abstract: Accurate chest X-ray radiology report generation (RRG) requires recognizing clinically relevant abnormalities and accurately describing them. Although Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves the clinical accuracy of generated reports, our analyses suggest limited improvements in visual representations for abnormality recognition. To address this limitation, we propose a selective regional visual distillation framework that enhances visual representations of challenging abnormalities while preserving existing visual capabilities. Specifically, we train a region-aware teacher with targeted supervision on challenging anatomical regions to acquire complementary visual knowledge. Rather than transferring all teacher features, we verify their utility through regional feature replacement and select only those that improve the original student’s performance. We further introduce a Spatially Gated Residual Adapter (SGRA) to distill these verified features while minimizing interference with the student’s existing visual representations. Abstract: Accurate glioma segmentation is vital for diagnosis and follow-up, but manual segmentation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable across interpreters. Gliomas are heterogeneous in size, shape, and location. Deep learning has therefore emerged as a potential solution. CNNs excel at local features but may struggle with long-range dependencies, whereas Vision Transformers capture global context efficiently but incur higher computational complexity. Most previous studies focused on pre-treatment gliomas; post-treatment cases with resection cavities (RCs) remain less explored. This study proposes a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN (CMC-Seg) model within a cascaded framework for pre- and post-treatment diffuse glioma segmentation, aiming to balance accuracy and computational cost. Experiments used BraTS 2025 mpMRI of diffuse glioma patients. After preprocessing, a coarse segmentation model extracted tumor-centered patches, which were fed to CMC-Seg for fine-grained segmentation. CMC-Seg was compared with 3D U-Net, SegResNet, SwinUNETR, UNETR, nnFormer, and SegMamba. On the test set, CMC-Seg achieved the highest mean Dice (81.20%) and non-enhancing tumor core (NETC) Dice (77.09%). It also achieved an RC Dice of 78.63% and the lowest 95% Hausdorff distance (HD95; 4.39 mm). Results were comparable to CNN and Mamba baselines and significantly better than Transformer-based baselines (P < 0.05). CMC-Seg required the fewest inference GFLOPs (381.49). Ablation experiments indicated that multi-direction scanning and cross-attention improved performance, particularly for RC (P < 0.05). Abstract: Real-time onboard robot control calls for a lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) model, yet shrinking the backbone leaves less capacity for deliberation at inference time. Chain-of-thought decoding, dual-system architectures, and larger backbones can restore deliberation but reintroduce the latency and memory costs that motivated going small. Recurrent action heads offer a lighter alternative by iterating in latent space before committing to an action, but existing designs refine a single undifferentiated state that must simultaneously encode slowly evolving task context and rapidly changing motor commands. We propose the Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH), which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies: a low-level state that updates fast, grounded in action tokens and proprioception, and a high-level state that updates slowly, grounded in visual understanding and the instruction-informed low-level state. The two states exchange information through nested reasoning cycles. Because all iteration occurs in the compact head after a single backbone pass, HR-AH adds hierarchical reasoning without increasing the backbone size. With a 22.5M-parameter head, 3-4.3x smaller than those of RD-VLA and VLA-Adapter on the same backbone, HR-AH reaches 97.0% success rate on LIBERO and a 4.40 average chain length on CALVIN ABC->D, at the lowest latency among compared methods. We show that this hierarchy improves performance over a parameter-matched single-state head, and that routing distinct modalities to each level yields further gains in both accuracy and inference cost.

Abstract: Recent geometric foundation models can successfully convert a video sequence into frames of registered point clouds, but cannot predict moments beyond the observed temporal resolution. We propose a continuous-time 4D reconstruction method that extracts 3D structure and camera poses at any time instant, with additional guidance from event-camera measurements. While event cameras provide evidence at microsecond resolution to continuously fill the temporal gap, integrating them into existing RGB-based foundation models remains challenging. We formulate the problem as interpolation in the latent feature space and augment event-based losses in the image space as an auxiliary task to boost accuracy. Operating in the latent space leverages the powerful geometric priors of foundation models, while the event loss provides physically grounded guidance. To effectively address the lack of paired training data, we further propose a self-supervised training framework that uses pseudo-ground-truth labels of estimated geometry and simulated events generated from high-frame-rate RGB videos. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed pipeline outperforms baselines that temporally interpolate either the input RGB videos or the estimated geometry, and that it generalizes to unseen real-world scenarios. Controlled experiments with synthetic corruptions show that it remains robust under motion-blur and low-light conditions.

Details

Motivation: 因果视频世界模型逐块自回归生成，早期小误差会作为历史反馈并累积放大，导致场景和机器人崩溃。教师强制训练使用干净真实历史，导致训练与推理历史分布不匹配，且模型易走捷径复制前一帧而非预测场景变化。

Abstract: Causal video world models generate block by block from their own previous outputs. Small errors in early blocks are fed back as history and grow until the scene and the robot fall apart. Teacher forcing trains on clean ground-truth history, so the model never sees the history it will actually condition on, and it also finds a shortcut: copying the previous frame instead of predicting how the scene changes. We present Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that keeps real video as the only supervision and reshapes how history is presented. History is perturbed in three ways: random noising, self-resampling by the model itself, and joint denoising, in which the most recent blocks are still partly noisy when the next block is predicted. On top of this we move history guidance and first-frame anchor guidance from inference into training, so that the model is pushed to use its history and its reference frame rather than ignore them. Dynamics Forcing needs no teacher model, no distillation, and no additional model at inference. Applied to a 5B video model with LoRA on 77 hours of manipulation video on a single GPU, it better matches unseen real continuations and reduces error accumulation.

Abstract: Wrist cameras provide an action-centric view that is directly relevant to robot manipulation. However, collecting human wrist-camera videos at scale is challenging due to cumbersome setups that can interfere with natural hand movements. In contrast, head-mounted human egocentric videos are much easier to scale. Trained on approximately 940 hours of paired head- and wrist-camera recordings, Ego2Wrist jointly generates three views. To evaluate generated wrist views without ground truth, we propose hand-centric cross-view consistency (HCC), which measures consistency between generated wrist views and corresponding hand regions in the input head view. HCC ranks model checkpoints comparably to ground-truth-based LPIPS, and human evaluators prefer HCC-selected generations in 77% of responses. Evaluated on four datasets, Ego2Wrist outperforms fine-tuned WorldWander, reducing LPIPS by 28% and receiving human preference in 76% of responses. More importantly, HCC facilitates recursive self-improvement on in-the-wild egocentric videos by selecting generated wrist views for further training. Generation quality progressively improves over three rounds. These results demonstrate a scalable approach to generating real-world wrist-view human manipulation videos for robot policy training.

Result: 在三个 VERIFIED 基准上，RELAY 无训练即在视频检索 R@1 上超过训练基线；VCMR 中在一个基准上与 VideoSearch-R1 相当，另两个基准在 IoU 0.5 上落后。其无标注预测区间偏短，使用少量标注查询校准一个 margin 后，可将区间扩展到基准标注习惯，并在 VCMR IoU 0.5 上超过训练基线。

Abstract: Video corpus moment retrieval (VCMR) requires finding the video and time interval that match a text query in a corpus of videos. We present RELAY, a training-free framework for VCMR that shares memory across queries. RELAY processes a batch of queries in three stages: search with a query bank, ranking with video notes, and localization with video prompt caching. In the search stage, an embedding model scores each video by its best-matching frame. The query bank penalizes videos that score highly for many other queries in the batch. In the ranking stage, a vision-language model (VLM) writes notes on each candidate video’s scenes, people, objects, and actions once. Then, a large language model (LLM) reranks the candidates from these notes. In the localization stage, a VLM predicts the time interval of the moment in the top-ranked video. When multiple queries select the same video, prompt caching lets the VLM reuse its frames. On the three VERIFIED benchmarks, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in video retrieval R@1 without training. Without any labeled moment, its predicted intervals are shorter than the annotated ones. In VCMR, it achieves similar performance to VideoSearch-R1 on one benchmark and trails it at IoU 0.5 on the other two. Human annotators also mark shorter moments than the original annotations of the benchmarks. A single margin, calibrated on a few labeled queries, widens the predicted interval to the annotation convention of the benchmarks. With it, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in VCMR at IoU 0.5.

Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation enables the recognition of arbitrary categories through natural language descriptions and has recently been extended from natural images to remote sensing. However, existing approaches primarily focus on three-channel optical imagery or limited-band multispectral data, while pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to directly exploit the rich spectral information of hyperspectral imagery (HSI) without additional adaptation. More importantly, different land-cover categories rely on distinct spectral cues, which may be weakened by uniform fusion. To address these challenges, we propose SpectralRoute, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary hyperspectral segmentation. Specifically, we construct complementary spectral views from HSI and enrich category descriptions with external spectral knowledge, enabling frozen vision-language models to extract diverse spectral-semantic responses. We then introduce a class-adaptive spectral routing mechanism that selectively amplifies discriminative spectral responses for each category, overcoming the limitations of uniform fusion. Furthermore, physical spectral priors are incorporated to refine predictions for visually similar land-cover categories. Experiments on three hyperspectral benchmarks demonstrate that SpectralRoute consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods without additional training.

Abstract: Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) within the medical domain remain a difficult and not well-understood problem, and it is still unclear where these models break down. Using this benchmark, we perform an in-depth experimental study of 10 widely used VLMs across five modalities and four question categories. Abstract: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. Abstract: Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to localize the temporal segment in a video that corresponds to a given textual description. However, a textual query often provides only a sparse semantic description of the target event, whereas the video contains rich and fine-grained visual variations. This mismatch creates an inherent gap between textual semantics and visual content, making a single textual input insufficient for precise cross-modal alignment. As a result, when multiple temporally adjacent or semantically similar segments exist, the model may struggle to distinguish the target moment from confusing candidates. To address this challenge, we propose a Multi-Perspective Auxiliary Representation (MPAR) framework, which aims to bridge this alignment gap by enriching a single textual input with complementary visual cues from multiple perspectives. Specifically, MPAR consists of three key components: (1) Auxiliary Representation Initialization (ARI) constructs multiple learnable representation slots from the original query, preserving the query intent while preparing flexible carriers for subsequent visual cue injection; (2) Visual-Induced Semantic Structuring (VISS) injects target-specific visual attributes into each representation while preserving semantic coherence with the original query; and (3) Multi-Perspective Semantic Aligner (MPSA) aligns each auxiliary representation with corresponding video regions to enhance discriminative localization. By constructing multi-perspective auxiliary representations and guiding the model to attend to relevant visual regions across these representations, our model achieves more accurate moment localization. Extensive experiments on MR benchmarks demonstrate that our MPAR outperforms state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of MPAR.

Abstract: Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to identify the temporal segment in an untrimmed video that corresponds to a natural language query. A Heuristic Localization Branch first generates candidate moments, while a Semantic Verification Branch evaluates their query consistency in a semantically enriched latent space. Query supervision further trains the verifier with the same candidate moment but different queries, encouraging it to distinguish the matched query from semantically similar mismatched queries. The resulting verification features are incorporated into a Progressive Refinement Loop that updates both query representations and multimodal features. To suppress potentially harmful updates, a lightweight reliability estimator gates query updates and reweights candidate contributions in feature feedback. A convergence-based adaptive stopping strategy additionally terminates unnecessary refinement during inference. Experiments on three standard MR benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and state-of-the-art performance of our method.

Abstract: Thermal-guided low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is promising for nighttime unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) perception because thermal imagery remains informative under severe visible degradation. However, the degraded visible image serves as both the alignment reference and the enhancement target, making thermal guidance uncertain in its spatial correspondence and local utility under low illumination, sensor differences, and UAV motion. To address these challenges, we propose a Reliability-Aware Multi-Strategy Guidance Network (RMGNet) for thermal-guided UAV LLIE under weak optical-thermal alignment. Its Reliability-Aware Guidance Calibration Module (RAGCM) performs coarse-to-fine displacement estimation and jointly evaluates the reliability of aligned thermal guidance and the usability of degraded visible evidence. Based on calibrated guidance, degradation, and reliability cues, the Multi-Strategy Enhancement Routing Module (MSERM) generates candidates for detail preservation, highlight-protected relighting, and thermal compensation, then spatially routes their contributions. We further construct the UAV weakly aligned Optical-Thermal dataset (UWOT), the largest UAV-oriented benchmark to date for weakly aligned optical-thermal low-light enhancement, containing 5,000 triplets. Extensive experiments show that RMGNet outperforms representative single-modal and multimodal state-of-the-art methods in enhancement quality while retaining competitive computational efficiency and greater robustness to practical cross-modal misalignment. The dataset and code will be publicly available at https://github.com/mmic-lcl/Datasets-and-benchmark-code.

Abstract: Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: AxEBench.github.io

Abstract: Effective real-time, full-duplex multimodal interaction requires systems to understand not only what users say, but also the communicative needs conveyed through prosody, facial expressions, gestures, and context, and to generate audiovisual responses that appropriately address those needs. To address this, we introduce Process-Oriented Scoring, which grounds the assessment of intent fulfillment in observable auditory and visual cues, such as prosody and gestures. Rather than relying solely on a single overall score, it evaluates how well a response addresses the communicative needs conveyed by each applicable primitive dimension. We aggregate the dimension-level scores according to each dimension’s relevance to the annotated evidence. Beyond intent fulfillment, Outcome-Oriented Scoring evaluates the naturalness, appropriateness, and human-likeness of the reply itself under audio-only, visual-only, and audiovisual conditions. To make these judgments traceable to observable evidence, we propose a Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV module, which uses structured, timestamped audiovisual observations of the user and the digital human’s reply to assess one dimension or criterion at a time. [226] Multimodal View Training: Learning More Through Different Modalities cs.CVPDF

Devang Kulshreshtha, Priyanka Kaswan, Minh Pham, Chinmay Hegde, Niv Cohen

TL;DR: 论文提出多模态视图训练（MVT），将同一文本信息转换为语音和渲染文本图像等多个视图，并训练多模态语言模型在各视图下输出相同目标。该方法无需新事实或额外监督，还可通过轻量连接器让纯文本LLM在训练时利用音视频编码器，而推理时仍保持纯文本架构。

Details

Motivation: 探索语言模型能否通过以不同形式重复接触同一信息而学到更多，目标是在不引入新数据和新监督的情况下提升模型对事实知识的学习与操作能力。

Result: 在问答、机器遗忘和知识编辑任务上，自适应MVT相对纯文本训练分别提升QA召回率15.2个百分点、遗忘质量40.7点、编辑泛化性25.2点；与标准数据增强结合还能进一步提升QA和编辑泛化性。

Insight: 创新点在于用同一事实的多视图一致性训练替代新数据监督，并通过轻量连接器把多模态训练收益迁移到纯文本LLM且不改变推理架构；理论上解释了跨模态训练可使权重更新更聚焦共享事实内容、减少对视图特定特征的依赖。

Abstract: Can a language model learn more from the same information simply by encountering it in different forms? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing Multimodal View Training (MVT), a simple training approach that presents identical information through text, speech, and images, without requiring new facts or supervision. Starting from a text sample, MVT generates corresponding audio and rendered-text image views, and trains a multimodal language model to produce the same target output across all three views. To further bring these benefits to text-only large language models (LLMs), we train lightweight connector modules to pretrained audio and vision encoders, allowing the LLM to learn from multimodal inputs while retaining its text-only architecture at inference. Across question answering, machine unlearning, and knowledge editing, adaptive MVT improves QA recall by +15.2 percentage points, forget quality by +40.7 points, and editing generality by +25.2 points over text-only training. Combining MVT with standard augmentation further improves QA and editing generality. Our theoretical analysis illustrates how training across modalities can shift weight updates toward shared factual content and reduce their reliance on features specific to each view.

[227] PathStream: Towards Streaming Diagnostic Copilots for Whole-Slide Pathology cs.CVPDF

Dankai Liao, YuFeng Wu, Ziyue Wang, Guanxi Liu, Tianyi Zhang

TL;DR: 论文提出病理学家主导的流式诊断范式，构建了基于5位病理学家在1,791张TCGA全切片图像上观看轨迹的PathStreamBench，并提出PathStream模型，通过两阶段训练和诊断注意力损失联合学习流式响应与最终诊断。

Details

Motivation: 现有病理AI多基于选定图像区域、固定视觉上下文或自主导航，未反映病理学家沿观看轨迹整合多区域多倍率形态学证据的诊断过程。

Result: PathStream在核心任务上优于14个视觉语言模型和3个领域微调基线，轨迹WSI相关性得分达77.87，超过最强领域微调基线的62.76；无需额外训练可泛化到教育病理视频、三个外部中心和未见器官。

Insight: 创新点在于形式化病理学家主导的流式诊断副驾驶任务，构建覆盖响应时机、形态描述和会话级诊断的基准，并用诊断注意力损失引导模型聚焦检查过程中累积的相关视觉与文本证据。

Abstract: Pathologists reach a diagnosis by integrating morphological evidence across regions and magnifications along viewing trajectories. Existing pathology AI rarely reflects this process: models predict from selected image regions, answer questions within fixed visual contexts, or navigate slides autonomously. We formalize pathologist-led streaming diagnosis, in which the pathologist controls navigation while a copilot selectively describes incoming views and synthesizes accumulated evidence into a final diagnosis. We record five pathologists’ viewing trajectories on 1,791 TCGA whole-slide images (WSIs) spanning ten organs, with response labels, morphological descriptions, and session-level findings and diagnoses. We construct PathStreamBench to assess response timing, morphological description, and session-level diagnosis, alongside auxiliary video understanding. We introduce PathStream, which jointly learns streaming responses and diagnosis through two-stage training, with a diagnosis-attention loss guiding attention during diagnosis to relevant visual and textual evidence accumulated as the examination unfolds. PathStream outperforms 14 vision-language models and three domain-fine-tuned baselines on the core tasks, achieving a trajectory WSI Relevance score of 77.87, surpassing the strongest domain-fine-tuned baseline’s 62.76. Without additional training, its diagnostic capabilities generalize to new educational pathology videos, three external centers, and an unseen organ.

[228] GUI-Q: Task-Sensitive Granularity and Relation-Preserving Quantization for GUI Agents cs.CVPDF

Tianqi Li, Yang Wang, Xin He, Le Zhang, Yun Liu

TL;DR: 论文提出面向GUI智能体的训练后量化框架GUI-Q，在W4A16设置下通过任务敏感粒度分配和关系保持的对称/非对称网格选择，缓解量化导致的GUI响应精度下降以及指令-视觉亲和、局部空间关系扭曲问题。该方法无需完整重训练，旨在降低GUI智能体部署内存并加速模型调用。

Details

Motivation: GUI智能体需部署在资源受限设备上，但其内存占用大且模型调用频繁，训练后量化虽可降低开销，却可能损害GUI目标选择所需的响应准确率、指令-视觉亲和和局部空间关系，微小坐标误差即可导致漏点并影响后续任务执行。

Result: 在三种具备GUI能力的模型上，GUI-Q相较最强评估的4-bit配置将平均grounding TargetHit提升8.04至12.55个点，同时相对BF16降低49.9%至56.2%的静态峰值GPU内存；固定输出回放结合packed 4-bit执行带来1.7至2.8倍模型调用加速。

Insight: 创新点在于从任务响应与关系保持角度设计GUI专用PTQ：TSGA结合响应敏感性和激活加权失真降低，在scale-byte预算下分配更细量化粒度；RPSS选择对称或非对称网格以保持指令-视觉亲和及局部空间关系，而非仅依赖局部重建误差。

Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable automated interactions with mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. However, their large memory footprint and repeated model calls hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ) without full retraining. Quantization can degrade GUI response accuracy and distort the instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations needed for GUI target selection. Small coordinate errors can cause missed clicks, while early action errors can alter subsequent interface states and disrupt task execution. Local reconstruction error alone does not directly assess whether these responses and relations are preserved. We propose GUI-Q, a PTQ framework that targets response and relation preservation with 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16). Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation (TSGA) allocates finer groups under a scale-byte budget by combining response sensitivity with the measured reduction in activation-weighted distortion. Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection (RPSS) then selects symmetric or asymmetric grids to preserve instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations in GUIs. Across three GUI-capable models, GUI-Q improves mean grounding TargetHit by 8.04 to 12.55 points over the strongest evaluated 4-bit configurations, while reducing static peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory by 49.9% to 56.2% relative to bfloat16 (BF16). Fixed-output replay with packed 4-bit execution provides 1.7 to 2.8 times model-call speedups. The code will be released.

[229] Audio-Visual Rearrangement cs.CV | cs.AI | cs.MM | cs.SDPDF

Ruohao Guo, Jiatong Ye, Chenwei Dong, Jinxing Zhou, Dantong Niu

TL;DR: 论文提出 Audio-Visual Rearrangement（AVR）新任务：智能体根据口头请求，找到合适物体并交付给请求者或指定目的地。为支持该任务，构建了覆盖显式目标、说话者相对空间指代和隐式用户意图三类查询、八个子类的数据集，并提出将运动感知空间音频模块集成到音视频大语言模型中的框架，通过多任务指令微调联合提升语音理解、空间音频感知、视觉定位和动作预测。

Details

Motivation: 现有具身智能与音视频理解研究较少覆盖“听懂语音请求—声学定位说话者—视觉检索物体—移动交付”的完整闭环。论文希望解决智能体在动态环境中联合理解语音指令、空间声源线索和视觉目标，并完成物体重排与交付的问题。

Result: 摘要未给出具体定量指标，实验在已见和未见环境中建立了基线性能，用于验证任务可行性并为后续研究提供比较基础。

Insight: 创新点主要在于提出 AVR 新任务及配套数据集，细化了显式、说话者相对空间指代和隐式意图等查询类型；方法上将运动感知空间音频模块融入音视频大语言模型，使其能随智能体移动更新空间线索，并结合多任务指令微调进行语音理解、空间音频感知和视觉定位的辅助监督。

Abstract: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.

[230] OmniSenMo: A Unified Multisensory Language Model for Generalizable Human Motion Estimation, Understanding, and Prediction cs.CVPDF

Cheng Guo, Qiming Cao, Pu Perry Wang, Pu Wang, Hongfei Xue

TL;DR: 论文提出OmniSenMo，一种统一的多传感器语言模型，用于人体运动估计、理解和预测。它以人体骨架为共同参考，将RGB、深度、LiDAR、毫米波和WiFi等传感器转换为关节令牌，实现任意传感器子集的融合，并通过多粒度观察适应不同任务。在MM-Fi和XRF55数据集上，模型在姿势估计和动作识别等任务上优于现有方法，即使缺少RGB也能取得更好结果。

Details

Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型主要依赖RGB相机进行人体运动分析，但在光照差、遮挡或隐私敏感场景下，深度、LiDAR、毫米波、WiFi等传感器可提供补充信息。然而，现有模型仅覆盖部分传感任务，且异构传感器令牌语义不一致、空间未对齐，配对数据稀缺，任务时间粒度不同，导致难以统一处理。

Result: 在MM-Fi跨动作划分上，OmniSenMo使用全部五种传感器，在姿势估计任务上MPJPE为84.1 mm，优于LEO-Fuse的89.0 mm；在未见动作识别上准确率69.2%，优于HoloLLM的42.8%。即使不使用RGB，也优于使用RGB的方法。在XRF55跨数据集验证中，未见动作识别性能远优于HoloLLM。

Insight: 论文创新点在于以人体骨架为共同参考，将各传感器统一表示为关节令牌，实现逐关节融合；利用模拟器生成五种传感器数据进行预训练；采用多粒度观察适应不同任务。客观分析，其统一表示和融合机制有效解决了异构传感器对齐问题，且模拟数据预训练策略有助于缓解真实配对数据稀缺问题，跨传感器和跨数据集泛化能力突出。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) estimate, understand, and predict human motion, but mainly from RGB cameras. Depth, LiDAR, mmWave, and WiFi complement RGB under poor lighting, through occlusions, and in privacy-sensitive applications, but existing multisensory models cover only some of these sensing tasks. Covering all of them from any sensor subset is challenging, since the tokens of heterogeneous sensors are semantically inconsistent and spatially misaligned, paired multisensory data are scarce, and the tasks need different temporal granularities. We present OmniSenMo, a multisensory language model that takes the human skeleton as a common reference for all sensors. Its skeleton-grounded motion representation turns each sensor into joint tokens, one per body joint, so that any sensor subset is fused joint by joint and expressed in the motion vocabulary that the language model learned from motion capture and text. We pretrain it on all five sensors generated by our multisensory simulator, and Multi-Granularity Observation gives each task the frames it needs. On a cross-action split of MM-Fi, the same model with all five sensors outperforms the models compared on each task, including LEO-Fuse in pose estimation (84.1 vs. 89.0 mm MPJPE) and HoloLLM in unseen-action recognition (69.2% vs. 42.8%). Even without RGB, it outperforms both methods that use RGB, and in a cross-dataset validation on XRF55, it recognizes unseen actions far better than HoloLLM.

[231] Visual-RFT++: Extending Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to Multimodal Tool Use cs.CVPDF

Ziyu Liu, Zeyi Sun, Xiaoyi Dong, Yuhang Cao, Haodong Duan

TL;DR: 论文提出Visual-RFT++，一个统一框架，将强化微调（RFT）扩展到视觉感知任务和多模态智能体工作流，使大型视觉语言模型能够对图像进行推理、操作图像，并利用可验证奖励评估自身输出。该框架在多种视觉感知任务和智能体任务上显著提升了开源LVLM的性能，并引入了多模态智能体工具基准MAT。

Details

Motivation: RFT在大型推理模型中已成为核心范式，但如何利用RFT将视觉感知、逐步推理和智能体工具使用统一到一个连贯的训练范式中仍是开放挑战。

Result: 在视觉感知任务上相比SFT取得大幅提升，包括one-shot细粒度分类+24.3个百分点、COCO 4-shot +21.0个百分点、LVIS +15.4个百分点；在MAT-Coding上提升+18.6 F1/+13.0 EM，MAT-Search上提升+10.3 F1/+8.7 EM；在多跳QA基准（2Wiki、HotpotQA）上提升29.3 F1和25.9 EM。

Insight: 创新点在于将RFT统一扩展到视觉感知和智能体工作流，利用可验证奖励驱动模型自我评估，并赋予LVLM网络搜索和代码图像操作等工具使用能力，同时构建了多模态智能体工具基准MAT。

Abstract: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) has recently become a central paradigm for advancing Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), as demonstrated by systems such as OpenAI’s o3 and the R1 series. Despite significant progress in LLMs, how to leverage RFT to unify visual perception, step-by-step reasoning, and agentic tool use into one coherent training paradigm remains an open challenge. In this work, we present Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning++ (Visual-RFT++), a unified framework that extends RFT to both visual perception tasks and multimodal agentic workflows, enabling LVLMs to reason with images, act upon images, and evaluate their own outputs using verifiable reward. With Visual-RFT++, open-source LVLMs not only show significant gains on diverse visual perception tasks, but also acquire agentic abilities such as web searching for real-time information and code-based image manipulation (e.g., cropping, rotation, and analysis). Across visual perception tasks, including fine-grained classification, few-shot detection, reasoning grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, Visual-RFT++ delivers strong gains over SFT, including a +24.3 percentage points improvement in one-shot fine-grained classification and +21.0 percentage points on COCO’s 4-shot setting and +15.4 percentage points on LVIS with around several hundred samples. To evaluate agentic behaviors, we introduce the Multimodal Agentic Tool Bench (MAT) with MAT-Search and MAT-Coding. Visual-RFT++ surpasses its baseline by +18.6 F1 / +13.0 EM percentage points on MAT-Coding and +10.3 F1 / +8.7 EM percentage points on MAT-Search. It also shows gains of 29.3 F1 and 25.9 EM percentage points on multi-hop QA benchmarks such as 2Wiki and HotpotQA, demonstrating strong cross-modal generalization. Visual-RFT++ introduces a data-efficient and reward-driven framework that strengthens both visual reasoning and agentic adaptability.

[232] ToWo-VTON: Take-Off Wear-On Virtual Try-On via Topology-aware Decoupling cs.CVPDF

Zhenchen Wan, Tianxi Chen, Runqi Lin, Tianyi Bo, Ce Chen

TL;DR: 论文提出 ToWo-VTON，一种基于“Take-Off/Wear-On”两阶段范式的虚拟试衣框架：先估计紧身人体代理以提供结构引导，再合成目标衣物，从而解耦人体结构估计与衣物合成。方法构建了 Body-Fitting DressCode 数据集，并在扩散模型和 MLLM 引导骨干上实例化，面向下半身和全身等复杂场景。

Details

Motivation: 现有虚拟试衣方法在上衣场景表现较好，但在下半身和全身场景中仍受复杂遮挡和大幅轮廓变化困扰。论文希望减少源衣物干扰，并支持大幅身形变化下的衣物放置。

Result: 在 VITON-HD 和 DressCode 上相较所评估基线取得提升，扩散模型和 MLLM 引导实现的 KID 分别降低 26.1% 和 58.6%，并在所评估服装类别中生成更连贯的肢体布局和衣物边界。

Insight: 核心创新是拓扑感知的解耦式两阶段范式，将人体结构先验与衣物合成分离，并通过 BFDC 数据集提供人体代理监督。其可借鉴点在于跨扩散与 MLLM 骨干的统一框架，以及用 Garment Boosting Attention 保留衣物细节。

Abstract: Virtual Try-On (VTON) aims to synthesize garment transfer without physical trials. Although recent methods perform well on upper-body garments, they still struggle in lower-body and full-body scenarios with complex occlusions and large silhouette changes. To address this limitation, we introduce ToWo (Take-Off Wear-On), a two-stage paradigm that decouples body structure estimation from garment synthesis. Take-Off first generates a tight-fitting body proxy that provides estimated structural guidance, and Wear-On then synthesizes the target garment conditioned on this prior. This decoupling reduces source-garment interference, supporting garment placement under substantial silhouette variations. Built on this paradigm, we propose ToWo-VTON, a unified topology-aware framework with structure-aware supervision. We construct the Body-Fitting DressCode (BFDC) dataset via body-aware diffusion and VLM-based filtering to provide body-proxy supervision across upper-, lower-, and full-body cases. We instantiate ToWo-VTON on both diffusion-based and MLLM-guided backbones. For diffusion-based models, we fine-tune on BFDC using the body proxy as the person input. For the MLLM-guided model, we use native backbone conditioning for the body proxy and target garment, and add Garment Boosting Attention (GBA) to preserve garment details. Experiments on VITON-HD and DressCode demonstrate improvements over the evaluated baselines, with KID reductions of 26.1% and 58.6% for diffusion-based and MLLM-guided implementations, respectively. The combined BFDC-training and Take-Off/Wear-On strategy also produces more coherent limb layouts and garment boundaries across the evaluated garment categories.

[233] PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Kanghui Tian, Shuai Dong, Yuhan Zhu, Congcong Wang, Ji Zhao

TL;DR: 论文提出 PixelOne，用于 GUI grounding 中低延迟、高精度的点击定位。它先把使用 VideoJEV 文本选项打分器逐步选择行列并放大候选区域的搜索教师模型的空间知识，蒸馏到直接从原生分辨率截图预测点击的学生模型；学生继承教师参数，并通过空间蒸馏与框监督匹配教师分布。推理时同一决策头选择视觉 token，轻量像素头在该 token 内预测点击，单次前向完成。

Details

Motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 模型虽能单次前向预测坐标，但截图下采样会丢失小控件细节，固定全局 bin 在高分辨率下覆盖的像素范围又过大，难以兼顾精度与延迟。论文希望在不做多步搜索的情况下，从原生分辨率截图直接实现精确点击。

Result: 在四个 benchmark 上，PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B 取得 83.8% 平均准确率，是被评估的单次前向 grounding 模型中最高，平均每个目标延迟 0.43 秒。

Insight: 创新点在于将教师模型“选行列并逐步放大”的搜索式空间定位能力，通过空间蒸馏压缩到学生模型的单次前向中；推理时结合视觉 token 选择与轻量像素头做 token 内点击预测，并用 click-aligned loss 鼓励目标框内像素得分高于框外。客观看，其核心价值是把多步搜索/缩放策略转化为单步、原生分辨率的像素级定位，兼顾精度和低延迟。

Abstract: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV’s text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher’s parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourages pixels inside the target box to score above those outside. Across four benchmarks, PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B achieves 83.8% mean accuracy, the highest among the evaluated single-forward grounders, with a mean latency of 0.43 s per target.

[234] TriSegAgent: Context-Efficient 3D Annotation with MLLMs via Tri-Planes cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Qingqiao Hu, Jialin Li, Meilong Xu, Kehan Qi, Yipeng Zhang

TL;DR: 论文提出 TriSegAgent，一种面向 3D 标注的 MLLM 智能体：它将 3D 体数据用三正交平面（tri-planes）表示，让仅接受 2D 输入的 MLLM 在迭代交互分割中判断预测误差，并通过视觉执行器把判断转成精确体素级 3D 点击和接受决策。作者还构建了覆盖 35 个公开医学数据集、3 种成像模态、690 个 ROI 的基准进行评测。

Details

Motivation: 交互式分割可将标注简化为检查预测并点击修正，但要让 MLLM 智能体在 3D 体数据上运行该循环，需要把 3D 预测压缩成 token 高效且能显示错误区域的 2D 观察，以降低多次调用成本并保持信息量。

Result: 在 690 个 ROI 的新基准上，使用前沿 MLLM 时 TriSegAgent 总体 Dice 比最强基线高约 10 点，且在小于 3 cm 的目标上优势更大；使用 Flash 级 MLLM 时也优于近期基于前沿 MLLM 的 3D 分割智能体。

Abstract: Interactive segmentation models turn a few clicks into a segmentation prediction across domains, so annotators only decide where the prediction still needs correction. Annotation thus becomes a loop of inspecting the prediction and clicking again. Each step of this loop is a visual judgment, which suits general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents. In this work, we focus on letting these agents run this loop on 3D volumes. However, the MLLM in such an agent takes only 2D images as input, so the agent must observe the 3D volume in 2D. Since the loop calls the MLLM many times, this observation must be token-compact enough to keep every call cheap, yet informative enough to show error regions in the 3D prediction. We meet both needs with tri-planes, the three orthogonal planes that cross at one point in the volume. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that tri-planes are context-efficient yet keep sufficient detail to show error regions in the 3D prediction. Building on tri-planes, we introduce TriSegAgent, an MLLM agent that refines the 3D prediction iteratively. Within the agent, the MLLM only judges the prediction on tri-planes, while a visual harness turns each judgment into a 3D action in code. To make the loop reliable, the harness places each click at an exact voxel in the volume and checks whether to accept the 3D prediction. To evaluate the agent, we build a diverse benchmark of 690 regions of interest (ROIs) from 35 public medical datasets across three imaging modalities. With frontier MLLMs, TriSegAgent reaches an overall Dice about 10 points above the strongest baseline, and its lead is even larger on targets below 3 cm. With flash-level MLLMs, it outperforms a recent 3D segmentation agent built on a frontier MLLM.

Gang Yang, Si Chen, Quan Zhou, Jiangchuan Li

Details

Motivation: 遥感图像场景复杂、目标尺度多样，现有语义分割方法难以充分利用对象和通道层面的上下文信息，从而限制分割精度。论文旨在通过聚合对象级与通道级上下文来提升遥感图像语义分割的判别能力。

Abstract: Semantic segmentation, which assigns a class label to each pixel, is a key task in computer vision. However, semantic segmentation of remote sensing images (RSIs) remains challenging because of complex scenes and objects at multiple scales, which limits segmentation accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose a context aggregation scheme called object and channel context aggregation (OCCA), consisting of three components: object contextual attention module (OCAM), channel contextual attention module (CCAM), and aggregation module (AM). Firstly, motivated by the observation that each pixel shares the class label of the object to which it belongs, object-level context represents each pixel through aggregating context from its corresponding object class. Secondly, because feature channels are correlated with object categories, channel-wise context models channel-wise contextual dependencies conditioned on object categories. Finally, the context information from OCAM and CCAM are fed into AM and used to weight and modulate the object context, enhancing the discriminative ability of the segmentation model. The experiments on several public remote sensing datasets including LoveDA, UAVid, ISPRS Potsdam, and Vaihingen datasets demonstrate competitive improvements over existing methods.

Motivation: 现有对抗物体攻击多针对单一模态、仅协调当前时刻的相机与 LiDAR，或主要在相机流中建模时序持续性，缺乏当前与历史观测的统一构造，导致检测器累积证据未被充分抑制，攻击效果受限。

Result: 在 nuScenes 上，AdvMTO 能有效抑制三个 BEV 检测器对交通锥的检测；时序消融实验表明，检测器原生历史建模对攻击构造和优化都很重要。摘要未给出具体定量数值或 SOTA 对比。

Insight: 创新点在于用统一的 2DGS 物体状态同时生成多模态观测，并通过检测器原生处理构造历史输入；对时序相机检测器将梯度传播到历史 BEV 记忆，对融合检测器结合有界外观扰动与沿局部法线的几何细化来扰动相机和 LiDAR 两种模态。

Abstract: Adversarial object attacks pose a threat to BEV-based 3D object detectors in autonomous driving. Existing attacks typically target a single modality, coordinate camera and LiDAR observations at the current timestamp, or model temporal persistence mainly in camera streams. Without a unified construction of current and historical observations, attacks can leave part of the detector’s accumulated evidence unsuppressed, limiting their effectiveness. In this paper, we propose AdvMTO, a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) framework for suppressing detection of persistent adversarial objects. Its oriented surfels encode appearance, geometry, and opacity in one object state, from which camera images and scanline LiDAR returns are generated. AdvMTO then constructs current and historical inputs through detector-native processing, regenerating LiDAR returns in each native source sweep for fusion detectors. We optimize bounded appearance perturbations for each detector, propagating gradients through historical BEV memory for temporal camera detectors. For fusion detectors, bounded geometry refinement along local normals further perturbs both sensing modalities. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate effective suppression of traffic-cone detection across three BEV detectors. Temporal ablations further highlight the importance of detector-native history modeling for both attack construction and optimization.

[237] Uncovering Separable and Composable Skill Mechanisms in Vision-Language Models cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Miaoyu Li, Boyang Li

TL;DR: 论文关注视觉语言模型内部视觉推理技能的定位机制，提出可分离性和可组合性两个技能定位准则，并构建多技能可解释性框架DISCO。该方法通过可分离头选择识别技能特定注意力头，并首次设计指标评估所识别注意力头的可分离性与可组合性。

Details

Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型技能定位方法在机制识别和评估中大多忽视技能机制的可分离性与可组合性，难以支持精准诊断、定向干预以及用少量机制解释更广泛能力。

Insight: 创新点在于将可分离性与可组合性明确作为技能定位的重要准则，提出基于跨技能贡献的可分离头选择方法，并首次设计量化所识别注意力头可分离性与可组合性的评估指标。

Abstract: Recent work has sought to localize the internal mechanisms underlying visual reasoning skills in vision-language models. These methods largely overlook separability and composability in both mechanism identification and evaluation. We propose separability and composability as two important desiderata for skill localization. Separability requires identified mechanisms to contribute primarily to their target skills while having limited effects on other skills, enabling precise diagnosis and targeted intervention. Composability requires skill mechanisms to be combinable to support complex tasks, allowing a small set of mechanisms to account for broader capabilities. In this work, we propose a multi-skill interpretability framework DISCO, built around these two properties. For identification, we propose Separable Head Selection, which selects skill-specific attention heads based on their contributions across skills. For evaluation, we are the first to design metrics for measuring separability and composability of identified heads. Extensive experiments on three VLMs and four fundamental visual reasoning skills demonstrate the effectiveness of DISCO. It achieves the highest separability, outperforming the strongest baseline by 24.80, 18.38, and 13.75 points across the three models, respectively, while also achieving the highest composability on all three models.

TL;DR: 论文提出PinGround，一种用于视觉语言模型并行定位的方法。传统顺序解码将框逐个写入，效率随实例数增长而下降；PinGround为每个查询写入一个空间锚点，并行解码距离该点最近的匹配实例，通过前缀树共享图像和查询，结合粗到细锚点、重复抑制和集合级强化学习，在不改变模型架构的情况下实现高效并行定位。

Details

Motivation: 视觉语言模型在密集场景中定位多个实例时，顺序解码的步数随实例数量线性增长，导致效率低下；而实例本质上是无序集合，顺序解码并非必要。

Insight: 创新点在于将查询锚定到单点以实现独立并行解码，利用前缀树共享图像和查询前缀，结合粗到细锚点细化、重复抑制和集合级强化学习优化F1；仅需修改提示和注意力掩码，具有通用性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can localize through their text interface, grounding open-vocabulary objects, complex referring expressions, text lines and layout regions with strong semantic understanding. They write the boxes one after another as a single sequence, although the instances of a query, unlike the words of a sentence, form an unordered set with no sequential dependence. The number of decoding steps therefore grows with the number of instances, which makes dense scenes the most expensive. Decoding the instances in parallel avoids this growth, but streams that cannot see each other duplicate some instances and miss others. We propose \method, which writes a single point into each query as a spatial anchor and asks for the matching instance nearest to that point within a local radius, or \none. Given the image, the anchored queries are independent, so they are decoded in parallel as leaves of a prefix tree that shares the image and the query, and the model is trained on the same tree. Coarse-to-fine anchors refine only the regions where instances are found, duplicate suppression keeps one box per instance, and set-level reinforcement learning optimizes the set F1. Only the prompt and the attention mask change, not the architecture. On three different VLMs and 12 benchmarks covering detection, OCR, layout and referring, \method is at most 5.5 F1 below sequential decoding trained on the same data, while its speedup grows with instance density and reaches 21.9$\times$ on dense scenes.

Yizhi Wang, Zixuan Li, Zhuwen Chen, Feiwei Qin

Details

Motivation: 现有多模态ReID方法通常在查询级估计模态可靠性，无法有效识别视觉质量正常但对应错误身份的冲突输入，可能导致高置信错误证据被融合并误导检索。论文旨在在身份冲突场景下实现更安全的多模态融合与重排序。

Result: 在RGBNT201和MSVR310两个数据集上，方法在保持干净输入检索竞争力的同时，提高了对身份冲突的鲁棒性，覆盖行人和车辆基准；摘要未给出具体数值或SOTA声明。

Insight: 创新点包括候选条件的证据仲裁机制，为每个模态-候选对估计信任与冲突并动态调整模态权重；候选集自注意力细化初始融合排序；以及面向不确定融合结果的查询级回退门控。客观上看，其核心创新在于将模态可靠性从查询级细化到候选级，并显式处理身份冲突与融合不确定性。

Abstract: Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID) exploits complementary identity cues from different sensing modalities to mitigate the performance degradation caused by challenging imaging conditions. Existing methods typically estimate Modality Reliability at the query level, making it difficult to identify conflicting inputs that retain normal visual quality but correspond to an incorrect identity. Such inputs may receive high confidence, promote irrelevant gallery candidates, and lead to negative fusion. To address this issue, we propose SafeRank-ReID, a candidate-conditioned safe re-ranking framework for Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID). To capture the varying support of the same modality for different candidates, we introduce a candidate-conditioned evidence arbitration mechanism that integrates unimodal retrieval evidence, input quality, and cross-modal consistency to estimate trust and conflict logits for each modality-candidate pair. Together, these logits contribute to the normalized modality weights, allowing support strength to vary across modalities and candidates while reducing the contribution of potentially unreliable evidence. A candidate-set refinement module subsequently applies self-attention to jointly model candidate representations and predicts residual scores from their competitive relations, thereby refining the initial fused ranking. For fusion results that remain uncertain after refinement, a query-level fallback gate estimates an interpolation coefficient from the overall conflict level and cross-modal uncertainty, adaptively combining the fused scores with those of the most reliable unimodal branch. Experiments on RGBNT201 and MSVR310 show that SafeRank-ReID maintains competitive clean-input retrieval while improving robustness to Identity Conflicts across person and vehicle benchmarks.

Bardia Safaei, Vishal M. Patel

TL;DR: 论文提出 VideoGCD，将广义类别发现（GCD）扩展到视频动作识别场景，利用仅来自已知类别的标注数据，对包含已知和未知类别的未标注视频进行分类。方法结合分区式专家混合模块、新类平衡损失和时序最优传输损失，以应对视频中的时序动态、类内差异大和帧间路由不一致问题。

Details

Motivation: 现有 GCD 方法主要在静态图像上有效，但直接用于视频时因时序动态、类内变化更大以及缺乏时序一致性而性能下降，因此需要面向视频的 GCD 框架。

Abstract: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to categorize unlabeled data from both known and unknown classes using labeled data from only the known classes. While recent GCD methods have shown promise on static images, their performance degrades in videos due to temporal dynamics, larger intra-class variation, and the lack of temporal consistency in existing approaches. We introduce VideoGCD, a framework tailored for video action recognition under the GCD setting. Our method integrates (i) a partitioned Mixture-of-Experts module that encourages specialization for known and novel categories, (ii) a novel-class balancing loss to reduce bias toward known classes, and (iii) a temporal optimal transport loss that promotes consistent routing across frames. Experiments on three video benchmarks demonstrate that VideoGCD significantly improves performance over existing GCD methods, particularly on novel categories. Our findings highlight the importance of combining temporal modeling and expert specialization for video GCD.

Motivation: 现有视频时序定位评测只看区间预测准确率，无法区分模型是真正找到事件，还是盲答、拟合单一标注风格或利用数据集偏差。论文希望度量并训练模型答案对事件帧的依赖程度。

Result: 监督微调和IoU奖励强化学习可使Qwen2.5-VL-7B准确率提升9到20点，但证据依赖并未高于基模型。作者提出的证据依赖训练目标在五个基模型上均提升该指标，与IoU奖励训练结合可保持准确率增益；遮挡事件帧会使训练模型更常拒答或漏检事件，遮挡等量其他帧则不会，并在第二数据集和patch scrambling下成立。

Insight: 创新点在于将“答案是否依赖事件帧”形式化为固定答案下的似然下降对比，并用区间内编辑与安慰剂编辑之差作为可训练信号，同时用安慰剂对照和下降上界避免模型学会对任意编辑反应。它提供了超越IoU准确率的因果式证据依赖评测与正则化思路。

Abstract: In video temporal grounding, a correct interval can come from finding the event, answering blind or fitting one annotation style, and Recall at IoU scores them alike. We measure evidence dependence, how much the answer rests on the event’s frames. Our fixed-answer audit edits either the frames inside the annotated interval or, as a placebo, as many frames elsewhere in the same video, and compares the two drops in the annotated answer’s likelihood. Supervised fine-tuning and three public checkpoints trained with IoU-reward reinforcement learning raise the accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 9 to 20 points, partly by answering blind and by fitting one annotation. Yet their answers rest on the event no more than the base model’s, and the same holds for IoU-reward training on our data at the audit’s frame rate. This comparison is a difference of the model’s own likelihoods, so we can train on it. A placebo contrast and a bound on the placebo drop rule out learning to react to any edit. With them, evidence dependence rises in all five base models we train, and the weight on clean supervision controls how much. Added to IoU-reward training, the objective raises evidence dependence while keeping the accuracy gain. Masking the event’s frames makes the trained models decline or miss the event more often than their base; masking as many other frames does not. The dependence moves to another event when the query names it, and holds on a second dataset and under patch scrambling, an edit never used in training.

Result: 在COCO上，TAED使DINO-R18提升2.5 AP、两阶段Deformable DETR-R18提升1.7 AP；在D-FINE和ECDdet等近期实时DETR上也有增益，且不增加额外推理开销。

Abstract: Distilling localization knowledge into compact detection transformers (DETRs) requires consistent teacher-student query correspondence across decoder layers. However, in DETRs with encoder-based query selection, the teacher and student select top-K proposals independently. Same-rank queries can originate from different spatial locations and correspond to different objects, making rank-based layer-wise supervision unreliable. To address this problem, we propose Trajectory-Aligned Encoder-Decoder Distillation (TAED), a framework for knowledge transfer between DETRs of different capacities. Encoder feature distillation matches normalized multi-scale features to strengthen student representations and increase the number of teacher-student query pairs from the same encoder locations. Source-indexed query alignment pairs native queries from the same encoder locations and retains pairs associated with the same object for which the teacher provides reliable and more accurate final localization than the student. Trajectory-aligned localization distillation maintains these correspondences and uses teacher proposals and corresponding decoder-layer box predictions to guide student refinement, without introducing additional queries. On COCO, TAED improves DINO-R18 and two-stage Deformable DETR-R18 by 2.5 and 1.7 AP, respectively. Further gains on D-FINE and ECDet demonstrate applicability to recent real-time DETRs at no additional inference cost.

[243] Draft Forcing: Target-guided Speculative Drafting and Learned Verifier for Autoregressive Video Generation cs.CVPDF

Chenkai Xu, Yuji Ren, Zihui Liu, Yijie Jin, Yuhao Shen

TL;DR: 论文提出 Draft Forcing，用于加速自回归视频扩散模型的流式逐块生成。该方法让轻量 draft 模型在目标模型多层 hidden states 引导下进行特征级起草，并用 on-policy 训练的特征空间 verifier 判断候选块是否可接受，从而减少调用大模型的开销。实验在 14B Self-Forcing 等模型上取得明显加速且质量损失较小。

Details

Motivation: 自回归视频扩散逐块生成时每块都调用大模型成本高；现有 chunk 级推测解码中 draft 易偏离目标轨迹并累积历史误差，且验证常被省略或依赖昂贵的解码后美学分数，缺乏与目标一致性的有效校验。

Result: 在 14B Self-Forcing 目标模型上，VBench 上实现 1.63× DiT 和 1.57× 端到端加速且质量损失很小；结合正交 KV 压缩可达 1.93× DiT（1.82× 端到端）。方法还可加速 MiniMax-H3 的流式变体，超过 50% 帧由 draft 生成并保持有竞争力质量。

Insight: 创新点在于用已提交块持久化的多层目标 hidden states 引导特征级 draft，并用多方面损失对齐目标轨迹；同时提出 on-policy 训练的特征空间 verifier，预测 CDF 校准的逐帧相对 RMSE，在无需 VAE 解码的情况下门控候选，提升推测解码的接受率与可靠性。

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming synthesis chunk by chunk, yet invoking the large model for every chunk remains costly. While chunk-level speculative decoding can offload chunks to a lightweight draft model, existing approaches suffer from two limitations: (1) an off-the-shelf draft diverges from the target’s trajectory, compounding errors in history; and (2) they either omit verification or rely on costly post-decode aesthetic scores rather than verifying consistency against the target. We address both with Draft Forcing, a framework coupling target-guided drafting with an on-policy trained verifier. Specifically, to align the draft for high acceptance, we opt for feature-level drafting, conditioning it on multi-layer target hidden states persisted from committed chunks, whose outputs are pushed to match target trajectories with multi-aspect losses. For verification, we propose an on-policy trained feature-space verifier predicting CDF-calibrated frame-wise relative RMSE against the target. It is trained on speculative rollouts as contexts anneal from random to inference-aligned mixtures, and gates proposals without VAE decoding. On the 14B Self-Forcing target, Draft Forcing achieves $1.63\times$ DiT and $1.57\times$ end-to-end speedups on VBench with minimal quality loss, and up to $1.93\times$ DiT ($1.82\times$ end-to-end) when combined with orthogonal KV compression. It generalizes to accelerate a streaming variant of MiniMax-H3, generating over $50%$ draft frames with competitive quality.

TL;DR: 论文面向无人机视频-文本检索，指出现有基准较少区分同一视频中不同查询所需的证据类型，构建了AirVT-15k数据集，包含15,504个无人机视频和155,040条双语描述，每个视频提供10条互补描述。同时提出AirFocus-CST网络，通过查询自适应选择相关帧和图像块、编码时序特征差异，并结合由粗到细交互与最优传输对齐实现检索。

Motivation: 无人机视频-文本检索既需要理解全局场景上下文，也需要捕捉局部物体状态和运动变化；现有基准虽提供多样航拍描述，但对同一视频内不同查询所依赖的差异化证据关注不足。

Insight: 创新点在于构建查询多样、双语且涵盖场景/物体状态/时序变化的无人机视频-文本基准，并提出查询自适应证据选择与时序差异编码机制，结合粗到细交互和最优传输对齐提升跨模态检索效果。

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle video-text retrieval (UAV-TVR) requires matching language to both scene context and subtle object changes. A harbor-layout query relies on global scene context, whereas a departing-vessel query requires local functional cues and motion states. Existing benchmarks provide diverse aerial descriptions but give limited attention to distinct evidence needs within the same video. We introduce AirVT-15k, a benchmark of 15,504 UAV videos and 155,040 captions, with ten complementary bilingual captions per video describing scenes, object states, and temporal changes. We also propose AirFocus-CST, which selects query-relevant frames and patches, encodes temporal feature differences, and combines coarse-to-fine interaction (CFI) with optimal-transport alignment (OTA). Average mean recall reaches 63.67% on AirVT-15k and 24.41% on CapERA, improving over the strongest baselines by 2.96 and 1.91 percentage points, respectively. The dataset and code are available at https://chenxi000233.github.io/AirVT-15k-site/.

Ziyang Zong, Canming Xia, Haoran Xu, Guang Tan

Details

Motivation: 现有3D室内场景合成方法依赖昂贵的手工标注数据集，成本高且泛化有限；同时，直接使用无标签视频训练会面临部分视角外推困难与原始视频质量不可控的问题。

Result: 在整理后的合成视频集上评估，该无标注方法在场景质量上优于最先进的监督方法。

Insight: 创新点在于用LLM作为空间常识评估器，通过思维链和可执行几何检查为强化学习提供奖励，并结合可控视频生成与基于熵加权的多标准筛选来构建高质量无标注训练数据；从客观角度看，将LLM奖励与数据整理结合以缓解无标注视频训练的噪声和外推误差，是该工作的可借鉴之处。

Abstract: 3D indoor scene synthesis requires generating objects to form a complete and coherent scene. Existing approaches rely heavily on manually annotated datasets, leading to high costs and limited generalization. We present SceneCast, an annotation-free framework that trains on large-scale, unlabeled videos, addressing two key challenges: (1) Videos provide only partial views of a scene, requiring the model to extrapolate unseen 3D regions, which is inherently error-prone; (2) Raw videos available online are uncurated, suffering from uncontrolled conditions and variable data quality. First, we design a Transformer-based model that predicts objects sequentially and is fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), where an LLM acts as a spatial common-sense evaluator. The LLM provides reward signals through chain-of-thought reasoning and code-executable geometric checks to refine object configurations. Second, we introduce \trim, a data curation approach that generates training videos with controllable video generation models. Crucially, it retains only high-quality prefix clips via multi-criteria quality assessment with an entropy-based weighting strategy. Evaluated on curated synthetic video sets, our annotation-free approach outperforms state-of-the-art supervised methods in scene quality.

Details

Motivation: 点监督时序动作定位只需为每段动作提供一个时间点标注，可降低视频标注成本；但现有方法依赖片段级动作响应生成伪标签，容易受到边界模糊、提案过长和时序结构弱的影响，从而限制定位质量。

Result: 在四个标准基准上验证了有效性：使用I3D特征时，THUMOS’14的AVG@0.1:0.7达到67.2%，GTEA达到58.1%，BEOID达到74.6%，ActivityNet-1.3的AVG@0.5:0.95达到31.7%，在多个基准上优于先前点监督方法。

Insight: 创新点在于用时序差分交互捕捉前后片段变化，并显式学习开始、核心、结束角色以建模动作内部时序结构；同时通过全点提案排序、Rolebank结构重排序以及检测器到STAR的软目标反馈闭环，提升伪标签的结构一致性和质量。

Abstract: Point supervised temporal action localization is becoming the need of time in this era of ever growing and non-stop video data. Existing method mainly rely on snippet level action response to generate pseudo labels. However, these labels often suffer from boundary ambiguity, over extended proposals, and weak temporal structure. To address these issues, we propose STAR, a structure-aware Temporal Action Recovery framework for point supervised temporal action localization. STAR works by enhancing the base S model with temporal difference interaction with attention module to capture forward and backward snippet changes, and introduces the learning of start, core, and end roles to model the internal temporal structure of actions. In addition, STAR further improves the pseudo label generation through All point proposal ranking and Rolebank based structural re-ranking, which suppress neighbor crossing and structurally inconsistent proposals. Finally, temporal action detector to STAR feedback supervision transfers high quality detector prediction back to the STAR model through soft start, core, end, action, and background targets. This helps to further refine the pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks shows the effectiveness of STAR. By using I3D features, STAR achieves 67.2% at AVG@0.1:0.7 on THUMOS’14, 58.1% on GTEA, 74.6% on BEOID, and 31.7% at AVG@0.5:0.95 on ActivityNet-1.3, outperforming previous point supervised methods across multiple benchmarks.

Francesco Manigrasso, Fabrizio Lamberti, Lia Morra

TL;DR: 论文提出模糊逻辑原型网络（FLPN），将零样本学习（ZSL）中的分类任务建模为视觉-语义嵌入空间中的原型匹配，并通过神经符号（NeSy）损失进行训练。FLPN利用逻辑张量网络（LTN）把类层次、属性例外和同类图像相似性等逻辑公理转化为可微操作，从而在训练中注入先验知识。方法还学习类级和属性级原型，其中属性级原型通过面向卷积或Transformer骨干的注意力机制获得。

Motivation: 现有ZSL研究较少探索如何在训练过程中利用神经符号技术注入先验知识来提升识别未见类的能力。论文旨在通过符号知识表示与深度网络学习的结合，缓解ZSL模型对已见类过拟合、泛化到未见类不足的问题。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点在于用LTN将类层次、高层归纳偏置和属性级例外等逻辑公理作为可微NeSy损失引入ZSL，并结合类级与属性级原型匹配及专用注意力机制。客观来看，其可借鉴之处是把符号先验以轻量、端到端可训练的方式融入原型网络，从而约束同类表示、防止过早过拟合已见类并增强跨类泛化。

Abstract: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) aims to train deep neural networks to recognize objects from unseen classes, starting from a semantic description of the concepts. Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) integration refers to a class of techniques that incorporate symbolic knowledge representation and reasoning with the learning capabilities of deep neural networks. However, to date, few studies have explored how to leverage NeSy techniques to inject prior knowledge during the training process to boost ZSL capabilities. Here, we present Fuzzy Logic Prototypical Network (FLPN) that formulates the classification task as prototype matching in a visual-semantic embedding space, which is trained by optimizing a NeSy loss. Specifically, FLPN exploits the Logic Tensor Network (LTN) framework to incorporate background knowledge in the form of logical axioms by grounding a first-order logic language as differentiable operations between real tensors. This prior knowledge includes class hierarchies (classes and macroclasses) along with robust high-level inductive biases. The latter allow, for instance, to handle exceptions in class-level attributes and to enforce similarity between images of the same class, preventing premature overfitting to seen classes and improving overall performance. % CHECK: original sentence had no verb (“Both class-level and attribute-level prototypes through an attention mechanism …”) FLPN learns both class-level and attribute-level prototypes, the latter through an attention mechanism specialized for either convolutional- or transformer-based backbones. FLPN achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GZSL benchmarks AWA2 and SUN, matching or exceeding the performance of competing algorithms with minimal computational overhead. The code is available at https://github.com/FrancescoManigrass/FLPN

[248] Mind the Gaps: State-Guided Supervision Allocation for Object Detection Dataset Distillation cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Jiehui Xie, Zhengxun Jin, Jiahao Zhang, Yuxuan Luan, Dongshen Han

Details

Motivation: 目标检测数据集蒸馏需要在有限图像预算下同时保留分类与定位信号。现有方法多强调单张图像的信息量，未显式考虑蒸馏数据集整体累计的监督，容易导致监督冗余和类别-尺度覆盖不均。

Result: 在 MS COCO 上，SGSA 在 0.25%-1.0% 三个图像预算下相比匹配的 OD3 基线提升 3.73-4.06 mAP；在 PASCAL VOC 上，相比最强评估基线在三个预算下提升 4.53-6.90 mAP50。

Insight: 核心创新是将检测数据集蒸馏转化为数据集级监督分配，并用类别-尺度配额和检测器预测累计状态显式引导图像选择与优化。其可借鉴之处在于利用“监督差距”驱动自适应对象采样、检测器引导的画布细化以及基于边际收益的候选选择，以促进跨图像监督互补。

Abstract: Recent advances in dataset distillation have enabled large-scale training datasets to be compressed into compact synthetic sets. However, dataset distillation for object detection remains challenging, as it requires preserving diverse classification and localization signals under limited image budgets. Existing approaches often emphasize individual-image informativeness without explicitly accounting for supervision accumulated across the distilled dataset, potentially leading to redundant supervision and uneven class-scale coverage. To address this limitation, we propose State-Guided Supervision Allocation (SGSA), a framework that formulates object detection dataset distillation as a dataset-level progressive supervision allocation problem. SGSA establishes class-scale supervision quotas and maintains a global state that tracks detector predictions accumulated from previously selected synthetic images. The remaining gaps between the target quotas and accumulated supervision guide adaptive object sampling, detector-guided canvas refinement, and marginal-gain-based candidate selection, encouraging complementary supervision across images. On MS COCO, SGSA outperforms a matched OD3 baseline by 3.73-4.06 mAP points across three image budgets (0.25%-1.0%). On PASCAL VOC, SGSA outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.53-6.90 mAP50 points across three image budgets. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of dataset-level supervision allocation guided by accumulated detector feedback under limited image budgets.

Jihwan Hong, Sunghwan Steve Cho, Ping Shu Ho, Joo Seong Kim, Bokyung Kim

Motivation: 结肠镜导航系统正从辅助引导走向自主控制，错误运动可能伤害患者，因此需要能遵循指定相机运动、保持结肠解剖一致并呈现病变与操作事件的世界模型用于开发评估；现有通用视频生成器在运动中会丢失结肠结构，内镜生成器又缺乏相机控制。

Abstract: Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon’s structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.

[250] Spatial-Zero: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models from Zero Data cs.CVPDF

Yutong Li, Haoyu Zhao, Daoguo Dong, Ziyi Ye, Yugang Jiang

TL;DR: 论文提出 Spatial-Zero，一个无需外部训练数据的视觉语言模型空间推理自进化训练框架。它通过 Proposer 生成对象配置与问题，Coder 将其转为可执行三维场景程序并渲染多视角图像，Geometric Oracle 校验空间约束、可见性与答案唯一性并从执行几何中导出真值标签，用于监督 Solver 并反馈指导后续任务生成。在六个空间推理基准和三个 VLM 骨干上，迭代自进化带来稳定提升。

Motivation: 空间推理要求模型理解度量距离、三维关系和视角相关几何，通常依赖人工整理的外部训练数据。论文希望让 VLM 在零数据条件下通过自主空间探索自进化，并解决自主探索中“生成有效空间交互任务”和“提供准确监督信号”两个关键挑战。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning requires a vision-language model~(VLM) to understand metric distances, three-dimensional relationships, and viewpoint-dependent geometry. Learning these capabilities typically requires externally curated training data. This paper introduces Spatial-Zero, a VLMs’ training framework that can self-evolve through autonomous spatial exploration with zero data. Spatial-Zero addresses two key challenges in autonomous spatial exploration: reliably generating valid spatial interaction tasks and providing accurate supervision for learning from these tasks. Specifically, a proposer specifies object configurations and questions, and a Coder turns them into executable scene programs that produce multi-view images and explicit scene geometry. A Geometric Oracle checks spatial constraints, visibility, and answer uniqueness and derives ground-truth labels from executed geometry; these labels supervise the Solver and ground difficulty feedback, while validation outcomes guide subsequent task generation. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks and three VLM backbones, Spatial-Zero yields consistent gains through iterative self-evolution. After three iterations, Qwen3.5-9B improves average accuracy by 3.23 percentage points; with Qwen3.5-4B, Spatial-Zero also outperforms existing VLM self-evolution methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/YutongLi2024/Spatial-Zero

[251] Decompose and Describe: Narrowing the Diagnosis-to-Report Gap in 3D CT Report Generation cs.CVPDF

Zhisong Wang, Wanxing Chang, Weiwei Cao, Fenghe Tang, Bowen Shi

Details

Motivation: 自动3D CT报告生成可辅助放射科工作流，但现有MedVLMs生成的报告常遗漏诊断发现。论文要探究模型的诊断能力是否能迁移到自由形式报告，并缩小诊断VQA与报告生成之间的任务相关性能差距。

Abstract: Automated 3D CT report generation could support radiology workflows, yet medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) often omit diagnostic findings from generated reports. Abstract: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. Abstract: Learned image captioning metrics are trained and tested on human judgments, so their reported correlation is a claim about generalization. Second, controlled retraining shows that duplicates can inflate a metric: for Pearl, the gain is confined to the duplicated samples and grows with every epoch; for DENEB, it stays below one point. The gain depends on the learner and on how often a training set repeats a sample. Third, Kendall’s $τ$ over all samples is the sum of two terms, detecting captions with the lowest human score and ranking the others; the first supplies most of the reported correlation and is nearly saturated. Abstract: Regional-scale crop mapping is critical for food production monitoring, yet remains challenging in tropical regions, where persistent cloud cover limits optical imagery. The approach combines two mechanisms. The first reduces the semantic inconsistency of the labels by shifting supervision from the sample level to the group level: a similarity-based clustering model organizes SAR time series into coherent groups, and noisy labels are used only to assign each group its most representative class. The resulting clusters are highly pure with respect to the reference classes (89.0% and 91.2% in the two study regions). The second reduces the spatial inconsistency of the predictions: a segmentation model delineates crop field boundaries from optical imagery, and patch-level predictions are consolidated by majority voting within each field, yielding spatially coherent maps. Evaluated in two Brazilian municipalities, Campo Verde (Mato Grosso) and Luís Eduardo Magalhães (Bahia), the approach consistently outperforms the noisy baseline in mean class accuracy, with gains of up to 10.14 percentage points, especially for minority crops. Abstract: Proactive streaming video understanding requires models to interpret unfolding events, respond timely, and retrieve relevant historical evidence. To systematically evaluate these capabilities, we introduce SVUBench, a comprehensive proactive streaming video benchmark comprising 12,131 questions and 62,881 answer points across ten proactive tasks spanning Perception, Understanding, and Reasoning. Constructed through model-assisted annotation and human verification, SVUBench introduces two complementary interaction modes. Basic evaluates sustained proactive responses from video onset, while Trajectory requires historical recovery and continuous response updates following task activation during streaming. A Duration-Scaled Challenge further evaluates these capabilities across four video duration tiers. We develop the Proactive Response Score (PRS) with task-adaptive answer windows to jointly assess answer correctness, response timeliness, historical consistency, and content quality. Extensive experiments and analysis reveal the strengths and limitations of existing models, highlighting directions for advancing proactive streaming video understanding.

It achieves up to a 3.7x decoding speedup over the fastest baseline on H.264/AVC videos. RAPID-Sel uses keyframes as coarse representatives of video segments, avoiding the dense candidate decoding and scoring required by existing frame selection methods. It achieves comparable accuracy with up to a 3.0x preprocessing speedup. Together, RAPID achieves a 4.9x time to first token (TTFT) speedup on hour-long videos over a state-of-the-art frame selection method using the fastest baseline decoder.

Abstract: We introduce JONES-19, a high-quality image dataset documenting 1,901 ornament designs belonging to nineteen human cultures. The images and their annotations are based on an open access archive of The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1856), by Owen Jones. The dataset poses numerous challenges as a benchmark for computer vision classification tasks and for research at the intersection of machine learning and art and design: a small sample size, image samples of human-designed artifacts rather than common objects in-context or natural scenes, imbalanced class distribution, and image distinctions based on fine details involving line patterns, reliefs, and colors. As a design-inspired dataset, JONES-19 can serve as a benchmark for various research fields, such as visual recognition, data-efficient learning, art-historical research, architectural style analysis, and cultural heritage. This paper describes the curation of the JONES-19 dataset and reports a baseline classification benchmark that evaluates the suitability of the dataset for training classifiers and exposes insights into inter-class relationships–particularly cultural similarities–by examining patterns in misclassification errors. Abstract: Decision models, which output probability distributions over candidate labels instead of generating text, are increasingly used as classifiers and evaluators for inputs associated with real-world locations. However, it remains unclear whether they can leverage spatial context and whether their predictions are geographically biased. GeoDecisions comprises two tasks: (1) geo-aware image classification, and (2) location rating on objective and subjective topics. We also find substantial geographic bias. On everyday photos, despite achieving higher accuracy, open-weight decision models exhibit more spatially clustered errors than supervised models. Moreover, across all five subjective topics, every decision model gives lower ratings to locations with lower socioeconomic conditions. Finally, we propose a training-free method that combines decision models with a location prior to improve their spatial awareness without substantially increasing performance bias.
