Abstract: Video polyp segmentation (VPS) is essential for computer-aided colonoscopy, as it localizes and tracks polyps frame by frame. However, VPS remains challenging because polyps resemble the mucosa and change quickly in scale, which calls for history beyond a short clip, and because blur, specular highlights, and occlusion often degrade only part of a frame. Existing methods keep history as whole frames, so their cost grows with the history length, and a partly degraded frame carries its degraded content to later predictions. To address these issues, we propose STREAM, a streaming framework for VPS that extends the causal multi-scale aggregation (CMA) of our conference work from a fixed clip to an online stream. STREAM introduces a Recursive Slot Memory (RSM) that summarizes multi-scale features and soft foreground and background cues into a constant number of slots, which the current features read and pass to CMA, supplying long-range history at a constant cost. Furthermore, we design Reliability-Aware Slot Writing (RASW), which estimates a pixel-level quality map from the current frame, supervised by its local error, and uses it to control which locations are written into RSM and how much each slot is updated. Experiments on SUN-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB demonstrate that STREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the Dice of the conference model from 81.3% to 85.7% on the hardest subset while running at 48 FPS with a constant state of 0.32 MB. Motivation: WSI 因扫描设备、染色方案和组织制备差异存在显著跨医院域偏移，导致模型跨源应用性能下降；现有自然图像 UDA 方法在计算病理中研究不足，且 WSI 超高分辨率和切片间/切片内异质性易造成不稳定和负迁移。

Abstract: Pathological whole slide images (WSIs) exhibit substantial domain shifts across hospitals due to variations in scanning devices, staining protocols, and tissue preparation procedures, leading to significant performance degradation when models are applied to data from different sources. Although unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has shown strong performance in transferring models from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain in natural images, it remains relatively underexplored in computational pathology. The ultra-high resolution of WSIs and their pronounced inter-slide and intra-slide heterogeneity pose unique challenges for domain adaptation, often rendering existing UDA methods unstable and susceptible to negative transfer. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-level Adversarial learning with domain-aware REgularization (DARE), a plug-and-play UDA framework for WSI classification. DARE incorporates adaptive pseudo-labeling within a teacher-student architecture to provide stable supervision for the target domain, alongside adversarial alignment of both patch-level and slide-level embeddings. Together, these components enable the joint optimization of semantic representations at both levels for cross-domain alignment. We further introduce domain-aware attention masking to regularize attention and improve cross-domain generalization. Extensive experiments on four public WSI datasets demonstrate that DARE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across various domain shifts.

Abstract: Diabetes leads to several health complications throughout the body, with the complication in the eyes being Diabetic Retinopathy. It leads to damaging or abnormal changes in the blood vessels’ structure, causing vision loss. The need for massive screening of a large population of diabetic patients has created a necessity for computer-aided, fully automatic diagnosis of DR. CNNs have shown great promise in the classification of DR based on the Fundus images. This paper aims to demonstrate the UNET, and its Stacked Architecture variant and their performance across several datasets. This paper has compared and studied the UNET architecture’s performance across multiple stacks and has come to a soft conclusion that the architecture performs its best at three stacks, and any more leads to deterioration of its performance. Motivation: 现有方法依赖视频扩散模型的表观深度回归，虽能恢复遮挡手部，但对未见相机泛化差，难以获得准确的度量 3D 手部运动。论文希望用几何一致性约束替代不稳定的直接深度回归。

Abstract: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The code is available at https://github.com/NTUYWANG103/ViDiHand.

Abstract: The Divan hay vimagrut’yan (1960-2017), the printed corpus of Armenian inscriptions, comprises nearly 7,600 records; a growing number of the inscriptions they describe, damaged or destroyed in recent decades, survive only in its pages. This paper presents the Corpus Inscriptionum Armenicarum Electronicum, which turns the ten volumes of the Divan into an open digital corpus. Layout detection, OCR and a vision-language model produce a first structured reading of each record, which specialists then check on a proofreading platform. First corrections show that letters are read reliably and that residual errors concentrate in the editorial signs. The corpus is designed as a lasting platform for documenting Armenian inscriptions and as a source of silver data in Classical and Middle Armenian for language models and computational linguistics.

Abstract: Generating realistic 3D human object interactions (HOI) is essential for applications, such as augmented or virtual reality (AR/VR) or character animation of interactive entertainment. A particular challenge lies in the faithful generation of hand grasps in human object interaction scenes, where even minor geometric inconsistencies, such as insufficient contact or interpenetration, can significantly compromise realism. While diffusion-based generative models have shown promising results in HOI synthesis, ensuring physically plausible hand-object interactions remains challenging. Rather than modifying or retraining the generative model, our approach iteratively optimizes the initial noise of the diffusion generator, thereby generating firm hand object contact, while mitigating penetration and keeping the hand position realistic. Experiments on the GRAB dataset demonstrate improvements over the baseline in grasp quality without additional model training or increased computational cost compared to existing methods. We further demonstrate the applicability of our approach to practical media production scenarios.

Motivation: 现有开放视频生成器单次仅能生成数秒短片；若想合成更长序列，要么依赖按预设脚本执行的智能体系统，要么基于上一片段末帧自回归滚动，这会丢失画面外状态，并导致跨轮次幻觉累积，用户无法设定明确目标、自主选择实现路径并让选择的后果在后续片段中保持。

Abstract: Open video generators such as MiniMax-H3 produce short clips of only several to a dozen seconds per run. To synthesize longer sequences, existing methods either rely on agentic systems following preset scripts, or roll out autoregressively from the previous clip’s last frame, losing off-screen states and accumulating hallucinations across turns. Consequently, users still cannot take an explicit goal, choose how to accomplish it, and see that choice persist across subsequent clips. To this end, we propose CineAct, a state-first agentic framework in which language-model agents handle reasoning while frozen image and video generators serve purely as renderers. Before interaction, the Architect initializes the world as a spatial layout with cameras, an asset library, and a scene graph; at each turn, the system deduces the planned state change, generates a target end frame with an image generator and rigorously verifies it, and synthesizes intermediate motion with an FL2V model. We further introduce a multi-space benchmark covering two suites: long-horizon step execution and open-intent branching admissibility. Experiments show that explicit world-state modeling boosts multi-step rollout consistency over the pixel-only baseline (+11.4 automated, +23.1 human points) and raises paired branching success toward a shared goal by +30.8 points.

Abstract: Geometry Problem Solving (GPS) serves as a rigorous test of the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), particularly when solutions require auxiliary constructions absent from the input diagram. However, explicit diagramming methods suffer from unstable image generation quality and cascading errors, while existing implicit attention mechanisms primarily focus on visible elements, limiting their ability to support reasoning that requires additional geometric constructions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{AuxCA} (Auxiliary-Clues-Aware GRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that helps models learn transferable auxiliary-construction strategies that can be applied beyond the training domain without explicit diagram generation at inference time. Specifically, we introduce Auxiliary Clues Dependency (\textbf{ACD}) to quantify the influence of auxiliary visual clues on token generation and integrate it into GRPO through fine-grained advantage weighting. Furthermore, we incorporate an auxiliary incentive reward to encourage the effective use of auxiliary geometric clues in correct solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AuxCA-8B outperforms the explicit-plotting baseline Bagel-Canvas and achieves competitive performance with leading proprietary models on auxiliary-dependent plane geometry problems. Abstract: Event cameras respond only to brightness changes, so whether an edge is visible depends on image motion perpendicular to it—a motion that constantly shifts with camera and scene dynamics. Result: 在4个大模型上，DtR比参考采样器快11-25倍；在每个加速比下都更接近参考结果，且ImageReward评分高于所有对比采样器，包括按预算校准的少步调度和已发表的多分辨率采样器。在FLUX.1-dev上，DtR在约8倍加速内仍是最忠实的采样器，优于缓存加速器；用户研究中86%的成对比较认为DtR样本更接近参考，并迁移到留出模型和视频任务，蒸馏模型也可作为其渲染器。

Insight: 创新点在于将少步采样的早期粗决策与后续细节渲染解耦：利用低分辨率下相同的粗噪声做出近似相同的构图决策，再以种子自身噪声重建全分辨率状态。该方法无需训练，揭示了早期低分辨率决策对种子保真度的关键作用，并提供了一种通用、可迁移的加速框架。

Abstract: Few-step samplers make large text-to-image flow models fast, but from the same noise they no longer generate the image of the standard 50-step sampler. Subjects, attributes and layout change, not just fine detail. We trace this loss of seed fidelity to the start of sampling. The coarse part of the initial noise decides coarse structure first, while the noise level is still above 0.9. Few-step samplers cross this range in their first steps, which account for 25-52% of their distance to the 50-step reference. Because this decision is coarse, a half-resolution run from the same coarse noise can make nearly the same decision at a third of the cost. We therefore propose Decide-then-Render (DtR), a training-free sampler that decides the composition in a few low-resolution steps, rebuilds the full-resolution state with the seed’s own noise and renders the details. On 4 large models, DtR runs 11-25$\times$ faster than the reference sampler. At each speed-up, it is closer to the reference and rated higher by ImageReward than every compared sampler, including few-step schedules calibrated per budget and published multi-resolution samplers. On FLUX.1-dev, it remains the most faithful sampler down to about $8\times$, ahead of caching accelerators. A user study on this model found DtR’s samples closer to the reference in 86% of pairwise trials. DtR transfers to a held-out model and to video, and distilled models can serve as its renderers. Project link: https://duanhuiran.github.io/DtR

[277] EgoDepth-Bench: Benchmarking Metric Depth for Egocentric Manipulation cs.CV | cs.ROPDF

Yuan Gao, Dongchen Wei, Xinyang Lin, Shuhua Cao, Xueliang Guo

TL;DR: 论文提出 EgoDepth-Bench，一个面向第一人称操作场景的度量深度估计基准，包含 37 个物理环境中的 941,233 个同步样本，每个样本提供六路标定 RGB 视图和鱼眼视图下的度量深度。该基准支持单目、双目和多视图模型的深度精度与预测覆盖率评估，并采用留出环境划分测试泛化能力。实验表明在该基准上微调 MapAnything 可显著降低未见环境上的深度误差。

Details

Motivation: 第一人称操作场景缺乏同时具备度量深度、多视图同步、环境泛化评估以及手部/物体区域覆盖分析的基准，论文旨在为该场景的度量与相对深度估计提供有效监督和严格评测。

Result: 基准包含 941,233 个同步样本、覆盖 37 个环境，标定球杆验证中位误差为 1.27 mm；在未见环境上微调 MapAnything 后，Metric AbsRel 从 0.708 降至 0.091，Scale-aligned AbsRel 从 0.327 降至 0.072。

Insight: 创新点在于构建大规模同步多视图 RGB 与鱼眼度量深度基准，利用主动红外立体模块重建高精度深度，并提供留出环境划分及包含手部和物体的覆盖率评估，从而兼顾度量精度与泛化性评测。

Abstract: We introduce EgoDepth-Bench, comprising 941,233 synchronized samples collected across 37 distinct physical environments. Each sample combines six calibrated RGB views with metric depth in the native fisheye view, reconstructed from five active-infrared stereo modules. A calibrated ball-bar confirms millimeter-level geometric accuracy, with a median error of 1.27 mm on a known sphere spacing. Environment-held-out splits enable evaluation of generalization to unseen environments. Across monocular, stereo, and multi-view models, the benchmark measures both depth accuracy and prediction coverage, including on hands and objects. Fine-tuning MapAnything on EgoDepth-Bench reduces metric AbsRel from 0.708 to 0.091 and scale-aligned AbsRel from 0.327 to 0.072 on unseen environments. These results demonstrate that EgoDepth-Bench provides effective supervision and enables rigorous evaluation of metric and relative depth estimation in egocentric manipulation. The project page provides the evaluation code and interactive RGB-depth sequences.

[278] AvatarAnyone: Agentic Reconstruction of Mesh-Based Layered Avatars from YouTube Video cs.CVPDF

Aymen Mir, Peter Wonka, Stefanos Zafeiriou, Rıza Alp Güler

TL;DR: AvatarAnyone 提出一种从日常 YouTube 视频重建分层网格化身的方法，将每件服装和鞋类重建为叠加在身体网格上的独立网格层。针对不同人的服装类别、类型和层数组合差异大、固定重建流程难以适用的问题，论文使用 AI agents 为每个人规划定制化优化流程。重建出的分层网格化身支持虚拟试穿、布料模拟，并可导入 Blender、Unreal Engine 和 MuJoCo 等平台。

Details

Motivation: 现有化身多为单一融合表面或高斯表示，难以支持换装、布料模拟和接触建模；而日常视频中服装类别、类型和层数高度多样，单一固定的分层重建流程无法适应所有组合。

Result: 论文在约 150 个 YouTube 视频上展示结果，并在四个数据集上优于现有基于网格的可动画单目重建方法；重建化身可支持更换服装层、渲染不同姿态、布料模拟以及导入 Blender、Unreal Engine 和 MuJoCo 等应用。

Insight: 创新点在于用 AI agents 预测服装类别、服装类型和分层结构，并据此选择初始化与分阶段优化，从而为每个人自动规划定制化分层网格重建流程；客观来看，将分层网格表示与 agent 规划结合，提升了复杂服装组合下的重建适应性，并增强了化身在试穿、仿真和接触建模中的可用性。

Abstract: We introduce AvatarAnyone, a method for reconstructing avatars from casual YouTube videos as layered meshes, with each garment and footwear as a separate mesh layered on top of the body mesh. In such videos, people differ in garment classes, clothing types, and layers, and each combination needs a different reconstruction. A single fixed layered reconstruction pipeline therefore fails. AvatarAnyone solves this problem with AI agents that plan a custom optimization for each person’s reconstruction. The agents predict the garment classes, the clothing type, and the layering. They use these predictions to choose an initialization and stage the optimization. Because the avatars are layered meshes, they support applications such as virtual try-on and cloth simulation. We change the clothing layers of an avatar and render it in different garments and poses. We can also simulate a clothing layer as cloth over the animated body with a standard cloth simulator. Most existing avatars are one fused surface or a set of Gaussians and cannot do this. We load the avatars directly into Blender, Unreal Engine, and robotics simulators such as MuJoCo. As the avatars are meshes, they support contact modeling with other objects. We show results from around 150 YouTube videos. On four datasets, AvatarAnyone outperforms existing mesh-based methods for animatable monocular reconstruction. Our project page is available at https://miraymen.github.io/avataranyone.

[279] BridgeMVS: Bridging Multi-View Stereo and Monodepth via Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion cs.CVPDF

Jianfei Jiang, Haochen Yu, Qiankun Liu, Rui Yang, Hongyuan Liu

TL;DR: 论文提出 BridgeMVS，一个统一的级联多阶段多视图立体（MVS）框架，通过双向动态融合（BDF）连接单目深度特征与多视图代价体表示。BDF 在每个阶段进行单目到代价体和代价体到单目的动态更新，实现 MVS 与单目深度估计（MDE）的相互增强，并可即插即用地集成到现有级联 MVS 框架中。

Details

Motivation: 现有 MVS 在特征匹配不可靠区域表现不佳，而 MDE 虽能提供稳健结构先验但存在尺度模糊；已有混合方法多仅单向利用单目线索，未充分挖掘 MDE 与 MVS 的双向互增强潜力。

Result: 在 DTU、Tanks-and-Temples 和 ETH3D 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，同时在 Tanks-and-Temples Intermediate 与 Advanced 榜单排名第一，并提升了单目深度估计精度。

Insight: 创新点在于提出双向动态融合 BDF，使单目结构特征引导代价体细化、多视图几何证据校准单目表示；并通过由粗到细传播融合表示及阶段式相对尺度 MDE 监督和度量尺度 MVS 监督实现跨分支交互，且 BDF 设计为可插拔模块。

Abstract: Multi-View Stereo (MVS) and Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) provide complementary cues for dense 3D reconstruction. While MVS leverages explicit geometry for metric depth, it struggles in challenging regions where feature matching is unreliable. Conversely, MDE provides robust structural priors but typically yields scale-ambiguous results. Existing hybrid methods mainly exploit monocular cues in a unidirectional manner, leaving the mutual enhancement between MDE and MVS insufficiently explored. To address this limitation, we propose BridgeMVS, a unified cascaded multi-stage MVS framework that bridges monocular depth features and multi-view cost volume representations through Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion (BDF). At each stage, BDF performs dynamic mono-to-cost and cost-to-mono updates, where monocular structural features guide cost volume refinement for more robust MVS depth estimation, while multi-view geometric evidence recalibrates monocular representations to improve their metric-scale consistency. Furthermore, the fused monocular and multi-view representations are progressively propagated from coarse to fine stages and constrained by stage-wise relative-scale MDE supervision and metric-scale MVS supervision, enabling cross-branch interactions to benefit subsequent high-resolution depth estimation. In addition, BDF is designed as a plug-and-play module that can be conveniently integrated into existing cascaded MVS frameworks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BridgeMVS achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DTU, Tanks-and-Temples, and ETH3D benchmarks, while simultaneously boosting the accuracy of monocular depth estimation. Notably, BridgeMVS ranks first on both the Tanks-and-Temples Intermediate and Advanced benchmarks. The source code is available at \href{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}.

[280] PestWeave: Linking Semantic Modeling and Evidence-Guided Text Modulation through Visual Prototypes for Fine-Grained Pest Learning cs.CVPDF

Xueheng Li, Yu Wang, Yuxiang Shen, Wen Xue, Rui Li

TL;DR: 论文提出 PestWeave，一个面向细粒度害虫识别的多模态框架，通过视觉原型连接内容自适应的视觉组织与证据引导的文本调制。其视觉通路在 RWKV 架构中引入语义 token 分组和聚类原型、全局、寄存器三类辅助 token，以增强复杂背景下的判别性建模；这些原型进一步评估文本语义是否得到图像支持，从而调节文本贡献与融合强度。

Details

Motivation: 农业害虫外观多样，复杂背景会遮蔽判别性视觉线索，而文本描述可能包含当前图像不支持的信息，导致跨模态融合受干扰；因此需要提升害虫细粒度识别中的视觉组织与可靠文本融合能力。

Result: 摘要在多个害虫识别数据集上进行了实验，验证了 PestWeave 的有效性及其在实际害虫管理中的潜力；但未给出具体定量指标或明确 SOTA 结论。

Insight: 创新点在于用视觉原型同时服务于内容自适应视觉扫描和文本证据校验：语义分组与辅助 token 保留空间结构并提供组级/全局上下文，原型则用于判断文本语义的视觉支持程度并调节融合强度，从而减少无支持描述的干扰。

Abstract: Agricultural pests threaten crop yield and quality, making accurate pest recognition essential for targeted management and sustainable agriculture. Their diverse appearances complicate recognition and motivate multimodal approaches incorporating complementary species knowledge from text. However, complex backgrounds can obscure discriminative visual cues, while textual descriptions may contain information unsupported by the current image, limiting effective cross-modal fusion. To address these challenges, we propose PestWeave, a multimodal framework connecting content-adaptive visual organization with text fusion through visual prototypes. Its visual pathway augments a Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) architecture with semantic token grouping and three types of auxiliary tokens, enabling content-adaptive scanning and contextual modeling while preserving spatial structure. Feature-similar tokens are reordered into adjacent scanning positions, while cluster prototype, global, and register tokens provide group-level summaries, global context, and additional interaction capacity, respectively. These prototypes also guide text modulation by assessing visual support for semantic components and regulating their relative contributions and overall fusion strength, reducing interference from unsupported descriptions. Extensive experiments on multiple pest recognition datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of PestWeave and its potential for practical pest management.

[281] Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing? cs.CV | cs.AI | cs.LG | cs.ROPDF

Cheng-Ru Chou, Shih-Yu Lai, Pei-Lin Chiang, Shou-Po Tsai, Jing-Zhe Huang

TL;DR: 论文提出MakeSense多模态融合框架，用于退化感知下的具身视觉，旨在缓解“负融合”问题，即增加传感器反而提高预测误差。方法通过私有流保留各传感器特有证据，并用共享瓶颈token进行信息融合，同时在训练中配对完整视图与传感器子集视图，惩罚传感器增多带来的更高误差。论文在五个数据集上验证该设计可识别有益/有害传感器添加，并通过轻量适配器迁移到无人机定位、协同3D检测、少样本姿态迁移和指令预测等任务。

Details

Motivation: 具身视觉系统依赖多传感器互补感知，但现有模型即使支持任意传感器子集，仍可能出现负融合，即新增传感器导致误差上升。论文关注如何在退化传感条件下实现更稳健、可解释的多模态融合。

Result: MakeSense在MM-Fi上减少了负融合；在MMAUD的无人机定位、V2X-Real的协同3D检测、RELI11D的少样本姿态迁移和Humanoid-Everyday的指令预测上均取得改进。基于冻结核心输出的世界模型在较长测试时域上预测未来融合状态比线性基线更准确。

Insight: 创新点包括：用私有流与共享瓶颈token分离传感器特有证据和共享融合信息；通过完整/子集视图配对训练显式惩罚传感器增加带来的误差；几何允许时距离读出仅用测距而其余预测使用全部输入；跨五个数据集的配对测试揭示有益与有害传感器添加，并以轻量适配器支持多任务具身感知。

Abstract: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. With lightweight adapters and per-dataset training, the same design improves UAV localization on MMAUD, cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Real, few-shot pose transfer to RELI11D, and command prediction on Humanoid-Everyday, where a world model trained on the frozen core’s outputs forecasts future fused states more accurately than a linear baseline at longer tested horizons. MakeSense supports embodied sensing across human activity, aerial systems, robotics, and autonomous driving.

[282] Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Bohe Chen

TL;DR: 论文指出现有的主动式任务助手评测基准存在“看时间而非看视频”的捷径：一个从不看视频、仅按固定时间报警和确认步骤的计时器基线在Ego-MC-Bench上取得高于已发表结果的mistake F1。作者将这一捷径可达到的性能边界形式化为video-blind frontier，并提出Evidence-Contrastive Training（ECT），通过在同一录制、同一已用时间下构造正负样本对进行对比微调，迫使模型依赖视觉证据。实验表明2B模型用ECT在QICD和Ego-MC-Bench上越过该边界，并在迁移和多种控制实验中表现出对视频内容的依赖。

Details

Motivation: 论文关注主动式任务助手需要判断步骤完成与错误发生的场景，指出当前基准和模型可能主要利用已用时间、指令和训练统计等非视觉线索，而非真正观察视频证据；目标是揭示并突破这种视频盲评测与模型捷径。

Result: 一个不看视频的计时器基线在Ego-MC-Bench上mistake F1达0.373，超过已发表最高约0.27；用209个QICD视频约15 GPU小时训练的2B ECT模型在四个随机种子下均越过video-blind frontier，并在无适配迁移到Ego-MC-Bench时及时确认59%的无错误步骤，而同等骨干的已发表模型为30%；等时间正负样本对判别达90-92%，时间戳重缩放几乎不影响，替换同食谱另一录制使完成准确率下降约三分之二。

Insight: 创新点在于将基准中可利用的时间盲区形式化为video-blind frontier，作为诊断评测捷径的工具；并提出ECT，在同一录制同一已用时间下配对正负样本，使时间无法区分正负，从而强制模型学习视觉证据。客观看，论文的重要贡献还包括揭示主动式任务助手基准的评测缺陷，并用较小模型和较少数据验证方法有效性。

Abstract: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark’s own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, so that elapsed time cannot separate the two sides of a pair. Trained on 209 QICD videos in about 15 GPU-hours, a 2B model with ECT crosses the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds; transferred to Ego-MC-Bench without adaptation, it confirms 59% of mistake-free steps in time, against 30% for a published model with the same backbone trained on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals and real recordings. Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains: at equal elapsed time it tells a finished step from an unfinished one in 90-92% of test pairs, where the instruction’s typical duration reaches 65%, rescaling the time stamps between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, and swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, cuts its completion accuracy by two thirds. The code and model weights will be publicly released.

[283] World Models as Native Latent Action Models cs.CV | cs.LG | cs.ROPDF

Qinyue Li, Weijie Qiao, Qingyi Tao, Zerui Gong, Zhe Yang

TL;DR: 论文提出将预训练视频世界模型作为原生潜在动作模型（Native LAM），通过可学习的动态寄存器从反事实时间对中蒸馏紧凑的潜在动作，并进一步提出PAWlicy预训练范式，将Native LAM作为动态教师来预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。在多个基准和真实机器人上取得优于现有方法的性能。

Details

Motivation: 现有潜在动作模型（LAM）需从头训练逆动力学和正动力学模型，面临像素重建与潜在容量/准确性的权衡；而预训练视频世界模型虽能生成高保真动态，但表示密集且纠缠。论文旨在以最小改动从世界模型中提取可迁移的紧凑潜在动作，解决无动作标注或异构动作空间视频中的动作表示学习问题。

Result: Native LAM在LARY基准上的动作分类和控制回归均优于现有LAM，并能跨机器人、跨场景及从人手到机器人重放相同运动；3.8B参数的PAWlicy在RoboTwin 2.0上达到93.6%平均成功率（VLA中最高），在RoboDojo各评估维度有竞争力且Precision与领先榜单条目相当，在真实机器人两个任务上均优于pi_0.5基线。

Insight: 创新点在于：将预训练视频扩散Transformer同时作为IDM和FDM，仅用可学习动态寄存器作为因果桥接，并在仅运动不同的反事实时间对上训练，从而蒸馏出紧凑的原生潜在动作；PAWlicy作为动态教师不生成视频。客观来看，该方法有效利用了世界模型的动态先验，避免了从头训练和像素重建的权衡，并实现了无需显式迁移目标的跨形态动作迁移。

Abstract: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video’s dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.

[284] GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind cs.CV | cs.ROPDF

Anh Dao, Quan-Dung Pham, Danh Vinh Le, Tuyen Pham Le, Quan Nguyen

TL;DR: 论文提出 GlanceNav，一种基于混合 MLLM 的流式视觉语言导航器。它用 Gated DeltaNet 维护贯穿整个 episode 的循环状态，并用注意力层保留短时窗口和由循环状态变化选出的关键帧库，从而以恒定内存和每步固定计算完成导航。论文还提出 Counterfactual Rewind（CoRe）强化学习阶段，通过回退到最接近目标的轨迹位置、专家少量纠正并按结果变化分配信用，提升从错误中学习的效率。

Details

Motivation: 现有 MLLM 导航策略在每一步重复编码历史帧，计算冗余且可用历史短；同时训练基于孤立决策和整段轨迹的单一结果奖励，难以高效利用历史并从错误中学习。论文希望每帧只编码一次、每步恒定开销，同时保留关键信息并高效强化学习。

Result: 仅用 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 训练集及 1000 条指令做强化学习，4B 模型在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE val-unseen 上成功率分别达 71.9% 和 73.6%；在 R2R-CE 上比此前不使用外部数据的最强单 RGB 方法高 9.1 个点，且每步运行 104 ms。

Insight: 创新点在于混合 MLLM 的恒定大小流式记忆：循环状态承载全 episode 历史，注意力保留近期观测与按状态变化选择的关键帧；以及 CoRe 通过可常数时间复制的记忆进行反事实回退和少量专家纠正，实现更细粒度的信用分配。客观看，结合高效记忆结构与回退式强化学习是较有借鉴价值的VLN效率与训练范式改进。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.

[285] Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding cs.CV | cs.AIPDF

Yicheng Zhang, Xun Zhang, Jingyuan Ma, Tianyu Yu, Yuan Yao

TL;DR: 论文指出当前视觉语言模型采用因果注意力，先出现的模态只能看到部分输入，难以形成统一的多模态理解。为此提出免训练的 Second-Look Prompting（SLP），将图像-问题对在输入中重复一次，使重复副本中的每个视觉与文本 token 都能关注完整输入，从而获得统一的多模态编码。方法简单通用，在多种开源与闭源模型、12 个基准上普遍提升性能。

Details

Motivation: 因果注意力使 token 只能关注其前面的内容，因此无论图像还是文本先出现，先出现的模态都会在信息不完整的情况下被编码，无法利用后续的多模态上下文。论文希望在不重新训练模型的前提下缓解这一结构性缺陷。

Result: 在 12 个基准上，SLP 使所有被评估模型的平均分均有提升，覆盖 9 个开源模型（3B–72B）和 3 个闭源前沿模型，其中 Gemini 3 Flash 在 MATH-Vision 上最高提升 5.6 分。

Insight: 创新点在于把“输入呈现方式”本身作为提升 VLM 的手段：通过重复输入让每个 token 都能看到完整上下文，实现统一多模态编码；并且发现新增视觉 token 不只是再次展示图像，即使替换为空白图像也能提升推理，其隐藏状态起到了预填充草稿本的作用。分析还揭示了问题引导第二张图的注意力分配这一互补机制。

Abstract: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it. Whichever modality comes first is therefore encoded under partial observation of the input, uninformed by the rest of the multimodal context. We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input. In the repeated copy, every visual and textual token can attend to the complete input, yielding a unified multimodal encoding of the pair. Moreover, the added visual tokens contribute computation beyond re-exposing the image: even a blank image in their place can improve reasoning. Across 12 benchmarks, SLP improves the overall average score of every evaluated model, spanning nine open-source models (3B-72B) and three proprietary frontier models, with gains reaching 5.6 points for Gemini 3 Flash on MATH-Vision. Our analysis reveals two complementary mechanisms: the question guides where the second image attends, and the added visual tokens act as a prefill scratchpad whose hidden states retain answer-relevant information from the image and question. These findings highlight input presentation as a simple yet effective way to improve VLM performance.

[286] SIAMBA: A Pseudo-Siamese Mamba-based Deep Learning Network for Multimodal Flood Change Detection cs.CVPDF

Muhammad Fasih Ishfaq, Giulio Weikmann, Lorenzo Bruzzone

TL;DR: 论文提出SIAMBA，一种基于伪孪生Mamba网络的多模态洪水变化检测方法，联合使用Sentinel-1 SAR与Sentinel-2多光谱双时相影像。模型采用模态特定编码器、选择性状态空间建模长程空间上下文，并通过门控跨模态变化模块融合多层级差异特征，实现渐进式多尺度解码。

Details

Motivation: 双时相多光谱与SAR联合洪水变化检测对灾害快速响应很重要，但面临云污染、光照变化、成像几何、SAR斑点噪声以及跨模态异质性和地物响应差异等挑战。论文旨在有效建模时间证据并处理跨模态异质性，提高复杂地理场景下的洪水变化检测性能。

Result: 在OMBRIA benchmark独立测试集上取得81.98% IoU和93.57% OA，为对比方法中最高；在法国、阿尔巴尼亚、圭亚那和东帝汶四个空间不连续区域子集上也取得最高未加权平均IoU和OA。

Insight: 创新点在于将伪孪生Mamba架构、模态特定编码与选择性状态空间长程上下文建模结合，并设计门控跨模态变化模块，在多语义层级提取绝对、有符号和相对对数比差异，配合注意力细化跳跃连接进行多尺度解码。客观上看，其价值主要在于面向多模态遥感异质性的差异融合与长程上下文建模设计。

Abstract: Flood change detection from bi-temporal multispectral and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images is essential for rapid disaster response. In this context, Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery provides discriminative spectral observations, whereas Sentinel-1 SAR provides weather-independent structural information. Using these modalities jointly requires modelling temporal evidence while accounting for cross-modal heterogeneity. In particular, change detection is complicated by cloud contamination, illumination variability, acquisition geometry and speckle, and heterogeneous land-cover responses. To address these challenges, we propose SIAMBA, a pseudo-siamese Mamba-based network for bi-temporal flood change detection from paired Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations. SIAMBA uses dedicated modality-specific encoders with dual-pooling squeeze-and-excitation recalibration and selective state-space processing for long-range spatial context. A gated cross-modal change module derives absolute, signed, and relative log-ratio differences at multiple semantic levels, and attention-refined skip connections support progressive multi-scale decoding. Experiments are carried out on OMBRIA benchmark, which includes an independent test set and geographically diverse subsets in France, Albania, Guyana, and Timor. SIAMBA achieves 81.98% IoU, and 93.57% OA on the independent test set, reaching the highest values in the considered comparison. It also provides the highest unweighted average IoU and OA across four regional subsets spatially disjuncted. These results indicate that combining selective state-space contextual modelling with gated multiscale discrepancy learning effectively improves flood change mapping across the evaluated geographic settings.

[287] Diffutoon-2: Toon Shading with Video Diffusion Models cs.CVPDF

Yuze Sun, Zhongjie Duan, Yingda Chen, Jingjing Chen

TL;DR: 论文提出 Diffutoon-2，一个视频扩散框架，通过动画重建学习卡通着色，将真实视频转换为动漫风格。方法使用两个互补模块分别从轮廓和模糊颜色重建动画片段，并在冻结视频主干的情况下联合引导推理生成。该方法无需跨域训练配对或外部风格参考，在定量指标和人工评估上优于通用及领域专用基线。

Details

Motivation: 现有卡通着色扩散方法通常依赖精心构建的源域-风格域训练对或额外视觉参考；Diffutoon 虽避免这些要求，但仍基于图像扩散主干、短窗口运动模块和重复重叠窗口去噪，存在局限。论文旨在构建更直接、无需配对数据和外部风格参考的视频扩散卡通着色框架。

Result: 摘要称大量实验表明 Diffutoon-2 在定量指标和人工评估上均优于通用基线及领域专用基线；未提及具体 benchmark 名称或数值。

Insight: 创新点在于通过动画重建学习卡通着色：两个互补模块分别从轮廓和模糊颜色重建动画片段，且冻结视频扩散主干；推理时用从真实视频提取的同类条件联合引导生成，从而避免跨域训练配对和外部风格参考。客观看，其可借鉴之处是将条件重建作为视频扩散的引导机制，并利用冻结主干降低训练依赖。

Abstract: Toon shading renders objects with a flat, stylized appearance. Diffusion models open a new route to this task by transforming photorealistic videos into an anime style. However, existing approaches often rely on curated source and style training pairs or additional visual references. Diffutoon avoids these requirements through structure guidance and colorization, but builds on an image diffusion backbone with short-window motion modules and repeated overlapping-window denoising. We present Diffutoon-2, a video diffusion framework that learns toon shading through animation reconstruction. Two complementary modules independently reconstruct animation clips from outlines and blurred colors, with the video backbone frozen. At inference, the modules jointly guide generation using the same types of conditions extracted from photorealistic footage, requiring neither cross-domain training pairs nor external style references. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffutoon-2 outperforms both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines, across quantitative metrics and human evaluation.

[288] Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning cs.CV | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Zhuoying Yang, Yichen Guo, Kathy Jia, Zichang Su, Ayesha Kashif

TL;DR: 论文提出LatentParse，一个无需训练的框架，用于提升视觉语言模型（VLM）的多视角空间推理能力。该方法把CLIP、DINOv3、VGGT三种预训练视觉编码器的潜在特征，通过一个“分析者”VLM借助预定义工具（定位物体、跨视角跟踪、度量视角间运动）解析为显式的空间证据，再蒸馏成简洁的文本报告，与图像一同输入目标VLM作答。在MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench和SPAR-Bench上对五个VLM均有稳定提升。

Details

Motivation: 多视角空间推理需要从2D观测推断物体与相机间的3D关系，依赖跨视角对应和场景几何，而现有VLM无法可靠提取这些信息；尽管预训练视觉编码器的潜在特征中已包含此类信息，但直接以灰度特征图形式放入上下文对VLM并无帮助，因此需要将潜在特征“翻译”成VLM可利用的形式。

Result: 在MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench、SPAR-Bench三个基准上，五个VLM相比仅输入图像的基线平均提升0.7–2.4个百分点；在MMSI-Bench上，Qwen3-27B从34.4%提升到39.5%，其中与相机相关的题目提升最大，达19.2个百分点。

Insight: 创新点在于无需训练即把多种视觉编码器的潜在特征解析为结构化文本关系证据：用分析者VLM加工具调用主动探测特征，而非直接拼接特征图；并融合语义（DINOv3）、区域-语言对齐（CLIP）与多视角几何（VGGT）三类互补信息，将隐式特征转换为显式、可被LLM消费的空间证据。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

[289] OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes? cs.CVPDF

Liu Yang, Huiyu Duan, Yixuan Gao, Sirui Liu, Lu Liu

TL;DR: 论文提出 OmniV-Bench，用于系统评估多模态大模型对全向视频（ODV）中沉浸式 360 度时空场景的理解能力；该基准包含 4,123 个高质量 ODV 和 8,923 个人工标注问答对，覆盖 11 个细粒度任务。实验表明现有 MLLMs 在该场景下仍面临显著挑战，作者进一步提出 OmniV-Harness 智能体框架以增强 ODV 理解与时空推理。

Details

Motivation: 全向视频能提供丰富的 360 度空间上下文和时间动态，但现有 MLLMs 对 ODV 所承载的沉浸式时空信息理解能力尚未被充分探索，缺乏系统评测基准和有效增强方法。

Result: 构建了 OmniV-Bench 基准，涵盖通用、空间和时空理解三类共 11 项任务；实验显示当前 MLLMs 在 ODV 时空复杂度下表现受限，而 OmniV-Harness 能一致提升其沉浸式时空推理能力。摘要未给出具体数值或 SOTA 对比。

Insight: 创新点在于系统化建立全向视频沉浸式时空理解基准，并提出结合视角引导证据初始化、任务相关证据获取和自适应工具使用的智能体框架。客观来看，其价值在于将 ODV 评测与 agentic 工具增强结合，为 MLLMs 的 360 度时空推理提供新评测与方法思路。

Abstract: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.

[290] WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild cs.CVPDF

Richard Shaw, Arthur Moreau, Athanasios Papaioannou, Thomas Tanay, Zhensong Zhang

TL;DR: 论文提出 WildAnySplat，一个面向野外多视图图像的前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，用于在存在瞬态遮挡、光照变化和相机 ISP 导致的多视图不一致时进行鲁棒的新视角合成。方法采用学生-教师框架，让学生从野外输入中学习一致的三维表示，并由干净图像教师提供监督；同时结合真实配对、合成增强和伪干净标签的混合数据策略。模型基于 Transformer 和 DPT 头预测相机位姿、深度与高斯，并引入逐视图瞬态掩码和 bilateral grid 颜色变换模块。

Details

Motivation: 现有前馈重建方法在真实野外图像中容易受到瞬态遮挡、光照变化和相机 ISP 等因素影响，导致多视图不一致并降低重建质量；论文旨在提升前馈 3DGS 在野外场景中的鲁棒性和外观一致性。

Result: 在具有挑战性的野外基准上，WildAnySplat 提升了对瞬态遮挡和外观变化的鲁棒性，同时保留了前馈 Gaussian Splatting 的快速推理能力；摘要未给出具体定量数值或明确 SOTA 声明。

Insight: 创新点包括：用学生-教师框架从干净图像学习鲁棒规范表示；结合真实配对、合成增强和优化重建伪标签的混合数据策略；预测逐视图瞬态掩码以重加权光度监督并抑制不可靠高斯；用 bilateral grid 建模逐图像颜色变换以恢复规范辐射表示。客观来看，论文将野外不一致性建模显式融入前馈 3DGS，通过掩码、颜色校正和教师蒸馏缓解数据稀缺与域差距，具有较好的工程整合价值。

Abstract: We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images. Unlike controlled captures, real-world images often contain multi-view inconsistencies caused by transient occluders, illumination changes, and camera ISP, which degrade the quality of existing feed-forward reconstruction methods. To address this challenge, we introduce a student-teacher framework that learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent 3D representations. A teacher network operates on clean images, while a student processes the corresponding in-the-wild inputs. The teacher provides clean supervision to guide the student toward a consistent canonical representation. Since paired clean and in-the-wild data are scarce, we use a hybrid data strategy, combining real paired captures, synthetic augmentations, and pseudo-clean labels generated from optimization-based reconstructions, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data. We adopt a transformer architecture with dedicated DPT heads for camera pose, depth, and Gaussian prediction. We additionally predict per-view transient masks to reweight photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians. To account for cross-view appearance variation, we incorporate a bilateral grid module that models per-image color transformations and enables recovery of a canonical radiance representation. Experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks show that WildAnySplat improves robustness to transient occlusions and appearance variation while retaining the fast inference of feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.

[291] Token Pruning Needs a Protected Sink Token: Coherent Spatial Aggregation in Vision Transformers cs.CVPDF

Julian Wyatt, James Willoughby, Allison Clement, Irina Voiculescu

TL;DR: 论文研究视觉Transformer在token剪枝下的响应机制，提出Monte Carlo Token Pruning（MCTP）来估计前向过程中显式移除token对预测的影响。作者发现DINOv3等模型在不同深度保持较一致的token重要性排序（高连贯空间聚合），而SigLIP 2不具备该性质；这种连贯性依赖高范数“sink” token的保留。基于此，论文建议token reduction方法应保护sink token，并提供一种事后评估预训练ViT剪枝响应的方法。

Details

Motivation: 现有token reduction工作多比较剪枝算法本身，较少分析模型如何响应剪枝以及这种响应随模型深度如何变化。论文旨在理解ViT对token移除的敏感机制，并找出维持剪枝后预测稳定性的关键因素。

Result: 将MCTP应用于预训练模型发现，DINOv3在各深度保持较高的token重要性排序连贯性，而SigLIP 2不连贯；移除DINOv3的prefix token会导致预测和连贯性崩塌，而仅保护SigLIP 2的5个sink token可将物体边界框外token影响最多降低62%。

Insight: 创新点在于用MCTP显式评估token移除对预测的影响，并揭示高范数sink token对ViT剪枝后连贯空间聚合的关键作用。客观来看，论文将“保护sink token”作为token reduction的设计原则，并提供了一种无需重训练的事后剪枝响应评估视角。

Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are a predominant architecture for computer vision, with token reduction emerging as a popular paradigm to improve their efficiency. Prior work compares reduction algorithms, but not how models respond to them, nor how their response changes with model depth. We propose Monte Carlo Token Pruning (MCTP), which estimates each token’s impact on the prediction when tokens are explicitly removed during the forward pass. Applying MCTP to recent pretrained models, we observe that most, such as DINOv3, maintain a similar ranking of token importance at every depth (high Coherent Aggregation), while SigLIP 2 does not. This coherence requires predictions to survive pruning, which depends on keeping high-norm “sink” tokens: prefix tokens are kept by design, while prefix-free SigLIP 2 forms them on patch tokens, which pruning may remove. We show that in removing DINOv3’s prefix tokens, its predictions and coherence collapse, while protecting only 5 tokens for SigLIP 2 cuts the token impact outside the object’s bounding box by up to 62%. Beyond this, MCTP offers a post-hoc method to evaluate how a pretrained ViT responds to pruning, and suggests that token reduction methods should keep “sinks”.

Abstract: Dietary decisions require identifying a food’s nutrient content and considering individual dietary needs, but recognizing food from an image alone does not provide this information. Visually similar foods can have different nutrient profiles, so selecting the wrong food record can lead to incorrect decisions even when nutrient rules are applied correctly. Using this dataset, we construct three diagnostic tasks covering visual nutrient question answering, personalized food recommendation, and condition-aware food substitution. Paired instances and input controls examine how visual identity and respondent context affect decisions. Motivation: 多标签遥感场景分类面临复杂空间-光谱模式、极端类别不平衡以及标签间依赖建模不足等问题，论文旨在同时增强视觉上下文建模和自适应标签关系推理。

Abstract: Multi-label remote sensing scene classification remains a challenging task due to complex spatial-spectral patterns, extreme class imbalance, and inter-label dependencies that are often insufficiently modeled. To address these challenges, we introduce a Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network (SRCWDNet), which integrates three key modules: (1) a Cross-Window Attention module that captures local and global visual context through learnable global tokens; (2) a Dual Label-Graph module that adaptively combines statistical co-occurrence graphs and learned semantic-embedding graphs to facilitate label-relational reasoning; and (3) a Neural Classifier Chain that sequentially predicts labels to exploit inter-label dependencies. These findings demonstrate that jointly modeling visual attention and adaptive label correlations can substantially improve multi-label remote sensing scene classification, particularly under long-tailed class distributions.

Motivation: 实时自由视角人体视频流需要逐帧实时重建、严格带宽预算和轻量客户端 GPU 解码，但现有逐帧优化或前馈推理会产生巨大 3D Gaussian 数据，难以实际流式传输，而强压缩又会严重损害渲染质量。

Abstract: Live free-viewpoint video streaming of humans enables immersive telepresence and interactive XR applications. However, this requires reconstructing each frame in real time, transmitting the data within strict bandwidth budgets, and decoding it on lightweight client GPUs. Existing approaches, whether relying on per-frame optimization or feed-forward inference, generate massive 3D Gaussian payloads that exceed practical streaming limits, while aggressive compression severely degrades rendering quality. HoloSplat splits a feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head, introducing a multi-rate streaming codec driven by server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. On the server side, we apply opacity-guided token pruning, PCA-based dimensionality reduction, and lossless geometry coding for token anchors. On the client side, a feature reconstruction hypernetwork is fused into the Gaussian head to recover compression-induced quality loss. Furthermore, we introduce Neural Session Calibration (NSC), which rapidly fine-tunes the Gaussian head online using incoming camera views during a warm-up phase. This resolves quality degradation from novel camera parameters and varying capture conditions with zero per-frame overhead. In our evaluations, HoloSplat averages 32.2 FPS on four RTX 5090 GPUs at 50 Mbit/s. It decodes each frame into 3D Gaussians in 22.1 ms on an RTX 3050 Ti laptop GPU, transmitting 22.8$\times$ less data than uncompressed float32 Gaussians, while calibrated decoding improves PSNR by 1.050 dB.

Motivation: 现有自回归视频少步生成仍依赖DMD以保持竞争力，但DMD牺牲样本多样性且需要大规模双向教师；论文旨在分析限制独立AR FlowMap蒸馏的因素，使纯FlowMap蒸馏在少步AR视频生成中具备竞争力。

Abstract: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher’s denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.

Motivation: 多条件/all-in-one 视频生成中，身份、涂鸦、深度、运动视频等条件都会被 token 化并拼接，导致条件 token 的计算开销占主导；但这些 token 中存在大量时空冗余，因此需要在几乎不损失质量的前提下减少条件 token。

Abstract: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.

[299] WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation cs.CVPDF

Motivation: 4D时空视觉缺乏类似NLP中GPT统一token表示的共同表示协议，感知任务与生成任务通常由分离的单向管线处理，或由未对齐的单模态空间拼接而成，难以统一优化和扩展。

Abstract: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today’s state-of-the-art large language models. By casting diverse understanding and generation problems into a shared token representation, GPT enables a single architecture and unified optimization loop to master heterogeneous tasks across massive corpora, giving rise to powerful foundation models for natural language. In contrast, 4D spatiotemporal vision lacks a common representational protocol: perception (such as depth and camera estimation) and generation are either handled by separate one-way pipelines or bolted together from unaligned single-modality spaces. In this work, we introduce WorldLatent, a framework that formulates a unified 4D latent space as a common protocol for both world perception and generation. Rather than relying on fragmented, task-specific models or stacked single-modality representations, our framework proposes a multimodal VAE architecture that compresses and fuses complex 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single structured latent representation. Within this formulation, perception and generation operate as complementary denoising processes over the same latent space, enabling one generative model to learn both capabilities simultaneously within a single training loop. Experiments across representative 4D benchmarks verify that our fused latent protocol achieves specialist-level zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing from a single model. By demonstrating that diverse 4D tasks can be seamlessly unified under a shared representational protocol, our work provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.
