Details

Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型难以有效整合视觉理解与生成，而直接利用预训练视觉语言模型也面临理解与生成所依赖的视觉表示不一致的问题。论文的出发点是让预训练模型已学到的多模态知识能够被视觉生成有效利用。

Result: 论文报告该方法在保留预训练理解能力的同时扩展出较强视觉生成能力；受控对比表明，在重建保真度相当的情况下，共享视觉表示比使用独立视觉表示空间能显著提升生成学习效果，但摘要未给出具体benchmark或定量指标。

Insight: 创新点在于构建理解与生成共享的视觉表示空间：用 Abstraction Fusion 聚合冻结视觉编码器的分层表示形成共享视觉token，并用 Block-wise MoT 让轻量生成流仅在块边界与视觉语言模型交互。客观看，其可借鉴之处是复用冻结VLM表示并以低耦合方式接入生成流，从而兼顾预训练理解能力的保留与生成能力扩展。

Abstract: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

[301] Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic cs.CVPDF

Zihang Lin, Huaiyuan Qin, Liangli Zhen, Qing Guo, Jun Liu

TL;DR: 论文发现现代自监督ViT（如DINOv2/v3）存在类似人类空想性错觉的现象：在纯噪声输入上，其特征的少数方向仍形成空间连贯模式（pareidolic子空间），且该子空间占据了自然图像特征方差的大部分，导致物体涌现能力下降。作者提出无需训练的校准方法PSC，通过缩放该子空间方向来恢复物体发现能力，在多个任务上显著提升性能。

Details

Motivation: 解决自监督ViT中物体涌现能力（object emergence）下降的问题，特别是DINOv2/v3虽密集特征更强但物体涌现能力远不如DINO。探究其原因是特征中存在由噪声引起的虚假空间模式（pareidolia），并试图通过校准恢复模型发现物体的能力。

Result: 在物体发现任务上提升最多31.7 CorLoc，显著性检测提升30.2 maxF，视频物体分割提升59.9 J。这些结果说明PSC有效恢复了DINOv2/v3的物体涌现能力。

Insight: 创新点在于发现并命名了自监督ViT中的pareidolia现象，揭示了patch-level loss与图像级损失对该现象的影响，并提出简单有效的训练无关校准方法PSC。客观分析：该工作从特征空间角度解释了模型能力差异，提供了一种可解释的校准手段，可能对自监督学习的目标函数设计有启发。

Abstract: In human perception, pareidolia is the tendency to perceive a meaningful pattern, such as a face, in a random or ambiguous stimulus.We find a similar phenomenon in modern self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs): on white noise, which contains neither objects nor spatial structure, a few directions of their features still form spatially coherent patterns across the patches, imposed by the features themselves.We call this behavior pareidolia, and the span of these directions the pareidolic subspace.On natural images, it holds most of the feature variance in DINOv2 and DINOv3 but little in DINO.This excess explains why DINOv2 and DINOv3, despite stronger dense features, fall far behind DINO in object emergence, the hallmark ability of self-supervised ViTs to identify the patches of an object on their own.Our experiments further show that scaling down their pareidolic subspaces steadily restores their ability to discover objects, so their object emergence is hindered rather than lost.These findings naturally lead to a training-free calibration: Pareidolia Subspace Calibration(PSC) measures the pareidolic subspace only on a noise input and then calibrates the features of natural inputs by scaling its directions down to the variance level of the remaining directions.Across diverse object emergence tasks, PSC improves DINOv2 and DINOv3 by up to 31.7 CorLoc on object discovery, 30.2 maxF on saliency detection and 59.9~$\mathcal{J}$ on video object segmentation.To identify the cause of pareidolia, we trace it block by block and find that it forms in the middle blocks of every self-supervised model we examine but stays strong to the last block only in models trained with a patch-level loss; controlled training confirms that an image-level loss alone lets it fade.

[302] Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory cs.CVPDF

Chen Wang, Jiahui Huang, Riccardo de Lutio, Alex Trevithick, Bryan Chu

TL;DR: 论文提出 Lyris，一个面向长视频生成的布局引导框架：对已观测或已生成区域使用持久点云记忆，对未观测区域由视觉语言模型生成粗粒度 3D 布局作为锚点，从而实现从单张照片出发、相机可控且返回时保持一致的长距离场景漫游。系统可生成超过 3 分钟、50 米的漫游视频，并能穿过门口进入原图未展示的房间。

Details

Motivation: 现有基于记忆的视频生成方法只能保持已见内容，缺少对未观测区域的锚定，容易导致相机漂移；文本提示能命名物体但不能精确放置，而布局条件方法通常依赖人工制作布局。论文希望自动为视频模型在已观测和未观测区域都提供空间锚点，实现精确相机控制和长期一致性。

Result: 论文展示了从单张照片生成超过 3 分钟、50 米的漫游视频，并可进入未展示房间；在四个数据集上的分钟级往返评测中大幅优于 SOTA，相机误差降低 3.8 倍，返回一致性平均提升 22%。

Insight: 创新点在于将持久点云记忆与 VLM 自动生成的 3D 布局结合：已观测/生成区域由点云记忆锚定，未观测区域由 VLM 用每个物体一个带标签 3D 框的粗布局锚定。该粗粒度布局接口简单到 VLM 可生成、用户可编辑，又足以让视频模型沿相机路径渲染并遵循，是连接布局控制与长视频生成的可借鉴设计。

Abstract: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return. Memory-based video generation methods preserve what they have already seen, but have no anchor beyond it, where the camera drifts from its path and a text prompt can name objects but not place them. Layout-conditioned methods provide such an anchor and precise control over what appears where, but rely on layouts that are typically authored by hand. Both limitations arise because, beyond what was captured, nothing anchors the video model unless a human authors one. To overcome both, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework that never leaves the video model without an anchor: a persistent point-cloud memory where the scene has been observed or generated, and a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors where it has not. Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse. A layout of one labeled 3D box per object is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow once rendered along the camera path. We demonstrate walkthroughs of over three minutes and 50 meters from a single photo, passing through doorways into rooms it never shows. When evaluated on minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a wide margin, reducing camera error by 3.8x and improving consistency upon return by 22% on average.

[303] Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action cs.CV | cs.LG | cs.ROPDF

Seongchan Kim, Soowon Son, Sangoh Kim, Hyunah Ko, Eunbeen Hong

TL;DR: 论文研究自动驾驶推理式VLA模型的结构化剪枝，提出MoOP方法，通过融合推理与轨迹预测两个目标的重要性排名来剪枝VLM，并聚合去噪步重要性选择固定的动作专家MLP通道子集，从而在减少参数和内存的同时尽量保留推理与动作能力。

Details

Motivation: 推理式VLA模型使用CoT推理指导动作生成，但带来显著内存和计算开销；论文希望在不进行后剪枝微调的情况下，结构化剪枝并同时保留场景理解、推理和轨迹预测能力。

Result: 在24.0%参数减少下，MoOP的驾驶表现与最强基线相当或略好，并保留94.0%的稠密模型LingoQA分数；在30.0%减少下退化最小且是唯一推理未崩溃的方法。结合移除93.75%动作专家MLP通道后总参数减少39.4%，开环误差接近不变、闭环有竞争力，并实现1.37倍端到端加速和36.6%峰值内存降低。

Insight: 创新点在于发现推理与轨迹目标对同一VLM结构赋予不同重要性，以及动作专家中MLP通道比query heads在去噪步间更稳定且少数通道主导重要性；MoOP据此融合双目标排名剪枝VLM，并聚合逐步重要性选择固定MLP通道子集。

Abstract: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model’s LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

cs.AI [Back]

[304] SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Sudhakar Mishra

TL;DR: 论文提出 SAMA，一种免训练的相机心率（rPPG）估计器：对 POS 与 CHROM 两类色度谱做质量加权共识，扣除由同帧运动、皮肤掩膜几何和背景亮度构造的无脉搏参考所占频段，再用随机游走先验下的 Viterbi 脊线在时间上跟踪心率，输出经轨迹滤波、幅度归一化并带逐窗口置信度的波形。方法在五个公开数据集的 218 段视频上以统一固定人脸框和 rPPG-Toolbox 协议评测。

Details

Motivation: 现有 rPPG 评测通常只用每段视频一个心率，掩盖了远程问诊中真正读取脉搏的短时间窗口；作者希望得到一种无需训练、无需数据集调参、在短窗口上依然稳健的心率估计方法。

Result: 在五个数据集上各协议层级的平均 MAE 均为最低：逐视频 4.40 对 POS 的 5.13 bpm，30s 窗口 4.80 对 5.43，10s 窗口 5.05 对 6.59；30s 与 10s 窗口上配对差值的 bootstrap 区间不含零（Wilcoxon p=0.11 与 0.004），但逐视频不显著，且在 SUMS 逐视频和 MMPD 子集上未超过 POS；未超过 UBFC-rPPG 上已发表的最佳神经网络。剔除 20% 最低置信窗口可使 10s 池化误差从 4.06 降至 2.33 bpm。

Insight: 创新点在于完全免训练免调参的流程：多色度谱质量加权共识、利用无脉搏参考频段抑制伪影、Viterbi 脊线时间跟踪并输出逐窗口置信度。此外论文揭示了逐视频协议存在 1.2–1.6 bpm 的误差下限、未校准视频无法恢复肤色，指出评测协议本身的局限，这些诊断性发现也具借鉴价值。

Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is usually benchmarked by one heart rate per video, a figure that hides the short windows in which a tele-consultation would actually read the pulse. We present SAMA, a training-free estimator that (i) forms a quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra, (ii) discounts frequencies occupied by pulse-free references derived from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry and background brightness), (iii) follows the heart rate through time with a Viterbi ridge under a random-walk prior, and (iv) returns a track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with a per-window confidence. No parameter is learned and no dataset-specific tuning is used. On 218 recordings from 111 participants in five public datasets (UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a two-participant subset of MMPD), all processed with the same fixed face box and scored with a re-implementation of the rPPG-Toolbox protocol, SAMA has the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over datasets at every protocol level: 4.40 against 5.13,bpm for POS per video, 4.80 against 5.43 on 30,s windows and 5.05 against 6.59 on 10,s windows. Pooled over participants, the bootstrap interval of its paired difference from POS excludes zero on 30,s and 10,s windows (Wilcoxon p=0.11 and 0.004) but not per video, and it does not beat POS on SUMS per video or on the MMPD subset. Withholding the 20% least confident windows lowers the pooled 10,s error from 4.06 to 2.33,bpm. We also show that the per-video protocol has a floor of 1.2–1.6,bpm on datasets where heart rate drifts, and that skin tone cannot be recovered from uncalibrated video, which motivates the instrumented, skin-tone-stratified collection we propose for the Indian population. The method does not surpass the best published neural networks on UBFC-rPPG; we report where it stands against them without re-running them.

[305] From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.CVPDF

Changyu Du, Stavros Nousias, Syed Salman Ahmed, Kai Dietmair, Mohammad Alrabab’h

TL;DR: 论文将建筑环境中的场景级Scan-to-BIM建模定义为智能体式3D编码任务，并发布S2Bench基准，包含128个真实场景扫描及专家参考模型。智能体可在统一框架中用Python测量扫描、在实时CAD/BIM内核中构建带类别标签的构件并迭代修正代码，同时提出并行异步协作机制。论文系统评测了五个智能体和协作团队在1028次重建中的表现。

Details

Motivation: 现有编码智能体可将3D测量转为CAD几何，但建筑环境的工程模型重建不仅需要表面拟合，还需要语义理解与一致的建造约束。论文旨在推动从点云到BIM的智能体式场景级重建评测。

Result: 领先智能体可在5cm内覆盖96%的扫描几何，但mIoU仅63%，且没有智能体在超过38%的场景中通过全部工程检查。覆盖率和工程一致性随场景规模下降；将较小模型作为团队运行可同时改善几何覆盖、语义和工程一致性，并在大场景上获得更大覆盖提升。

Insight: 创新点在于将Scan-to-BIM形式化为可交互、可迭代的智能体3D编码任务，构建跨领域真实场景与专家模型基准，并提出并行异步多智能体协作框架。客观看，其价值还包括揭示几何拟合与工程语义/建造关系推理之间的显著差距。

Abstract: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96%$ coverage within $5,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/

[306] Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Haibin Tong, Liangliang Xin, Yamei Zhu, Jiang Yu

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向马尔可夫推理的专用大语言模型统一设计范式，从缓存、学习和架构三个层面解耦推理链长度与内存占用：缓存层面用恒定大小的状态转移替代历史KV存储，学习层面将长链预测重构为独立可训练的一步转移目标，架构层面引入双循环Transformer（外循环推进推理状态，内循环递归深度分配自适应计算），并配套三区域缓存、步相对位置、截断反向传播等机制。

Details

Motivation: 标准自回归LLM的KV缓存随生成历史增长，成为长链推理和多分支采样的内存与吞吐瓶颈；而许多推理问题本质是一阶马尔可夫的，下一步仅依赖当前状态的充分表示而非全部历史步骤，因此需要专门设计以状态为中心、内存开销与推理链长度解耦的推理引擎。

Result: 摘要中未提及具体定量实验结果、benchmark或SOTA对比，仅提出设计范式和评估协议。

Insight: 创新点在于将马尔可夫性显式融入LLM设计：缓存层面提出恒定大小的马尔可夫状态接口，学习层面用独立可训练的一步转移目标配合状态瓶颈、蒸馏、不变性和漂移一致性损失，架构层面设计双循环Transformer（外循环状态推进+内循环递归深度自适应计算），并配套三区域缓存、步相对位置、截断反向传播和分支感知检查点等工程机制，核心思想是推理系统只需携带未来所需信息而非记住全部历史。

Abstract: Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps. At the learning level, we reformulate long-chain prediction as independently trainable one-step transition objectives, with explicit state bottlenecks, distillation, invariance, and drift-consistency losses. At the architectural level, we introduce a dual-loop Transformer: an outer loop advances the reasoning state, while an inner recurrent-depth loop allocates adaptive computation to each transition through shared weights and explicit memory tokens or recurrent matrix states. We connect this architecture to a three-region cache, step-relative positions, truncated backpropagation, branch-aware checkpoints, and a transition-centric evaluation protocol. The organizing principle is simple: the optimal reasoning system need not remember everything; it must carry forward exactly what the future needs. This principle opens a path toward specialized reasoning engines whose memory footprint is decoupled from reasoning-chain length.

[307] DiscernBench: Evaluating Cooperative Discernment of LLM Agents in Institutional Settings cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Disha Sheshanarayana, Tanishka Magar

TL;DR: 论文提出 DiscernBench，一个用于评估 LLM 智能体在航空、执法、应急管理等机构场景中是否应遵从、拒绝或上报请求的协作判断基准。该基准基于真实事件报告构造场景，评估 8 个 LLM 在三种决策配置下的最终决策与多智能体审议中的中间判断，揭示了多智能体协作中的决策聚合偏差。

Details

Motivation: LLM 部署到实际业务中需要判断其在制度约束下能否正确合规、拒绝或升级请求；现有评估多关注单智能体推理或最终答案准确率，缺少对多智能体协作判断及冲突决策过程的系统评估。

Result: 实验覆盖 8 个 LLM 和 3 种决策配置。角色专业化多智能体审议将平均过度上报率从单智能体直接判断的 3.79% 提升到 28.27%；在分歧下出现 Minority-Signal Override，即单个专家建议可能不成比例地影响集体决策，且影响方向和幅度随模型与专家角色显著变化。

Insight: 创新点在于提出面向机构场景的协作判断基准，使用真实事件报告构造场景，并同时分析最终决策和多智能体审议中的中间判断；客观来看，其价值在于揭示最终答案准确率无法捕捉的集体决策行为，强调可信多智能体系统还需评估冲突判断如何转化为集体决策。

Abstract: The deployment of large language models in operational settings demands evaluation of judgment under institutional constraint. We introduce DiscernBench, a benchmark for evaluating cooperative discernment: the ability of an agent to determine whether to comply with, refuse, or escalate a request in an institutional setting. DiscernBench comprises scenarios derived from real-world incident reports across domains such as aviation, law enforcement, and emergency management. We evaluate eight LLMs across three decision-making configurations and analyze both final decisions and the intermediate judgments produced during multi-agent deliberation. Under disagreement, Final Responders exhibit model- and role-dependent aggregation patterns in which a lone specialist recommendation can disproportionately influence the collective decision, a phenomenon we term Minority-Signal Override. Role-specialized multi-agent deliberation raises average over-escalation from 3.79% under direct single-agent judgment to 28.27%, with the direction and magnitude of minority-signal influence varying substantially across models and specialist roles. These results reveal distinct collective decision behaviors that are not captured by final-answer accuracy alone. Trustworthy multi-agent systems therefore require evaluating not only individual specialist reasoning, but also how conflicting judgments are transformed into collective decisions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Disha1001/DiscernBench.

[308] MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Kewei Wei, XueXiang Wen, Bocheng Hu, Weili Xu, Haiyang Yu

TL;DR: 论文提出 MVAgent，一种无需训练的多视频理解智能体框架：为每个视频分配一个 LocalAgent 独立规划观察并维护私有观察历史，再由 GlobalAgent 协调跨视频推理与联合观察。该框架将单视频观察决策与跨视频判断解耦，在多个多视频理解基准上提升效果并加快运行速度。

Details

Motivation: 现有多视频理解智能体通常由单一控制器同时完成逐视频观察决策和跨视频判断，导致上下文累积所有视频观察、难以适配各视频内容并影响跨视频推理效率。论文旨在分离这两类决策以提升多视频理解效果和效率。

Result: 在 CVBench、MVU-Eval 和 CrossVid 上，使用不同规模 Qwen3.5 时平均比同模型单次推理高 5.1 分、比同模型最强先前智能体高 5.0 分；使用 GPT-6-sol 时比同模型单次推理平均高 4.3 分，并在相同硬件上比同规模先前智能体快 1.8–2.7 倍。

Insight: 创新点在于训练-free 的层级多智能体架构：LocalAgent 按视频独立观察并保留私有历史，GlobalAgent 通过指令与报告汇总进行跨视频协调和联合观察。客观上看，其可借鉴之处是将局部感知规划与全局推理分离，减少上下文污染并提升多视频证据整合效率。

Abstract: Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video’s content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves aggregate benchmark scores by 5.1 points on average over Single-pass inference with the same model and by 5.0 points over the strongest prior agent using the same model. With GPT-6-sol, the average gain over Single-pass inference with the same model is 4.3 points. On the same hardware, MVAgent also runs 1.8-2.7 times faster than prior agents of comparable size.

[309] GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Wenyi Wu, Siqi Liu, Yuru Feng, Zixuan Song, Aayush Salvi

TL;DR: 论文提出GameAnything，一个开源智能体平台，通过迭代开发将多模态灵感转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展；同时构建GameAnything-Bench基准，评估九种编码智能体配置在功能正确性和游戏质量上的表现。

Details

Motivation: 现有游戏开发系统和基准主要关注明确规格，难以支持多模态参考适配，也缺乏对实际游戏体验的评估。

Result: 评估九种编码智能体配置发现，当前智能体能适配参考内容，但在可玩交互和精确修改上仍有困难；多模态参考提升内容保真度，迭代细化带来显著但因智能体而异的效果提升。

Insight: 创新点在于整合编码智能体与独立试玩批评器、持久开发状态和可复用经验记忆，并构建覆盖多模态参考、游戏目标和环境的基准，用探索性玩法测试同时评估功能正确性与游戏质量。

Abstract: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.

[310] SAEPO: Sparse-Autoencoder-Guided Credit Assignment for Policy Optimization cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Yusong Zhao, Zihao Zhao, Zirui Zhang, Tunyu Zhang, Ziyan Wang

TL;DR: 论文提出 SAEPO，一种由稀疏自编码器（SAE）引导的 token 级信用分配方法，用于结果监督的策略优化。它不只在序列级判断正确性，而是利用预训练 SAE 在推理轨迹中构建 token 级语义表示，并依据 SAE 概念对 token 打分，从而实现更细粒度的优势塑造。SAEPO 可作为插件兼容 GRPO、GSPO 等策略优化算法，并在数学和代码基准上验证有效性。

Details

Motivation: 现有 RLVR 依赖可验证奖励，但结果验证器只提供粗粒度的序列级正确性信号，无法指出哪些中间推理 token 对成功或失败有贡献。直接基于稀疏结果反馈训练基座模型时，策略优化效率较低，因此需要更细粒度的信用分配。

Result: 论文在三个 LLM 主干模型、六个数学基准和两个代码基准上评估 SAEPO。相比匹配基线，数学和代码基准平均分别最高提升 6.63% 和 5.57%；在 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 上训练曲线显示早期准确率增长更快。

Insight: 主要创新是用预训练 SAE 的无监督概念表示进行 token 级信用分配，例如惩罚错误的“最终答案”token、奖励正确的“推理过程”token，并将其作为通用的 advantage-shaping 插件接入不同策略优化目标。客观来看，可借鉴点在于把可解释的 SAE 特征用于细粒度奖励/优势塑造，从而缓解结果监督信号过于稀疏的问题。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated strong performance in improving large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet its credit-assignment signal remains coarse. Outcome verifiers provide scalable supervision by judging whether a completed response is correct, but they do not directly indicate which intermediate reasoning tokens contribute to success or failure. As a result, policy optimization can be inefficient, especially when training base models directly from sparse outcome feedback. In this paper, we introduce SAEPO, a Sparse AutoEncoder-guided token-level credit assignment method for outcome-supervised Policy Optimization. Rather than treating correctness only as a rollout-level (sequence-level) signal, SAEPO uses a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to build token-level semantic representations within reasoning trajectories; it scores each token based on the SAE concepts (e.g., penalizing wrong “final-answer” tokens but rewarding correct “reasoning-process” tokens), learned in an unsupervised manner, to achieve fine-grained credit assignment. SAEPO is a plug-in advantage-shaping module compatible with various policy optimization algorithms. We instantiate SAEPO with both GRPO and GSPO, covering token-ratio and sequence-ratio policy-gradient objectives, and evaluate SAEPO across three LLM backbones on six math and two code benchmarks. Empirical results show that SAEPO improves both the math and code benchmark averages over the matched baselines, with gains of up to 6.63% and 5.57%, respectively. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base, training curves also show faster early accuracy growth. Feature and token-level analyses suggest that the SAE-derived signal favors question-relevant concepts and reasoning tokens.

[311] CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Xiaoqian Hu, Ruihong Qiu, Yanran Tang, Sen Wang

TL;DR: 论文提出 CARE-3D，一个面向情境化 3D 场景的强化后训练框架，用于训练具身智能体自适应地决定需要接地哪些对象、调用哪个工具，以及如何评估返回证据对答案的支持。方法先用 SFT 建立有效工具交互，再冻结 3D 接地模块并用 GRPO 优化智能体，同时引入证据反事实归因和组覆盖采样。

Details

Motivation: 现有方法多从监督轨迹中模仿固定的证据获取模式，而没有直接优化返回证据对正确答案的支持；仅用结果奖励也难以对中间工具选择进行细粒度信用分配，并可能导致低频工具探索不足。

Result: 在 MSQA 和 Beacon3D 上，CARE-3D 相比仅使用答案与格式奖励的 SFT 和 GRPO 取得一致提升，尤其在空间推理和接地答案一致性方面表现更好。

Insight: 创新点在于用返回证据的反事实归因实现证据敏感的中间信用分配，并用组覆盖采样保持工具覆盖；客观看，其将证据效用评估与强化学习信用分配结合，提升了 3D 接地推理中工具选择与证据使用的自适应性。

Abstract: Situated 3D reasoning requires embodied agents to interpret objects, scene geometry, and viewpoint dependent spatial relations. Existing methods learn grounded interactions from supervised traces, but largely imitate prescribed evidence acquisition patterns rather than optimizing the support that the returned evidence provides for the correct answer. Moreover, outcome rewards provide limited credit for intermediate tool choices and may leave infrequent tools underexplored. An effective agent should instead adaptively decide what to ground, which tool to invoke, and how to assess the utility of returned evidence. To this end, this paper presents CARE-3D, a reinforcement post-training framework for adaptive grounded reasoning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on grounding instructions first establishes valid interactions, after which Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimizes the agent while keeping the 3D grounding module frozen. CARE-3D combines Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence for evidence sensitive credit assignment, and Group Coverage Sampling to preserve tool coverage. Experiments on MSQA and Beacon3D show consistent gains over SFT and GRPO using only answer and format rewards, especially in spatial reasoning and grounding answer coherence. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/xiaoqian-UQ/CARE-3D}{CARE-3D}.

[312] When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Ziqing Ge

TL;DR: 论文重新审视将长文本渲染为图像的光学上下文压缩在推理型VLM中的真实成本，指出仅统计prefill token不完整：图像输入会显著增加decode长度（1.5-3.5倍），并在5个模型和2个长上下文benchmark上给出成本核算与收益判据。作者进一步提出无需训练的image-first策略，在部分模型上降低账单6-14%，精度损失0.3-1.2个百分点。

Details

Motivation: 已有评估常认为图像化长文本减少输入token就能省钱，但推理模型的输出/decode成本可能主导总成本，因此需要分析光学压缩在何时真正划算。

Result: 四个通用VLM的decode长度增长1.5-3.5倍；在QuALITY上按典型输出定价，5个模型中有2个使用图像输入反而比文本更贵。所提启发式在Kimi-K3和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上降低费用6-14%，精度下降0.3-1.2个百分点；在QuALITY上设置推理预算更有效。

Insight: 创新点在于decode-aware的端到端成本建模与交换率判据(1-1/c)/(r-1)，说明压缩收益取决于输入/输出价格加权比而非单纯压缩率，并指出中等压缩下的信息损失不足以解释decode tax。客观看，其价值是把光学压缩从prefill节省分析扩展到推理成本与部署策略分析。

Abstract: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen’s OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload’s price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input’s prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.

[313] WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Binhui Xie, Jinmin Li, Haomiao Tang, Guangting Wang, Song Jin

TL;DR: 论文提出 WeMM-Ecom 多模态大模型家族，覆盖 0.8B 稠密模型到 35B MoE（3B 激活参数），面向微信电商场景并兼顾通用能力。其训练流程包括渐进提升电商数据比例的两阶段继续预训练，以及结合 on-policy 蒸馏与强化学习的 hybrid-thinking 后训练，支持非思考与思考模式。论文构建 28 个电商 benchmark 和 64 个通用 benchmark 进行评估，并已将模型用于微信多个生产场景。

Details

Motivation: 通用多模态大模型在电商内容理解上专业能力不足，而实际业务需要覆盖多尺寸、兼顾通用性能与高效部署的领域专用模型。论文旨在构建面向微信电商的多模态模型家族，并系统评测其电商与通用能力。

Result: 在 28 个电商 benchmark 上，WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B 超过更大的开源旗舰模型 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next、HY4 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash；在 64 个通用 benchmark 上，各尺寸模型均超过同规模 Qwen3.5，轻量版优于 Qwen3.5-2B、MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B 和 LFM3-VL-2B。模型已服务微信数百个生产用例，日请求达十亿级。

Insight: 创新点在于渐进提升电商数据比例的两阶段继续预训练、结合 on-policy 蒸馏与强化学习的 hybrid-thinking 后训练，以及覆盖 8 类业务场景的 28 个电商 benchmark 体系。客观来看，领域数据配比、训练 recipe 与评测构建是主要可借鉴之处。

Abstract: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom.

[314] Unpacking the Evaluators: How Configuration Shapes the Evaluation of Alignment in Explainable AI cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Gizem Karagoz, Tanir Ozcelebi, Nirvana Meratnia

TL;DR: 论文系统分析了可解释AI（XAI）中基于对齐的评估方法如何受到评估配置选择的影响。作者将对齐评估形式化为一个结构化配置空间，并构建框架，在2D/3D合成与真实数据集上建模XAI方法、真实标注表示、指标族、软/硬指标形式及阈值策略之间的交互；同时提出基于局部熵和边界质量比的XAI输出行为分类法。实验表明，对齐评估结果会随配置系统性变化，不能被视为固定不变的解释质量度量。

Details

Motivation: XAI评估本应以人为中心，但专家人工验证难以扩展，因此基于归因图与预定义真实标注表示对齐的指标被广泛使用。然而，这类评估隐含偏向真实标注表示、指标族、软/硬指标形式及阈值策略等设计选择，论文旨在系统揭示这些配置对评估结论的影响。

Result: 实验覆盖2D和3D合成及真实数据集，发现不同XAI-真实标注-指标三元配置会呈现系统性差异，例如软/硬指标实现下对齐结果表现出不同行为模式；不同指标族与归因结构对阈值敏感性也不同。摘要未报告具体数值或SOTA比较，主要贡献是配置敏感性分析与评估协议建议。

Insight: 创新点在于将对齐评估形式化为结构化配置空间，并系统建模多类评估设计因素的交互；同时提出基于局部熵和边界质量比的XAI输出行为分类法，用于结构化刻画归因模式。客观看，论文并非提出新的XAI方法，而是强调评估协议本身的可变性，为设计更可靠、行为感知的XAI评估流程提供方法论。

Abstract: Explainable AI (XAI) evaluation fundamentally requires human-centered evaluation, assessing whether explanations align with human reasoning and expert knowledge. However, such evaluations often require expert-driven manual validation and are difficult to scale, leading to the widespread use of alignment-based metrics, where attribution maps are compared against predefined ground-truth (GT) representations. Despite their popularity, alignment evaluations are implicitly bias towards multiple design choices made during the evaluation process, for example GT representations, metric families, metric formulations (soft vs. hard), and thresholding strategies. In this paper, we formalize alignment evaluation as a structured evaluation configuration space through which the influence of these design choices can be systematically analyzed. We further introduce a structured alignment evaluation framework that models interactions between XAI methods, GT representations, metric families, metric formulations, and thresholding strategies across 2D and 3D synthetic and real-world datasets. In addition, we propose a novel taxonomy of XAI output behavior based on local entropy and boundary mass ratio, enabling structured characterization of attribution patterns for alignment evaluation. Our experiments reveal systematic flows (triples of XAI-GT-metric configurations), showing that alignment outcomes provide distinct behavior patterns under certain configurations, such as soft/hard metric implementations. We further observe varying levels of threshold sensitivity across metric families and attribution structures. These findings demonstrate that alignment evaluation cannot be treated as a fixed or invariant measure of explanation quality, and provide practical guidance for designing more reliable and behavior-aware XAI evaluation protocols.

[315] What Quality Engineers Need to Know About Generative AI: Structured Data Extraction cs.CE | cs.CLPDF

Fadel M. Megahed, Ying-Ju Chen, Yamin Dahwich, Zhao-Wei Chen, Lucas K. Hung

TL;DR: 本文是一篇说明性论文，介绍质量工程师如何利用大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）进行结构化数据提取。论文阐述相关概念，从测量系统视角讨论结构化抽取，并给出 R 与 Python 实现，还展示了两个免费网页应用：从汽车召回通知中抽取信息，以及监控 arXiv 上的质量工程研究。作者通过人工评估验证抽取准确性，并公开应用及源码供读者适配。

Details

Motivation: 论文关注质量工程师在实际工作中如何理解和应用生成式 AI 进行结构化数据提取，并解决 AI 抽取结果需要可靠验证的问题。

Result: 在汽车召回通知应用中，4 名评审对 30 份通知、2 个模型的 720 个字段级评分中 98.6% 被评为完全正确；在 arXiv 论文应用中，21 名作者评估 45 篇论文，摘要大多被评为基本正确或正确，但部分分类字段和数学表达式仍存在问题。

Insight: 论文的创新点主要在于面向质量工程场景的系统性教程与实践演示，提出从测量系统视角理解结构化抽取，并提供可复现的 R/Python 实现、两个公开 Web 应用及人工验证流程；客观上看，其贡献更偏向应用落地与方法推广，而非新模型或新算法。

Abstract: In this expository paper, we explain how quality engineers can use large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) for structured data extraction. We introduce the relevant concepts, discuss structured extraction from a measurement-system perspective, and demonstrate its implementation in R and Python. We then present two freely available web-based applications (apps): (a) extracting information from automotive recall notices and (b) monitoring quality engineering research on arXiv. To ensure the accuracy of our AI-driven structured extraction, human evaluators validated the results. In the first app, four reviewers assessed information extracted from 30 recall notices using two models, with 98.6% of the 720 field-level ratings judged fully correct. In the second app, 21 authors evaluated information extracted from 45 of their arXiv papers. All paper summaries were rated mostly correct or correct, although the evaluations identified problems with some classification fields and mathematical expressions. These results demonstrate the practical potential of structured data extraction while emphasizing the need to validate the extracted information. We make both apps and their source code publicly available so that readers can adapt the approach to their own applications.

[316] Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming cs.CR | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Chris Tava

TL;DR: 论文复现并验证了自适应LLM红队中攻击者多样性下降的现象：使用Qwen2.5-14B攻击者和Phi-4-mini防御者进行GRPO/DPO协同训练，攻击成功率提升的同时攻击多样性收窄。作者在26个AdvBench行为上评估，提出用ADR比较训练前后攻击分布，并设定ADR低于0.75且攻击仍有效作为多样性降低判据。

Details

Motivation: 自动红队通过强化学习可提高攻击成功率，但可能使攻击向量变窄、多样性下降；已有报道指出GRPO协同训练攻击者与防御者会减少攻击多样性，本文旨在复现并量化这一现象。

Result: 三次运行在24次攻击者、12次防御者LoRA更新后，ADR分别为0.63、0.61、0.63，均在第12轮满足低于0.75且含95%置信区间的判据，而第4、8轮未达标；在26个AdvBench行为上，攻击多样性降低的同时攻击成功率仍随攻击者更新继续提升。

Insight: 论文的主要贡献在于对GRPO协同红队中攻击多样性收窄进行可复现的实证验证，并使用ADR指标及“多样性降低但攻击仍有效”的判据进行量化；客观上看，这更像是系统复现与评估指标应用，而非全新算法创新，但为红队训练中成功率和多样性的权衡提供了可操作度量。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning can make automated red-teaming more successful while narrowing the attacks it produces. Co-training an attacker and a defender with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been reported to reduce attacker diversity. This experiment reproduces attack diversity reduction using three runs with a Qwen2.5-14B attacker and a Phi-4-mini defender trained by direct preference optimization (DPO). The attacker receives a success-only reward and uses a length-unbiased loss, bounded updates, warm-up and ratio clipping. The attacker is evaluated on 26 AdvBench behaviors. Training ended after 12 rounds, following a decision based on development checkpoints, so the reported intervals are nominal. Attack Diversity Retention (ADR) compares the within-behavior of the trained attacker spread with the untrained attacker. In order for an attack diversity to be consider as having been reduced, a criterion requires the ADR to be below a 0.75 target with a 95% confidence interval together with continued attacker effectiveness. Therefore, if an attacker narrows its attack vector by 25% consistently its considered less diverse. After 24 attacker and 12 defender LORA-based updates, ADR for the three runs were 0.63, 0.61 and 0.63, respectively. Each run met the criterion at round 12; the earlier checks at rounds 4 and 8 fell short. Despite attacks being less diverse, attack success continued to improve as the attacker was updated after each training run.

[317] Lightweight Spectral Subspace Filtering for Trojan-Resilient AI Inference Engines cs.CR | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Soumita Chatterjee, Sudip Ghosh, Tamal Ghosh, Bhargab B. Bhattacharya, Hafizur Rahaman

TL;DR: 论文提出一种无需训练的轻量级谱子空间过滤框架，用于检测和抑制深度神经网络中的多触发后门攻击。该方法利用良性与恶意特征分布的几何分离，通过SVD识别主导恶意子空间，并在推理时对激活进行投影清洗，无需模型重训练。在CNN和Transformer架构上实验表明，该方法将攻击成功率从94.2-99.8%降至平均2.07%，同时保持干净准确率高达98.54%，且推理开销低。

Details

Motivation: 后门攻击对AI推理引擎构成严重安全威胁，尤其是多触发后门攻击因其效果分布且隐蔽而难以检测和缓解。现有防御方法可能需要重训练或计算开销大，因此论文旨在提出一种轻量、无需重训练的运行时防御框架。

Result: 在AlexNet、ResNet18、VGG16、MobileNetV2和ViT等架构上评估，所提方法将攻击成功率（ASR）从94.2-99.8%降低至平均2.07%，干净准确率保持在最高98.54%，且推理开销低。方法对不同的中毒率和多个并发触发器均表现出鲁棒性。

Insight: 论文的创新点在于：1）提出无需训练的谱子空间过滤框架，利用SVD识别恶意特征子空间；2）通过推理时激活投影实现后门抑制，仅需少量离线收集的触发样本；3）方法轻量且适用于多种架构，对多触发后门攻击有效。客观分析，其创新在于将谱分析方法与特征子空间投影结合用于后门防御，避免了重训练成本，并针对多触发场景提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a significant security threat to deep neural networks (DNNs) deployed on AI inference engines and hardware accelerators. By embedding hidden triggers during training, these attacks induce malicious behavior while maintaining high accuracy on benign inputs. Multi-trigger backdoor attacks are particularly challenging to detect and mitigate because of the distributed and stealthy nature of their effects. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a training-free Spectral Subspace Filtering framework that detects and suppresses backdoor-induced activations by analyzing latent feature representations. Exploiting the geometric separation between benign and malicious feature distributions, the framework employs Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to identify the dominant malicious subspace and performs inference-time spectral scrubbing through activation projection. This approach suppresses backdoor effects without model retraining, requiring only a small set of triggered samples collected offline. Experimental evaluation across CNN and transformer architectures, including AlexNet, ResNet18, VGG16, MobileNetV2, and Vision Transformer (ViT), demonstrates that the proposed method reduces the attack success rate (ASR) from 94.2-99.8% to an average of 2.07%, while preserving clean accuracy of up to 98.54% with low inference overhead. The framework also demonstrates robustness across varying poisoning rates and multiple concurrent triggers, highlighting its potential as a lightweight runtime defense for enhancing the security and reliability of AI inference engines against backdoor attacks.

[318] Mind the Trap As LLMs Guess the Data Model: Grain-Aware Guards Against Fan-out in Text-to-SQL and Its Benchmarks cs.DB | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Ahmed M. Mahran

TL;DR: 论文研究LLM驱动的Text-to-SQL系统在一对多/多对多连接后聚合时产生的fan-out重复计数问题：连接使实体行重复，SUM/COUNT会多计且仍返回看似合理的数值。作者用一个依赖度量粒度和连接键重复行数的条件来刻画该错误，审计发现BIRD开发集4.2%的gold答案存在失真，并发布BIRD-FanOut与GrainTraps基准。进一步提出grain-aware函数依赖作为防护，在八个LLM agent上降低BIRD中的fan-out错误率。

Details

Motivation: Text-to-SQL中LLM常生成涉及一对多或多对多连接的聚合查询，fan-out会导致计数/求和重复但结果表面合理，现有schema和普通统计难以发现。论文旨在形式化识别这种陷阱，并让模型和基准评测显式考虑数据粒度。

Result: 审计发现BIRD开发集4.2%问题存在失真gold；BIRD后续修订改变了44%被审计标记为确定fan-out的答案，而未标记答案为16%。在八个LLM agent上，grain-aware FDs将BIRD的fan-out错误从18.4% runs降至约13%，且在held-out问题上有效；但整体准确率提升较小，因为剩余错误多非fan-out，且BIRD提示常引导过度计数。

Insight: 创新点在于用数据上的条件刻画fan-out、审计并修正Text-to-SQL benchmark的gold答案、发布BIRD-FanOut和GrainTraps，以及提出包含度量粒度和每键重复信息的grain-aware FDs防护。客观看，其价值在于把schema未显式表达的grain与连接重复性引入Text-to-SQL评测和模型防护，并强调benchmark gold需在真实数据上审计。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems built on large language models (LLMs) often aggregate over one-to-many and many-to-many joins, a classic trap: when the joined rows repeat an entity, a SUM or COUNT counts it more than once, yet the query runs and returns a plausible number. We characterize these fan-out errors by one condition on the relation an aggregate reads, which depends on two facts a schema does not show: each measure’s grain, and how many rows a join on each key repeats. An audit that tests the condition on the data finds distorted gold answers for 4.2% of the dev questions of BIRD, a widely used benchmark, and BIRD’s later, independent revision changed 44% of the answers the audit flags as definite fan-out, against 16% of unflagged ones. We release BIRD-FanOut, 486 BIRD questions with reviewed gold, and GrainTraps, synthetic questions that set this trap and related ones. Across eight LLM agents, functional dependencies (FDs) computed from the data help no more than per-column statistics on GrainTraps, but grain-aware FDs, which also state each measure’s grain and the repetition per key, cut fan-out errors on BIRD from 18.4% of runs to about 13%, also on held-out questions and without LLM judges. Accuracy rises less, because most remaining errors are not fan-out and BIRD’s hints often prescribe the over-count. Text-to-SQL models should be given the grain of the data, and benchmark gold should be audited on the data. Code, data and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/ahmed-mahran/misqal

Vagner Inácio de Oliveira, Paula Dornhofer Paro Costa

TL;DR: 论文提出CHICO，一个源自Europeana的多模态文化遗产数据集，整合精选目录字段、图像和上下文信息，并保留原始记录，用于证据支撑的描述生成，也可支持多模态检索、元数据丰富和基于证据的评估。

Details

Motivation: 文化遗产聚合器的目录记录常存在稀疏、异构元数据，且媒体链接可能无法访问图像；需要结构化和验证这些资源，以支持可复现的多模态AI研究。

Result: 构建了包含超过60,000条文化遗产记录及关联图像的CHICO数据集，保留原始Europeana记录；摘要未提及具体benchmark或SOTA结果。

Insight: 创新点在于桥接稀疏元数据与多模态证据，构建带原始记录、精选字段、图像和上下文的数据集，支持证据基础的描述生成与评估，并拓展至检索和元数据丰富等任务。

Abstract: Cultural heritage aggregators provide access to millions of digitized items. Yet their catalog records often contain sparse, heterogeneous metadata, with associated media links that may not lead to accessible images. Structuring and validating these resources for multimodal AI research can support reproducible experimentation. To this end, we present CHICO (Cultural Heritage Images and Catalog Objects), a multimodal dataset derived from Europeana that brings together curated catalog fields, images, and contextual information to support evidence-grounded description generation while retaining the original Europeana records. It comprises more than 60,000 cultural heritage records with associated images. Although originally developed for that purpose, it can also support multimodal information retrieval, metadata enrichment, and evidence-based evaluation.

[320] Learning the Next Best Move with Visual Diffusion Models cs.GR | cs.CVPDF

Amir Razlighi, Ali Mahdavi Amiri, Yiorgos Chrysanthou, Andrey Voynov, Daniel Cohen-Or

TL;DR: 论文提出视觉扩散模型可通过在视觉状态-下一步最佳移动（NBM）对上微调，直接在当前状态图像空间中预测下一步动作，无需显式符号表示或推理时搜索。重复进行NBM预测即可逐步构建序列问题的解。

Details

Motivation: 针对需要序列推理和前瞻的任务，避免推理时显式探索未来步骤或穷举搜索，直接学习预测依赖多步后果的最佳动作。

Result: 在象棋谜题和瓦片路径规划上验证，并扩展到四子棋、围棋和台球；象棋中预测合法走法并找到最佳走法远超回忆相似训练位置，包括需后续战术才能体现收益的弃子；路径规划能构造均匀成本地图最短路和不同通行成本地形上的成本最优路线，且无需数值成本监督。

Insight: 创新在于用预训练视觉扩散模型在图像空间直接预测NBM，以重复预测替代显式搜索，并隐式从示例中学习多步代价，支持全局性决策和序列问题求解。

Abstract: In this paper, we show that visual diffusion models can learn to predict the next best move (NBM) in tasks requiring sequential reasoning and lookahead, without explicitly exploring future steps or exhaustive searching at inference. Previous work demonstrated that these models can generate complete solutions to geometric and reasoning problems. Here, we show that simple fine-tuning on visual state–NBM pairs enables a pretrained model to select actions whose value depends on consequences several steps ahead. Each move is predicted directly in image space from the current state, without an explicit symbolic representation or search procedure. Repeated NBM predictions then construct a solution one decision at a time. We demonstrate this capability on chess puzzles and tile-based pathfinding, and show that it extends to Connect Four, Go and billiards. In chess, the model predicts legal moves and finds the best move far more often than by recalling similar training positions, including piece sacrifices whose benefit emerges only through later tactical continuations. In pathfinding, it constructs shortest paths on uniform-cost maps and cost-optimal routes across terrain tiles with different traversal costs, choosing longer routes when they are cheaper overall. These costs are learned implicitly from examples, without numerical cost supervision. These results show that direct visual move prediction can support globally informed decisions and successful sequential problem solving.

[321] Participant-Independent Validation of Smartphone Video and Wearable Inertial Sensing for Coach-Rated Running-Form Classification cs.HC | cs.CVPDF

Kian Lee, Eric Zhou

TL;DR: 论文评估了一个低成本跑步姿态分类流程：用侧视角智能手机视频结合可穿戴IMU加速度，对教练评定的四类跑步姿态线索进行分类。作者在20名跑者、294条记录和1555个窗口上做参与者独立验证，发现仅视频的LightGBM宏平均F1为0.310，高于多数类基线0.168；加入IMU后降至0.267。进一步多模型鲁棒性分析表明，视频-only通常优于基线，但IMU融合收益依赖验证设计、模型族和目标类别，简单特征级融合不能可靠泛化到未见跑者。

Details

Motivation: 论文关注自动化跑步姿态评估，希望让技术反馈在专业教练和实验室环境之外更可及，并检验低成本手机视频与可穿戴IMU融合是否能在未见跑者上稳定分类教练评定的跑步姿态。

Result: 在自建数据集上，视频-only LightGBM取得宏平均F1 0.310，高于多数类基线0.168；加入IMU特征后宏平均F1降至0.267，配对平均差为-0.043。多模型分析中，视频-only多数高于基线，但融合效果因模型族而异：Linear SVM略正、Logistic Regression约中性、树模型下降，整体性能仍较有限。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点在于低成本手机视频+IMU管道、参与者独立验证和记录级聚合。客观看，其更重要的贡献是系统揭示IMU融合的“表观增益”强烈依赖验证设计、模型族和目标类别，并强调跑者留出评估的必要性；这提示简单特征级融合容易高估泛化能力，后续应重视参与者独立评估和更稳健的融合策略。

Abstract: Automated running-form assessment could make technique feedback more accessible outside professional coaching and laboratory settings. We evaluated a low-cost pipeline combining side-view smartphone video with wearable inertial measurement unit (IMU) acceleration for coach-rated running-form classification. The dataset comprised 294 labeled recordings from 20 runners and 1,555 windows across four cues: landing position, suspension, triple extension, and upper-body posture. The primary analysis used 100 repeated four-runner holdout splits, recording-level aggregation of window predictions, and LightGBM models with hyperparameters fixed from prior modality-specific searches. Video-only LightGBM achieved mean macro F1 of 0.310, versus 0.168 for a majority-class baseline. Adding IMU features reduced macro F1 to 0.267, a paired mean difference of -0.043. Robustness analysis with Logistic Regression, Linear SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM found that video-only models had higher mean performance than the majority baseline, whereas fusion effects depended on model family: Linear SVM showed a small positive effect, Logistic Regression was approximately neutral, and tree-based models showed lower performance with fusion. These results indicate a modest participant-independent signal in smartphone pose features. However, apparent IMU-fusion gains depended strongly on validation design, model family, and target category. The gap between recording-level and participant-independent performance underscores the need for runner-holdout evaluation and suggests that simple feature-level fusion does not reliably generalize to unseen runners.

[322] Social-Qwen: From Individual Nonverbal Cues and Emotion to Multiparty Social Dynamics Understanding with Instruction Tuning cs.HC | cs.CVPDF

The Tung Nguyen, Jouh Yeong Chew

TL;DR: 论文提出 Social-Qwen，一个两阶段框架：先分析多方场景中每个参与者的非语言线索和情绪，再通过指令微调表示推断群体级社会动态（如群体参与度）。为缓解群体数据中个体标注稀缺，采用知识蒸馏传递监督信号。实验表明其在群体参与度分析上优于端到端基线并达到 SOTA，并具备向多活动场景和其他社会动态估计的泛化能力。

Details

Motivation: 多方场景中的机器人需要理解群体级社会动态，但个体非语言线索、情绪状态与交互上下文交织使问题复杂；现有端到端模型和大型视觉语言模型在实时性、数据与个体标注稀缺方面受限。论文假设显式建模个体级状态是实现准确群体级理解的关键。

Result: 在 OUC-CGE 数据集上，Social-Qwen 显著优于先前端到端基线，并在群体参与度分析上达到 SOTA；在涵盖多种社会活动的内部数据集上验证泛化性，并在群体和谐等其他社会动态估计上表现一致。

Insight: 创新点在于将个体非语言线索与情绪分析作为显式中间表示，结合两阶段指令微调实现群体社会动态推理，并用知识蒸馏缓解群体数据缺乏个体标注的问题；客观上看，其可借鉴之处是将个体状态建模与轻量指令调优表示结合，以兼顾可解释性、标注效率和实时社会智能潜力。

Abstract: Effective participation in multiparty scenarios requires robots to move beyond individual toward understanding group-level social dynamics, which are inherently complex due to the interplay of nonverbal cues, internal states, and interaction context. Existing approaches often rely on end-to-end deterministic models, while recent state-of-the-art methods such as large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) address this issue to some extent but remain limited by their size and computational cost for real-time applications. Moreover, both approaches are constrained by the scarcity of multiparty interaction data and annotations, which describe how individual nonverbal cues and emotional states contribute to social dynamics which describe collective outcomes such as group engagement. We hypothesize that explicitly modeling individual-level states is essential for accurate group-level understanding. To this end, we present Social-Qwen, a two-stage framework that first analyzes each participant’s nonverbal cues and emotions, then infers group-level engagement using instruction-tuned representations. To mitigate the lack of individual annotations in group datasets, we employ knowledge distillation to transfer supervision signals. Experiments on the OUC-CGE dataset show that Social-Qwen significantly outperforms prior end-to-end baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance in group engagement analysis, demonstrating the promise of instruction tuning for scalable social intelligence in robots. We further evaluate robustness by testing generalization to (1) an in-house dataset spanning multiple social activities and (2) estimating other social dynamics such as group harmony. Results suggest consistent performance, highlighting Social-Qwen as a promising approach toward real-time social intelligence for intelligent agents.

[323] Constellations of Colour: Mapping Semantic Neighbourhoods in CLIP cs.HC | cs.CVPDF

Matt DesLauriers

TL;DR: 论文以CLIP视觉语言模型为对象，将2500个命名颜色通过文本编码器嵌入并投影到二维地图，再用阈值最小生成树连接形成“星座”式颜色语义图。该图展示颜色在色相、明度、彩度等感知轴上的梯度，以及植物、虚构引用、食物等语义邻域，旨在为设计师提供可解释的、按语义关联探索颜色和构建调色板的工具。

Details

Motivation: 论文关注视觉语言模型如何组织颜色语言的文化与感知维度，并希望把基础模型中的颜色语义结构转化为设计师可理解、可操作的可视化工具。

Result: 摘要未报告定量基准或SOTA结果，主要呈现定性可视化发现：颜色语义图沿色相、明度、彩度等熟悉轴呈现梯度，并形成植物语言、虚构引用和食物等语义邻域。

Insight: 创新点在于采用研究型设计可视化方法，将CLIP文本嵌入、二维投影和阈值最小生成树结合为“颜色星座”图，把颜色语义关系转化为可导航的调色板设计界面，强调基础模型面向艺术创作者的可解释应用。

Abstract: How do vision-language models organise the cultural and perceptual dimensions of colour language? This pictorial presents a research-through-design visualisation of colour semantics in CLIP, a pretrained vision-language model. A dataset of 2,500 named colours is embedded with CLIP’s text encoder, projected to a 2D map, and connected via a thresholded minimum spanning tree to create disjoint “constellations” of related colour terms. The resulting maps offer a model for navigating the semantic and perceptual relationships between colour terms. The visualisations reveal gradients along familiar axes (hue, lightness, chroma), as well as semantic neighbourhoods, including botanical language (hyacinth, cornflower, tulip), fictional references (“Robin Hood green”, “warlock purple”), and food (butterscotch, toast, toffee). These visualisations give designers and creatives a map for exploring colour linguistically and building palettes by semantic association, pointing towards interpretable, artist-facing colour tools derived from foundation models.

[324] Psychological State Monitoring Methods Based on Multimodal Emotion Recognition cs.HC | cs.CVPDF

Ran Meng

TL;DR: 论文提出一种基于多模态情感识别的心理状态监测方法，构建分层框架，在时间与空间维度融合面部图像、语音信号及其他生理指标。系统同步采集摄像头、麦克风和可穿戴传感器数据，分别预处理和特征提取后，采用结合早期融合与晚期融合的高端融合架构实现跨模态信息鲁棒整合。实验在真实压力响应数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

Details

Motivation: 针对基于计算机的多模态情感识别系统在心理状态监测中准确性和可靠性不足的问题，论文希望更完整地分析人类情绪，并为智能心理健康评估和人本系统设计提供方法支撑。

Result: 在真实压力响应数据集上，融合多模态系统整体识别准确率约91%，平均F1约0.88，优于最佳单模态方法（面部准确率88%、F1 0.88）；时间分析显示不同群体压力跟踪适应性不均，消融实验确定了关键模块对系统稳定性的贡献。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点在于分层时空融合面部、语音和生理指标，并采用早期融合与晚期融合结合的高端融合架构提升跨模态鲁棒性。客观来看，其可借鉴之处是将多源异构情感信号按模态分别处理后再进行时空层级融合，并在真实压力数据上结合多指标评估与消融分析验证工程可行性。

Abstract: The computer-Based Multimodal Emotion Recognition System needs to increase the accuracy and reliability of psychological state monitoring. A hierarchical framework was proposed in this paper to integrate facial images, speech signals and other physiological indicators of emotion in time and space for more complete analysis of human emotions. Synchronously sample data streams from webcams, microphones and wearable sensors, and then preprocess and extract features specific to each type of data. A high-end fusion architecture is adopted to combine early- and late-fusion methods and thus robustly integrate cross-modal information. Experimental validation in a real-world stress-response dataset showed good performance. The overall recognition accuracy and mean F1-score of the fused multimodal system are both about 91% and 0.88, respectively, which are superior to the best unimodal approach (face, 88% accuracy and F1-score 0.88). Temporal analysis shows that the groups for stress tracking are not uniformly adapted and resilient, and ablation experiments have determined which modules contribute significantly to the stability of the system. According to all kinds of quantitative evaluations of precision, recall, accuracy and F1 scores, the proposed method shows good balance and is practical and generally applicable. The research has provided an engineering-feasible, data-driven solution for precise emotion inference and offered methodological support for intelligent mental health assessment and human-centered system design.

[325] Beyond Code and Pixels: Co-Generating Editable and Visually Rich Presentations cs.HC | cs.CV | cs.MMPDF

TL;DR: 论文提出SlidesWeaver，一个混合多智能体系统，用于生成可编辑且视觉丰富的PPTX演示文稿。它通过共享的deck和slide级状态协调语言与视觉智能体，结合分阶段多模态承诺、基于扩散的构图规划以及两种生成调度，以平衡构图自由和文本准确保留，同时保持原生文本与几何结构。

Details

Motivation: PPTX生成需要语义规划、视觉构图、精确布局和可编辑性，但程序化方法可编辑却设计僵硬，图像方法视觉丰富却难以编辑；混合系统需协调内容、布局和外观的相互依赖决策。

Insight: 创新点在于混合多智能体系统通过共享状态协调语言与视觉智能体，采用分阶段多模态承诺、扩散式构图规划及两种生成调度来平衡构图自由与文本保留。客观看，其将程序化与图像生成优势结合，并以多智能体协作和调度策略缓解可编辑性与视觉丰富度的矛盾。

Abstract: Generating PPTX presentations is a structured task that requires semantic planning, visual composition, precise layout, and editability, motivating collaboration among specialized agents. However, programmatic methods offer editability but often produce rigid designs, while image-based methods provide visual richness but flatten content into difficult-to-edit pixels. A hybrid system can combine these strengths, but must coordinate interdependent decisions across content, layout, and appearance. To address this challenge, we propose SlidesWeaver, a hybrid multi-agent system that coordinates language and vision agents through shared deck- and slide-level states. Specifically, it uses staged multimodal commitment, diffusion-based composition planning, and two generation schedules for different priorities between composition freedom and accurate text preservation, while preserving native text and geometry. Across 1,728 generations spanning 24 system-model configurations, SlidesWeaver achieves consistently superior overall quality across all evaluated dimensions while maintaining structural control, editability, and practical generation efficiency.

[326] CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting cs.IR | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Ramraj Chandradevan, Sayontan Ghosh, Vinoth Selvendran

TL;DR: 论文提出 CO-GRAFT，一个与奖励无关的干预式归因框架，用于分析 RL 训练给大语言模型搜索智能体带来的准确率增益究竟来自哪些功能角色及其交互。该方法让 RL 后智能体与 RL 前初始化在闭环检索中共同生成轨迹，并通过角色级策略嫁接评估 16 种角色分配，再用 Shapley 值和 Möbius 交互项分解总增益。实验在 Search-R1、多种模型和数据集上发现查询生成贡献有限，增益主要受答案有效性、检索保留、模型规模和搜索预算等因素影响。

Details

Motivation: RL 可将搜索智能体的精确匹配提升最多 32 分，但总体准确率无法说明哪些底层功能能力在训练中改善或发生了交互，因此需要细粒度的因果归因方法。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5 和 Llama-3.2 多种规模、base/instruction-tuned 初始化、GRPO/PPO 优化器以及 NQ 和 HotpotQA 上，查询生成对总增益贡献从不超过 15%；增益主要受 RL 前答案有效性、搜索保留、模型规模和固定任务级搜索预算支配，较大或答案格式良好的检查点中信用从推理转向答案抽取，较小 base 模型则依赖推理-决策耦合。

Insight: 创新点在于用角色级策略嫁接实现无需改权重或重训练的干预式归因，并结合合作博弈 Shapley 值与 Möbius 交互项区分单角色改进和多角色耦合，从而更细粒度解释 RL 搜索智能体的能力来源。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M”obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning–decision coupling.

[327] Understanding and Mitigating the Fragility of Self-Rewarding Optimization cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Rongyi Zhu, Tanqiu Jiang, Fenglong Ma, Ting Wang

TL;DR: 论文研究自奖励优化（SRO）的脆弱性：训练提示的轻微扰动会污染自生成偏好信号并引发迭代崩溃；作者用重排序攻击和前导攻击验证该问题，提出自奖励保真度（SRF）作为诊断指标，发现SRF低于阈值时SRO会相变崩溃，并提出投影解耦防御来提升鲁棒性。

Details

Motivation: SRO可让语言模型自生成奖励信号以自我改进，但其成功或失败的条件尚不清楚；论文关注其脆弱性来源以及如何缓解。

Result: 摘要未给出具体benchmark和定量数值；实验表明两类提示级攻击可使SRO迭代崩溃，SRF可作为自监督可靠性诊断信号并呈现阈值相变，投影解耦防御在对抗条件下提升SRO鲁棒性。

Insight: 创新点在于揭示提示扰动即可破坏自奖励信号，提出SRF量化自评估与oracle奖励的on-policy一致性，并利用SRF相变分析和投影解耦抑制奖励生成器敏感方向上的更新。

Abstract: Self-rewarding optimization (SRO) promises to improve language models by enabling them to generate their own reward signals. Yet when and how SRO succeeds or fails remains poorly understood. We reveal that SRO is fundamentally fragile: even seemingly benign perturbations to training prompts can corrupt the self-generated preference signal and trigger iterative collapse. We demonstrate this through two prompt-level attacks that serve as controlled stress tests: a Re-Ranking attack that concentrates training on prompts where self-reward diverges from an oracle, and a Preamble attack that learns short prefixes inflating self-reward without any gain in oracle quality. To explain why these attacks succeed, we introduce self-reward fidelity (SRF), a metric quantifying on-policy agreement between self-evaluated and oracle rewards. We show that SRF can serve as a diagnostic signal of self-supervision reliability, and that controlled SRF perturbations induce a phase-transition region: SRO improves when SRF remains sufficiently high, but collapses once SRF drops below a model- and task-dependent threshold. This analysis motivates Projection Decoupling Defense, which suppresses SRO update components along directions to which the reward generator is locally sensitive, improving SRO robustness under adversarial conditions. This work sheds light on the fragility of SRO and charts promising directions toward making it more robust.

[328] Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Maohao Ran, Yanting Zhang, Chendong Ma, Jun Song

TL;DR: 论文系统研究了大型语言模型在科学计算中面对物理机制切换时的失效模式：当物理条件跨越不同区段（regime）时，模型常常不会判断公式是否仍然适用，因而把公式用在有效域之外，给出看似合理但在物理上错误的结果。作者在72种物理机制上做了受控实验，并评估了后训练能否提升模型对物理区段的感知推理能力。

Details

Motivation: 地球与环境科学中的许多问题包含多个物理区段，同一公式只在特定区段内成立；而现有LLM被越来越多地用于科学计算，却可能识别不到这些随区段变化的约束，从而误用公式。论文希望系统刻画并缓解这一失效。

Result: 前沿LLM频繁在有效域外误用公式，导致准确率下降13到57个百分点；使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能让Qwen3.5-9B在依赖物理区段的任务上追平284B的DeepSeek V4 Flash，但效果受基座模型已掌握的公式所限；少量带解题过程示例的监督微调（SFT）加上RL共提升61个百分点，而从提供正确公式的教师模型做蒸馏可把准确率从0%提升到71%。

Insight: 创新点在于把物理区段约束当作评估LLM科学推理的关键维度，并通过72种机制的受控实验量化“公式误用”这一失效；客观来看，论文还揭示了仅靠RLVR受限于基座模型的公式知识，而显式提供公式或示例（SFT、蒸馏）能显著补足这一短板，为科学计算场景下LLM的训练与提示设计提供了可借鉴的思路。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. LLMs may fail to recognize these regime-dependent constraints, applying formulas outside their domains of validity and producing plausible but physically incorrect results. We systematically investigate these failures through controlled experiments and assess whether post-training can improve regime-aware reasoning. Across 72 physical mechanisms, we find frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity, reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables Qwen3.5-9B to match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but its effectiveness is limited by the formulas available in the base model. Combining supervised fine-tuning on a few worked examples with reinforcement learning improves accuracy by 61 percentage points, while distillation from a teacher supplied with the correct formula raises accuracy from 0% to 71%.

[329] DoC: Learning to Defer or Commit for Timely, Accurate, and Stable Conversational Diagnosis Prediction cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Xueren Ge, Anthony Cortez, Homa Alemzadeh

TL;DR: 论文研究对话式诊断预测中模型应在何时给出诊断、何时继续收集信息的问题，提出两阶段框架DoC：先通过迭代式承诺边界估计自动构造Defer/诊断监督信号，再用Defer感知的监督微调初始化策略，并通过轨迹级强化学习优化及时性、首次承诺准确率和承诺后稳定性。方法在EMSDialog和MediTOD上能够更早给出诊断，并取得较好的首次承诺准确率与承诺后错误率表现。

Details

Motivation: 对话式诊断需要从持续进行的临床对话中尽早、准确且稳定地预测诊断，但对话级标签只说明最终诊断，不说明模型应在哪一时刻停止等待并提交诊断。论文旨在解决缺乏承诺时间标注时，如何学习“继续延迟收集信息”还是“立即提交诊断”的决策问题。

Result: 在EMSDialog和MediTOD两个数据集上，DoC能够较早提交诊断，在经后训练的方法中取得最高首次承诺准确率76.7%/51.2%，并取得整体最低的承诺后错误率16.4%/48.3%。

Insight: 创新点在于将对话诊断预测建模为Defer/Commit的时序决策问题，无需人工标注承诺时间即可构造监督信号，并用轨迹级强化学习同时优化及时性、首次承诺准确率和承诺后稳定性；这种自动边界估计加多目标奖励的策略对需要决定何时输出结果的交互式预测任务具有借鉴价值。

Abstract: Conversational diagnosis prediction requires accurate, early, and stable predictions from ongoing clinical dialogue, yet dialogue-level labels do not specify when to commit. We propose a two-phase framework for learning deferral and diagnosis decisions. First, iterative commitment-boundary estimation constructs Defer/diagnosis supervision without annotated commitment times. Second, Defer-aware supervised fine-tuning initializes a policy, refined through reinforcement learning with trajectory-level rewards for timeliness, first-commit accuracy, and post-commit stability. On EMSDialog and MediTOD, DoC commits early, achieving the highest first-commit accuracy among post-trained methods (76.7%/51.2%) and the lowest post-commit error overall (16.4%/48.3%).

Muhammad Ahtesham, Xin Zhong

Details

Motivation: 传统视觉表示几何度量是对称的，对同一路径的正向和反向运动赋予相同代价，难以刻画视觉过程的方向性。论文希望解决如何从无序/有序视觉轨迹中学习表示空间的方向几何，并区分真实方向结构与归一化伪影或简单收敛效应。

Abstract: Conventional geometric measures of visual representations are symmetric, assigning equal costs to forward and reverse motion along the same path. We propose DiRGeo, a framework for learning directional geometry over frozen visual representations. Grounded in Randers geometry, DiRGeo learns a state-dependent directional field from ordered image trajectories through self-supervised contrast, without semantic labels. Sphere-tangent correction and attractor-relative decomposition distinguish learned directional structure from normalization artifacts and common convergence. Experiments across 17 visual processes, three encoder families, and multiple representation depths demonstrate consistent directional discrimination and whole-path asymmetry beyond simple attractor-based explanations. The learned fields become increasingly process-specific in deeper representations, while natural-video experiments reveal event-dependent directional preferences. As functional validation, DiRGeo guides restoration selection. These results establish directional geometry as a useful complement to symmetric representation analysis.

TL;DR: 论文提出 VeriLogic，一种面向可验证逻辑推理轨迹的强化学习框架。它将逻辑推理分解为显式中间判断、证明和最终决策，并组织为“验证落地—结构化策略优化—验证器引导迭代精炼”的流程，从而利用过程级验证信号而非仅依赖最终答案进行学习。

Motivation: 现有方法主要依赖响应级结果信号，忽略了推理轨迹内部的异质正确性：正确答案可能包含无效推理，有效中间步骤也可能出现在错误回答中。论文旨在让内部逻辑推理过程可验证、可学习，并提供过程级监督。

Abstract: Logical reasoning derives conclusions from premises through explicit intermediate inference steps, providing a natural basis for process-level verification and supervision. However, existing learning methods often rely on response-level outcome signals, which overlook heterogeneous correctness within the reasoning trace: a correct answer may contain invalid reasoning, while valid intermediate steps may also appear in an incorrect response. To address this issue, we introduce Reinforcement Learning on Verifiable Logical Reasoning (VeriLogic), which turns internal reasoning traces into explicit and verifiable learning objects. Rather than treating a response as an indivisible learning unit, VeriLogic decomposes logical reasoning into explicit intermediate judgments, proofs, and final decisions, and organizes them into a unified “Grounding - Optimization - Refinement” pipeline: (1) Verification-Grounded Reasoning Environment Construction grounds logical reasoning into explicit intermediate states and formally checkable proof obligations, making the internal reasoning process accessible to verification and learning; (2) Logical Structured Policy Optimization learns from verifier feedback through complementary global and local rewards, jointly optimizing the overall reasoning outcome while providing targeted optimization signals to different intermediate reasoning paths; and (3) Verifier-Guided Iterative Refinement acts on verifier feedback by leveraging proof states and error messages to iteratively diagnose and repair failed reasoning. Experiments on six logical reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over strong baselines, with average improvements of 6.39% and 5.00% on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1. These results highlight the value of making logical reasoning traces verifiable, learnable, and refinable beyond final-answer supervision.

Abstract: AI coding agents generate, modify, and validate code through multi-turn interactions. Existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on sparse terminal rewards, making it difficult to assess how intermediate decisions affect task outcomes, and group-relative methods also require repeated sampling for each task. We propose Direct Feedback Policy Optimization (DFPO), a single-trajectory reinforcement learning algorithm that trains directly from a single trajectory. DFPO achieves higher task resolution rates than GSPO under matched base models and execution harnesses.

TL;DR: 论文研究推理模型在答案提议处的回溯行为与内部潜在置信度方向之间的关系。作者从答案提议后的口头置信度中提取线性置信度方向，发现该方向不仅能调节口头置信度，还能以与回溯样本直接提取方向相当的效果调节下一个token的回溯概率。进一步干预表明，从轨迹中段或生成开始持续施加该方向可双向控制响应长度和答案提议数量，并在较小准确率损失下缩短或延长推理轨迹。

Details

Motivation: 推理模型常产生冗长思维链并频繁回溯，即使已得到正确答案仍提出多个答案提议，导致大量可能“装饰性”的推理开销。论文希望从模型内部不确定性表征出发，判断模型在答案提议处会选择回溯还是提交答案。

Result: 在三个32B模型上，约87%的生成轨迹只包含一个唯一答案但平均仍有约8个答案提议。沿潜在置信度方向干预可双向调节响应长度约-1.3k至+2.5k tokens、答案提议数量约-4.18至+4.75，且准确率损失较小；从生成开始施加也能在可比准确率下缩短轨迹。摘要未提及具体benchmark。

Insight: 创新点在于将口头置信度与潜在置信度方向关联，并揭示该方向可因果性地影响回溯决策，而不只是置信度表达。客观看，其可借鉴之处是利用内部置信度方向作为轻量干预信号，在不显著牺牲准确率的情况下控制推理长度和回溯行为。

Abstract: Reasoning models deliberate over multiple answer proposals, often resulting in excessively long traces due to backtracking, even when the correct answer has already been reached (Across three 32B models, 87% of rollouts contain 1 unique answer yet still make ~8 answer proposals on average). Given this potentially “decorative” chain of thought (CoT) reasoning, can we look to the model internals to determine if the model will backtrack or commit to an answer proposal? Operating under the hypothesis that models maintain an internal representation of their uncertainty, we seek to extract this representation and characterize its relationship with backtracking behavior at answer proposals. By querying the model’s verbalized confidence following answer proposals throughout a response trace, we extract a linear direction for latent confidence that separates high and low verbalized confidence. This direction can steer verbalized confidence as expected, but it surprisingly can also steer the next token probability of backtracking, performing on par with a linear direction extracted directly from backtracking examples. We then test the direction under progressively more realistic interventions. Steering continuously from a mid-trace answer proposal modulates response length (-1.3k - ~+2.5k tokens) and the number of answer proposals (-4.18 - +4.75) in both directions, with minimal cost to accuracy. Applying the confidence direction from the start of generation, where proposal positions are unknown, still shortens traces at comparable accuracy, and its effect surfaces in the linguistic confidence of proposals. Overall, our study reveals the intricate interplay between a model’s internal confidence and its proclivity to backtrack or commit to an answer.

Ryo Kuroki, Amin Mansouri, Philippe Schwaller

TL;DR: 论文提出一个面向大语言模型智能体的诊断性基准与评估框架，用于封闭世界系统辨识中的假设驱动自适应实验规划，并在动力学机理识别任务上实例化。该框架不仅看最终准确率，还评估智能体在实验设计空间中的探索模式，并将推理过程分解为信念更新、假设判别、判别性实验设计和干预下预测推理四个可解释步骤分别打分。作者评测了十个LLM智能体，发现强智能体优于贝叶斯优化和拉丁超立方基线，但弱智能体在将假设识别转化为可执行实验设计和对比预测时存在明显瓶颈。

Motivation: 现有对LLM智能体科学任务的评估通常只看最终任务准确率，掩盖了推理在何处成功或失败。论文希望超越准确率，诊断智能体在假设驱动实验规划中如何探索、更新信念、判别假设并设计判别性实验。

Result: 在十个LLM智能体上，较强智能体不仅超过自适应贝叶斯优化和非自适应拉丁超立方基线，还表现出不同于简单启发式的探索模式。推理分解显示强智能体在四个步骤上均稳定较好，而弱智能体常能完成信念更新和假设判别，却难以转化为可执行设计和尖锐对比预测；专家标注支持其预测推理，判别性实验设计证据积极但不够一致。

Insight: 创新点在于构建超越最终准确率的诊断性基准，将探索行为与四步推理分别评估，从而定位LLM智能体实验规划中的具体瓶颈。客观来看，其可借鉴之处是把科学推理拆成可解释环节并分别评分，揭示从识别合理假设到设计判别实验、形成对比预测之间的能力差距。

Abstract: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. Across ten LLM agents, we find that stronger agents outperform both adaptive (Bayesian optimization) and non-adaptive (Latin hypercube) baselines and exhibit exploration patterns inconsistent with naive heuristics. Decomposing reasoning reveals that the stronger agents score consistently well across all four steps, whereas weaker agents often succeed at belief update and hypothesis discrimination but are less reliable at translating them into actionable designs and sharp contrastive predictions. Independent expert annotations support predictive reasoning under our stated validation criteria, while evidence for discriminative experiment design is positive but less consistent. The results suggest a gap between recognizing plausible hypotheses and translating them into contrastive predictions, with more tentative evidence for a corresponding experiment-design bottleneck. The benchmark website is available at https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/.

[335] Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Linghua Zhang, Yunhe Li

TL;DR: 论文提出 SELFWRITE 框架：让语言模型无需梯度下降，直接在持久的 Python 会话中查看自身权重与激活，并编写程序构造低秩权重编辑来实现自我改进。每一代中，当前模型针对新的训练问题分析自己的推理过程，在隐藏门控集上对每个候选编辑打分，只有严格提升的编辑才会被合并进权重，随后由编辑后的模型撰写下一次编辑，从而形成递归自我改进循环。

Details

Motivation: 现有 LLM 的自我改进主要依赖数据、训练配方或外部脚手架，权重的更新始终由梯度下降完成，模型本身并不“写”更新。作者希望让模型成为自己权重的作者，探索一条完全无梯度、可递归的自我改进路径。

Result: 在 Qwen3.8-27B 与 DAPO-Math 数学题上，经过 5 代 SELFWRITE，门控准确率从 73.95% 升至 76.45%；在循环从未见过的留出测试集上，avg@4 从 76.30% 升至 77.75%，pass@4 从 82.60% 升至 84.80%，全程没有一次梯度步。提升幅度温和但方向一致，并验证了编辑后的模型仍能继续写出有效编辑。

Insight: 创新点在于把“权重更新”本身交给模型编写程序完成：利用奇异方向、正确与错误答案之间的激活对比、秩一投影、张量运算等白盒原语构造低秩编辑，并用隐藏门控集只合入严格提升的候选，从而保证改进单调且可递归。可借鉴的是“模型即权重编辑程序员”的范式与基于验证门控的自我改进闭环设计。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today’s language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. A language model can author useful changes to its own weights without gradients, and the edited model keeps writing useful edits.

TL;DR: 论文研究自适应LLM红队训练中攻击多样性为何收窄，以及收窄发生在攻击者-防御者-评判者学习环路的哪个环节。作者测试六种机制并在三种实验设置下迭代24轮，发现冻结防御者会使攻击多样性保持率（ADR）更早下降；成功攻击比全体生成攻击多样性更窄，且靠近既往成功样本或具有共同开头的攻击更容易成功。最终将多样性收窄主要归因于仅以成功为奖励、经组相对训练优势传导到攻击者更新的机制。

Motivation: 强化学习能提升自动化红队攻击成功率，但也会缩窄攻击向量。论文旨在定位这种多样性收窄在学习环路中的起始位置和关键机制。

Result: 在24轮实验中，冻结防御者在第12轮时ADR为0.496，低于联合训练的0.891；防御者更新会延迟但不阻止收窄。接近既往成功样本的攻击成功率高10-15个百分点，共同开头攻击有5-16个百分点优势；行上限和更新幅度影响较小，攻击长度仅解释部分ADR下降。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点是系统追踪自适应LLM红队中攻击多样性收窄的来源，并将其归因于成功-only奖励经组相对训练优势传导至攻击者更新，持续的成功优势设定方向。客观看，其价值在于用多实验臂和时间演化分析拆分防御者适应、奖励强化、更新规模等因素，并用winner-neighbor与common-opening现象提供可测量证据。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning can increase the success of automated red teaming but it also narrows the attack vector. This study asks where in the attacker-defender-judge learning loop does the narrowing begin and which mechanisms lead to a narrowing attack. Six mechanisms (defender adaptation, success edge, reward reinforcement, row cap, update size, and measurement) are tested across three experiment arms (co-trained, frozen defender, half learning rate) for twenty-four iterations. A frozen defender narrows attack diversity retention (ADR) earlier 0.496 relative to co-trained 0.891 at iteration twelve. Defender updates delay narrowing but dont prevent it. Successful attacks (“winners”) have narrower attack diversity than the full set of generated attacks. Attacks closest to previous winners succeed 10-15 percentage points more often than those closest to previous failures. This winner-neighbor advantage holds after a defender update and for a fixed defender too. Attacks with a common opening have a common-opening advantage of 5-16 percentage points. The training row cap and update size account for little impact on ADR, and attack length accounts for only part of the ADR decrease. Narrowing appears to originate from the success only reward through the group-relative training advantage to the attacker update, with a persistent success edge setting the direction.

Motivation: 人类能借助关系类比和模块化抽象在有限认知资源下进行抽象视觉推理并泛化到新问题，而深度学习依赖大量任务特定训练且易利用视觉捷径；现有神经符号方法又依赖显式规则监督或参数繁重的 Transformer，未能很好兼顾感知与高效推理。
