Abstract: Human visual intelligence enables efficient reasoning capabilities on abstract visual problems with bounded cognitive resources and minimal experience, and yields remarkable generalization to novel problems with its ability to draw relational analogies and modular abstractions. In contrast, deep learning models require exhaustive task-specific training on large datasets, making them prone to exploiting visual shortcuts and resulting in poor generalization. While neuro-symbolic approaches attempt to bridge this gap by decoupling perception from reasoning with dedicated computation units, existing solutions rely either on explicit rule supervision or parameter-heavy transformer architectures that reintroduce the computational inefficiencies they aim to solve. We introduce Slot-Dwn to address these limitations, a novel neuro-symbolic architecture that unifies unsupervised object-centric perception with logic-based symbolic reasoning. Our model utilizes a Multi-Head Differentiable Weightless Network (MH-DWN) that performs efficient reasoning entirely in Boolean space using look-up tables (LUTs). Our framework reduces visual perception complexity and introduces a LUT-based relational bottleneck with sparse input routing to minimize computational overhead. We evaluate Slot-Dwn across various abstract visual reasoning benchmark tasks targeting systematic rule generalization, sample-efficient anomaly detection, and multi-relational reasoning. We demonstrate that Slot-Dwn yields competitive performance with respect to the state-of-the-art, under extreme out-of-distribution regimes, while requiring up to 52% fewer trainable parameters, with significantly faster convergence.

[338] Reinforcing Diffusion Models by Instantaneous Trajectory Distribution Matching cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

TL;DR: 论文面向扩散模型的强化学习对齐，指出已有基于确定性ODE采样的方法本质上依赖带符号奖励加权回归，并存在行为分布与策略分布不匹配导致的基线梯度漂移问题。为此提出瞬时轨迹分布匹配 iTDM，通过后验分数恒等式取轨迹分布匹配的无穷小极限，得到锚定在行为速度上的样本级梯度，并用在线辅助去噪器保证基线不变性。方法在组合生成、文本渲染和偏好对齐等任务上验证了有效性。

Details

Motivation: 现有前向扩散强化学习方法虽可避免轨迹反向传播，但其基线减法隐含假设策略速度等于行为边缘速度，在CFG rollout、离线/离策略更新和在线自一致性不完美时会产生行为-策略不匹配与基线诱导梯度漂移，导致训练不稳定。

Abstract: Forward diffusion reinforcement learning (RL)—enabling deterministic ODE sampling without trajectory backpropagation—has grown increasingly popular for efficiently aligning diffusion models. However, we reveal that existing methods essentially rely on signed reward-weighted regression (RWR), regressing the \emph{trainable policy} velocity onto rollouts from a \emph{behavior distribution}. Unbiased baseline subtraction implicitly assumes that the policy velocity equals the behavior marginal velocity—an idealized assumption violated under classifier-free guidance (CFG) rollouts, offline/off-policy updates, and imperfect online self-consistency. This \emph{behavior–policy mismatch} breaks baseline invariance and injects \emph{baseline-induced gradient drift}, destabilizing training. To resolve this issue, we propose \textbf{I}nstantaneous \textbf{T}rajectory \textbf{D}istribution \textbf{M}atching (\textbf{iTDM}), taking the infinitesimal limit of Trajectory Distribution Matching toward a time-local reward-guided target via the posterior-score identity to yield a sample-level gradient anchored at the behavior velocity without learning an additional reward-tilted target score. Tracking this velocity with an online auxiliary denoiser guarantees exact baseline invariance at the auxiliary optimum, effectively suppressing baseline drift across both online and offline RL. Extensive experiments across compositional generation, text rendering, and preference alignment show that iTDM achieves state-of-the-art in-domain and out-of-domain performance. Notably, on the challenging GenEval2 benchmark, iTDM converges nearly $3\times$ faster than competing methods while scaling smoothly to $0.87$ without collapse. Code is available at https://github.com/Luo-Yihong/iTDM

Abstract: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model’s CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent computation is completed before the model generates its CoT, which takes no part in it. Altogether, we show that a hidden objective that requires reasoning can go unseen by a monitor that reads only the output.

Motivation: 多模态表格学习中标注数据稀缺，PFN可通过上下文学习避免任务特定训练，但图文编码器输出维度远高于PFN预训练时的特征数。现有PCA压缩接口在低数据下可能失效，论文旨在解决该失败机制并提升低数据性能。

Result: 在图像和文本分类任务、多种编码器及表格基础模型上，RoFE在低数据设置下优于PCA接口，并超过需要任务特定训练的基线；改进也可扩展到回归任务。摘要未给出具体定量数值或明确benchmark名称。

Insight: 创新点在于识别出PFN逐列标准化会移除PCA分数方差、使样本在保留全部方向时坍缩为正单纯形，并提出训练免费的旋转操作使各列方差近似相等，从而让标准化近似保持嵌入几何。客观上看，其价值在于揭示PCA+PFN接口的几何退化问题，并给出简单有效的免训练修正。

Abstract: Multimodal tabular learning combines tabular data with images and text, often in settings where labeled data are scarce. Tabular foundation models such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) offer a promising solution via in-context learning without task-specific training. However, modern image and text encoders produce embeddings with hundreds or thousands of dimensions, far exceeding the number of features encountered during PFN pretraining. Existing approaches bridge this gap using principal component analysis (PCA) to compress frozen embeddings. Surprisingly, we find that this PCA interface can underperform simple linear classifiers when labeled examples are scarce, even though PFNs are designed for small datasets. We identify the underlying failure mechanism: the PFN’s per-column standardization removes the variances of the PCA scores. When the PCA keeps every direction of the labeled examples, the examples collapse into a regular simplex in which all pairwise distances are equal. To address this problem, we propose Rotated Frozen Embeddings (RoFE), a training-free method that rotates PCA scores before PFN inference. We theoretically show that rotation makes the column variances nearly equal, so that standardization approximately preserves the embedding geometry. Across image and text classification tasks, encoders, and tabular foundation models, RoFE improves low-data performance over the PCA interface and outperforms baselines that require task-specific training. The improvements also extend to regression.

[341] Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Nan Chen, Soledad Villar, Soufiane Hayou

TL;DR: 论文提出 TipSweep，用于在 LLM 后训练（SFT、DPO、RLVR）中跨可训练 Transformer 块数量迁移学习率。方法先在最后少量块（通常 k0=1）上搜索最优学习率，再利用精度相关的缩放规则预测训练任意 k 个块乃至全模型时的最优学习率，并给出 FP32 主权重与直接 BF16 权重更新下的不同缩放规律。

Details

Motivation: LLM 后训练对学习率非常敏感，而网格搜索学习率在计算和显存上代价高；作者希望低成本确定不同可训练块数量下的最优学习率，避免全深度反复调参。

Result: 在 1B 到 7B 参数模型上观察到最优学习率随块数 k 呈精度相关缩放：FP32 主权重约按 k^{-1}，直接 BF16 权重更新约按 k^{-1/2}。针对 6.7B 模型实现两种搜索原型：一种可在 16 GiB 显存的单张消费级 GPU 上完成；另一种在高端 GPU 上单次数据遍历评估所有候选学习率，五候选搜索约消耗一次全深度训练一半的 GPU 小时。

Insight: 创新点在于利用“精度感知”的学习率缩放规则实现跨块数量的学习率迁移，并用考虑更新舍入的分析模型解释 FP32 与 BF16 下不同缩放指数；客观价值在于将高成本学习率网格搜索转化为少量块上的低成本搜索与规则外推，并提供显存和计算效率优化原型。

Abstract: The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in both computation and memory. In this work, we propose \textbf{TipSweep}, a method to transfer the learning rate across the number of trainable transformer blocks. To do so efficiently, we search for the best learning rate by training only the last $k_0$ blocks (in our experiments, typically $k_0=1$), and provide scaling rules that predict the optimal learning rate when training any set of $k$ blocks, including when $k=L$ (the full transformer). Across experiments with models ranging from 1 to 7 billion parameters, we observe that the optimal learning rate follows precision-dependent scaling rules: the optimal rate scales approximately as $k^{-1}$ with float32 (FP32) master weights, but as $k^{-1/2}$ when updates are applied directly to bfloat16 (BF16) weights without a master copy. We explain both rules using an analytical model that accounts for update rounding, under assumptions supported by profiling experiments. Finally, we develop two prototypes of the learning rate search for a 6.7-billion-parameter model. The first fits the search on a single consumer GPU with 16 GiB of memory. The second speeds up the search on a high-end GPU by evaluating all candidate learning rates in a single pass over the data, so that a five-candidate search takes about half the GPU hours of one full-depth ($k=L$) run.

[342] MACE: Memory-Augmented Crop-Disease Evaluation of Frozen Vision-Language Models cs.MA | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Tirtho Roy, Shreyan Ganguly, Muhammad Arbab Arshad, Nikhil Bhattacharya, Soumik Sarkar

TL;DR: 论文提出 MACE，一种无需训练的作物病害评估方法，用于增强冻结视觉语言模型。它通过在知识库外增加“症状描述-病害标签”记忆，并将查询图像描述与记忆匹配，仅检索文本描述和标签来辅助诊断。在十种作物上，结合 Claude Sonnet 5.5 显著提升了分布内和留出图像集上的诊断准确率。

Details

Motivation: 传统作物病害诊断依赖专家评估和针对特定作物或病害定制的模型，难以跨田间条件扩展；现有冻结视觉语言模型虽引入源知识库，但对症状在个体病例间的变化描述不足。

Result: 在十种作物上，MACE 将分布内准确率从 42.8% 提升到 62.2%，在留出图像集上从 50.7% 提升到 57.0%；检索到的病害标签贡献主要增益，加入对应文本描述后分布内准确率再提升约 6 个百分点。

Insight: 创新点在于无需训练地为冻结视觉语言模型补充病例级症状记忆，并通过检索文本描述和标签辅助诊断，使诊断模型只看到查询图像本身。客观来看，其可借鉴之处是结合静态知识库与动态检索记忆，并利用标签和描述两类信息提升跨病例泛化。

Abstract: In plant phenotyping, crop disease diagnosis has traditionally relied on expert assessment of visible symptoms and on models tailored to specific crops or diseases, and both are difficult to scale across field conditions. Recent methods provide frozen vision-language models with source-grounded knowledge bases that summarize the typical symptoms of each disease but describe little of how symptoms vary across individual cases. We introduce MACE (Memory-Augmented Crop-Disease Evaluation), a training-free method that supplements the knowledge base with a memory of symptom descriptions paired with known disease labels. MACE matches a description of the query image against this memory and retrieves only text descriptions and disease labels, so the query is the only image that the diagnosis model sees. Across ten crops, MACE with Claude Sonnet 5.5 improved accuracy over the knowledge-base baseline from 42.8% to 62.2% in distribution and from 50.7% to 57.0% on held-out image collections. Retrieved disease labels accounted for most of the gain, and adding the corresponding text descriptions improved in-distribution accuracy by about six percentage points.

cs.MM [Back]

[343] Face Is Not All You Need: MIME Benchmark for Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition cs.MM | cs.CVPDF

Yuxin Jia, Xing Lan, Wensong Wang, Jian Xue, Feiliang Ren

TL;DR: 论文关注真实场景中多模态信息不完整时的多模态情感识别问题，形式化定义了 Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition（IMER）任务，并构建了包含 2000 个视频片段的 MIME 基准，覆盖细粒度面部细节退化、严重面部退化和极端全模态缺失等设置。论文还提出 Chain of Emotion（CoE）分析范式与定制指标，用于剖析多模态大模型的情感线索感知与推理过程，并在七个主流 MLLM 上进行实验分析。

Details

Motivation: 现有 MER 方法通常假设多模态输入完整且对齐，并高度依赖面部线索，因此在真实场景中遇到模态退化或信息丢失时性能会严重崩溃。已有评测多局限于粗粒度全模态缺失，缺乏对多样细粒度不完整设置和可解释情感推理的系统评估。

Result: 论文在七个主流 MLLM 上进行大量实验，发现面部退化时身体语言和场景上下文可作为关键补偿机制，同时模型的基础视觉感知能力与高层认知推理能力之间存在明显差距；摘要未给出具体定量指标或 SOTA 数值。

Insight: 创新点在于正式定义 IMER 任务，构建覆盖多粒度模态缺失和情感信息丢失的 MIME 基准，并提出 CoE 分析范式和定制指标来细粒度分析 MLLM 的情感线索感知与推理过程，为鲁棒多模态情感识别提供评测平台和可操作洞见。

Abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) is a fundamental task in multimedia understanding, where state-of-the-art methods have achieved prominent success relying on the assumption of complete, well-aligned multimodal inputs. However, real-world unconstrained scenarios often suffer from unpredictable modality degradation and information loss, leading to catastrophic performance collapse of existing MER models that heavily depend on facial cues as the core inference anchor. However, few systematic works evaluate model robustness under diverse, fine-grained incomplete settings, as prior works are limited to coarse-grained full-modality removal and neglect interpretable analysis of emotional reasoning. To bridge this gap, we formally define the Incomplete Multimodal Emotion Recognition (IMER) task, which benchmarks model generalization and robustness under multi-grained modality and emotional information loss. We further construct MIME, a dedicated IMER benchmark with 2,000 video segments covering realistic fine-grained facial-detail degradation, severe facial degradation, and extreme full-modality loss, surpassing the limited coarse-grained settings of prior works. We also propose the Chain of Emotion (CoE) analysis paradigm with tailored metrics to dissect the fine-grained emotional cue perception and reasoning process of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Extensive experiments on seven mainstream MLLMs reveal that body language and scene context act as critical compensatory mechanisms under facial degradation, while a pronounced gap exists between models’ basic visual perception ability and high-level cognitive reasoning. Our work provides a focused evaluation platform and actionable insights for advancing robust multimodal emotion recognition. Our dataset and code are public at https://yuxinokk.github.io/MIME.

cs.RO [Back]

[344] GenPA: Image Generators as Efficient Robot Policies cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Zian Deng, Tianyi Zhang, Zilong Zheng, Ziyu Liu, Tao Zhang

TL;DR: 论文提出GenPA，将预训练图像生成模型直接适配为机器人动作策略：用仅19M参数的动作回归适配器微调图像生成骨干，并复用原生生成目标进行感知协同训练。推理时只需单次骨干前向和动作回归，无需生成未来视觉或迭代动作去噪，在仿真和真实操作任务中取得强性能与低延迟。

Details

Motivation: 现有代表性工作把未来视觉预测作为视觉生成预训练与动作学习的核心桥梁，即使推理阶段不再生成未来场景仍保留该训练目标。论文认为图像生成预训练已获得的指令跟随、空间理解和视觉想象能力可直接支持控制，因此无需依赖未来视觉预测。

Result: 无需额外大规模机器人数据预训练，GenPA在LIBERO达到99.10%成功率、LIBERO-Plus达到83.79%，并在真实操作任务中表现强且抗扰动；编译推理下单个H100每动作块耗时20.9 ms，相比强VLA和WAM基线实现1.7-3.4倍加速。

Insight: 创新点在于将图像生成骨干本身直接改造为高效动作学习器，用轻量动作回归适配器替代未来视觉生成和迭代去噪，并借助原生图像编辑接口统一比较当前场景感知、未来预测及其组合；消融还发现当前深度监督是简单有效的训练配方。

Abstract: Pretrained visual generation models have shown great promise in robotic manipulation. However, a representative line of work still treats future visual prediction as the central link between visual generative pretraining and action learning, retaining it as a training objective even when future scenes are no longer generated at inference time. We argue that the instruction-following, spatial understanding, and visual imagination capabilities acquired through image generation pretraining can support control without future visual prediction: image generation models themselves can be directly adapted into powerful action learners. Building on this perspective, we propose GenPA, which fine-tunes an image generation backbone with a lightweight 19M-parameter action regression adapter and reuses its native generative objective for perception co-training. The native image-editing interface accommodates different visual targets without task-specific perception heads, enabling comparisons of current-scene perception, future prediction, and their combinations within a common policy architecture. At deployment, GenPA requires only a single backbone forward pass and action regression, without visual generation or iterative action denoising. Without additional large-scale robot-data pretraining, GenPA demonstrates strong control performance and robustness to perturbations across simulation benchmarks (99.10% success on LIBERO and 83.79% on LIBERO-Plus) and real-world manipulation tasks. Under compiled inference, GenPA takes 20.9 ms per action chunk on a single H100 GPU, achieving 1.7-3.4x speedups over strong VLA and WAM baselines. Our latency analysis further highlights architectural advantages of visual generation backbones for efficient robot control. Ablations across visual tasks and their combinations identify current-depth supervision as a simple, effective training recipe.

[345] FlowPAC: Flow-Guided Visual Pruning and Action Caching for Efficient VLA Inference cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Jintao Cheng, Yipu Zhang, Haozhe Wang, Lin Jiang, Jiang Xu

TL;DR: 论文提出FlowPAC，一种面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型高效推理的局部性感知框架，利用任务感知光流作为共享物理信号，联合优化视觉token剪枝与动作计算缓存。方法包含DATP、LACT和FCAR，分别处理视觉token动态传播、局部性连续token选择和基于运动动态的动作块刷新。在LIBERO闭环评测中实现2.13倍端到端加速，并在保留30%视觉token时基本维持成功率。

Details

Motivation: 现有免训练加速方法如视觉token剪枝和动作缓存多采用静态资源分配，难以匹配动态机器人交互，导致控制性能下降以及KV-cache碎片化和非关键区域计算浪费等硬件低效问题，阻碍VLA模型边缘部署。

Result: 在LIBERO闭环评测中，FlowPAC相比稠密基线取得2.13倍端到端加速，同时在仅保留30%视觉token的情况下基本保持任务成功率。

Insight: 创新点在于以任务感知光流作为视觉与动作计算共享的物理信号，联合进行动态视觉token传播、局部性感知连续token选择和动作块自适应刷新；客观看，其价值在于将计算资源分配同时对齐机器人物理动态与硬件局部性约束，减少内存碎片并提升VLA边缘推理效率。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied AI, yet their high inference latency and memory footprint remain major barriers to edge deployment. Existing training-free acceleration techniques, such as visual token pruning and action caching, typically rely on static resource allocation. This mismatch with dynamic robotic interactions not only degrades control performance but also causes severe hardware inefficiencies, including fragmented KV-cache layouts and wasted compute on non-critical regions. To address this, we propose FlowPAC, a locality-aware framework that leverages task-aware optical flow as a shared physical signal to jointly optimize visual and action computation. Specifically, we introduce Direction-Aware Trajectory Propagation (DATP) and Locality-Aware Contiguous Token Selection (LACT) to jointly handle visual token dynamics and enforce spatial locality, reducing memory fragmentation and enabling efficient KV-cache compression. This is complemented by Flow-Conditioned Action-Block Refresh (FCAR) for adaptive action computation based on motion dynamics. Extensive closed-loop evaluations on LIBERO demonstrate that FlowPAC achieves a 2.13$\times$ end-to-end speedup over the dense baseline while essentially maintaining the success rate with 30% visual-token retention. These results validate that aligning computation allocation with both physical dynamics and hardware constraints is essential for efficient VLA deployment on edge systems.

[346] Defending Vision-Language-Action Models against Transferable Attacks via Visual-Proprioceptive Consistency cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Jiahao Wang, Ming F. Li, Han Xu

TL;DR: 论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型面临的可迁移对抗攻击，观察到此类攻击会扰乱模型对机器人自身位置的视觉感知。提出基于本体感知的防御框架，用机器人本体状态构建可信空间参考，并与视觉特征推断的感知位置比对，通过视觉-本体感知一致性检测并缓解攻击。实验验证可检测可迁移对抗补丁并提升闭环性能，真机实验也有效。

Details

Motivation: VLA模型在机器人任务中表现强，但对抗攻击可跨任务迁移，严重威胁机器人系统；且不同可迁移攻击都会破坏VLA对机器人自身的感知，因此需要一种不依赖特定攻击模式的防御。

Result: 大量实验表明能有效检测可迁移对抗补丁并改善闭环性能；真机实验进一步证明在真实机器人任务中的有效性。摘要未给出具体benchmark数值或SOTA比较。

Insight: 创新点在于利用本体感知作为可信空间参考，通过视觉-本体感知一致性检测并缓解攻击。客观看，该思路把防御锚定在不易被视觉对抗扰动的物理状态上，具有较强的任务/攻击泛化潜力，且实现思路简洁。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in a wide range of robotic tasks. However, adversarial attacks in VLA models have shown strong transferability across robotic tasks, posing significant threats to robotic systems. Despite their different attack strategies, we observe that these transferable attacks share a common consequence: they disrupt the VLA model’s perception towards the robot itself. Motivated by this observation, we propose a proprioception-grounded defense framework that leverages trusted proprioceptive information to detect and mitigate transferable adversarial attacks. Specifically, we utilize the robot’s proprioceptive states to establish a trusted spatial reference, and compare it with the robot’s perceived location inferred from visual features. Discrepancies between these two sources provide a reliable signal for detecting adversarial attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate effective detection of transferable adversarial patches and improved closed-loop performance. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of our defense on real-world robotic tasks.

[347] AlpaSafe: Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection for Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Qiren Wang, Mingyu Guo, Weisong Shi

TL;DR: 论文提出 AlpaSafe，一种用于自动驾驶 VLA 模型的风险感知轨迹选择器。它复用冻结 VLA 在生成候选轨迹时已计算出的场景表示（prompt prefill 的最后一个隐藏 token），用轻量级头对每个候选轨迹预测相对分数及碰撞/驶出道路风险 logits，并通过固定规则剔除风险支配候选后选择最高分轨迹，无需在线 rollout 或训练 VLA。

Details

Motivation: 基于推理的驾驶 VLA 每次决策会产生多个候选轨迹但只执行一个；常规评测用 oracle 选择最佳候选，部署时缺乏该选择器，且被执行候选的风险未被评估。现有在线评估器常需专门训练场景/世界模型并逐候选 rollout，推理开销大。

Result: 在 525 个 AlpaSim 场景上，AlpaSafe 在 selected regret 和 top-1 agreement 上优于 Alpamayo 默认 first-sample 规则与均匀随机选择；将有责碰撞或驶出道路率从 6.41% 和 6.10% 降至 4.93%。选择器仅 1.7M 参数，每次决策 0.75 ms。

Insight: 创新点在于复用冻结 VLA 的内部场景表示作为选择器输入，避免额外世界模型和推理时 rollout；用闭环仿真结果训练轻量风险头，并以风险 logits 的支配规则做安全约束选择。客观看，核心贡献是低成本、可插拔的候选轨迹选择/风险过滤框架，而非重新训练 VLA 或改进轨迹生成器。

Abstract: Reasoning-based driving vision-language-action (VLA) models propose multiple candidate trajectories at each decision, yet only one is executed. Standard evaluation scores the best candidate, assuming an oracle selector that deployment lacks, and leaves the risk of the executed candidate unexamined. Existing online evaluators typically close this gap with a purpose-trained scene or world model, often rolling out each candidate through it at inference time. We introduce AlpaSafe, a risk-aware trajectory selector that reuses the scene representation a frozen driving VLA computes while proposing its candidates. AlpaSafe reads the last hidden token of the VLA’s prompt prefill. A lightweight head, trained on the closed-loop simulation outcomes of the candidates, fuses this token with each candidate trajectory and predicts a relative score and collision/offroad logits. A fixed rule removes candidates dominated on the two risk logits and selects the highest-scoring candidate among those remaining, adding neither rollouts nor VLA training. Experiments on 525 AlpaSim scenes show that AlpaSafe outperforms Alpamayo’s default first-sample rule and uniform random selection in selected regret and top-1 agreement, and reduces the collision-at-fault or offroad rate from 6.41% and 6.10% to 4.93%. The selector has 1.7M parameters and takes 0.75 ms per decision.

[348] SANA-Robot: Efficient World Action Model with Hybrid Memory cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Yuyang Zhao, Zekai Li, Yicheng Pan, Jiaming Tang, Zhuoyang Zhang

TL;DR: 论文提出 SANA-Robot，一个 4.5B 参数的世界动作模型（WAM），通过混合记忆架构实现分钟级长时记忆，并能在边缘设备上实时运行。其核心设计包括：用线性注意力维持固定大小状态的全局记忆，用滑动窗口 softmax 注意力传播近期信息；通过给动作和视频 token 动态施加不同噪声水平，使单一模型既能作为策略又能作为世界模拟器；以及一套支持记忆训练和推理的全栈基础设施。最终在中型模型（约 5B）中取得领先性能，并实现 30Hz 闭环异步机器人控制。

Details

Motivation: 现有世界动作模型借助视频生成的世界知识提升动作生成，但预测开销大，无法在边缘设备实时部署，且普遍缺乏有效的长期记忆，难以完成需要整段 episode 记忆的任务。

Result: 在 RoboDojo 的记忆维度上，SANA-Robot 取得中型模型（约 5B）中的最佳表现，并在 LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Max 上取得最高成功率；真实部署中在 RTX 5090 上使用 FP8 GEMM 每动作块耗时 135ms（NVFP4 为 115ms），在边缘设备上实现 30Hz 实时异步闭环控制。

Insight: 创新点在于：以线性注意力加滑动窗口注意力的混合记忆，在恒定计算成本下实现长时记忆并保持高效推理；通过差异化噪声注入统一策略与世界模拟器两种角色；并配套数据打包、洗牌与基于记忆阶段的异步执行等全栈工程优化，兼顾效率与效果。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) leverage the world knowledge of video generation models to improve action generation by aligning visual prediction with action prediction. However, their prediction overhead prevents real-time deployment on edge devices, and they usually lack an effective long-term memory. We introduce SANA-Robot, a 4.5B WAM with minute-level memory that runs in real time on edge devices, built on the following core designs: (1) hybrid memory at constant cost: our WAM relies on linear attention to maintain a global memory with a fixed-size state, and on sliding window softmax attention layers that propagate previous information, enabling high success rates on tasks requiring whole-episode memory while keeping an efficient and constant inference speed; (2) a unified model: by dynamically applying different noise levels to action and video tokens, SANA-Robot can serve not only as a policy but also as a world simulator; (3) a full-stack infrastructure for both memory training and inference, including efficient data packing and shuffling as well as memory-phase-based asynchronous execution. SANA-Robot achieves the best performance on the memory dimension of RoboDojo among models of medium size (about 5B) and the highest success rates on LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro and LIBERO-Max. In real-world deployment, SANA-Robot takes 135 ms per action chunk on an RTX 5090 with FP8 GEMMs and 115 ms with NVFP4 GEMMs, and achieves closed-loop, real-time asynchronous robot control at 30 Hz on edge devices, demonstrating both the efficiency and the effectiveness of SANA-Robot. Project page: https://nvlabs.github.io/Sana/Robot/

[349] $ζ_0$: A Framework for World Action Models with Joint Scene and Body Foresight in Humanoid Control cs.RO | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Yizhi Chen, Zhanxiang Cao, Yitong Wang, Junyu Liu, Hongchu Zeng

TL;DR: 论文提出 ζ₀ 框架，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略升级为世界动作模型（World Action Model），在共享潜空间中同时预测未来视觉特征与实测关节轨迹，从而让人形机器人同时具备”场景预见”与”本体预见”。训练时引入以真实未来为条件的教师模型提供参考动作响应，并通过双响应迁移让因果预测器同时对齐教师与执行策略；部署时仅使用因果预测的未来。该框架可挂载于 Ψ₀、GR00T N1.7 等现有 VLA 基座之上。

Details

Motivation: 现有世界动作模型主要通过预测视觉结果来指导机器人动作，但人形机器人的交互还依赖本体（关节）如何响应，仅靠视觉预见会遗漏身体运动信息；而基于潜空间距离的损失又无法直接监督动作响应，因此需要一种同时预见场景与本体未来、并能直接监督动作响应的建模方式。

Result: 在 7 个 HumanoidArena 任务上，基于 Ψ₀ 和 GR00T N1.7 的 ζ₀ 平均成功率分别达 63.6% 和 79.5%，较各自基座提升 18.8 与 9.0 个百分点；在 6 个真实世界任务上达 78.3% 和 85.0%，提升 16.7 与 10.0 个百分点；在 GR00T 上 79.5% 的成绩超过所有参与对比的七任务联合策略。

Insight: 创新点在于将场景预见与本体关节轨迹预见统一到同一共享潜表示中联合预测，并用”以真实未来为条件的教师 + 双响应迁移”把未来信息蒸馏进因果预测器，从而在训练时利用未来监督、部署时保持因果可用性；其模型无关的框架设计可直接增强现有 VLA 基座，这种训练-部署非对称的监督方式是较可借鉴的思路。

Abstract: World Action Models anticipate visual outcomes to guide robot actions, yet humanoid interaction also depends on how the robot’s body responds. Visual foresight alone can miss body motion, while latent-distance losses do not directly supervise action responses. We present $ζ_0$, a framework that turns vision-language-action policies into World Action Models by foreseeing future visual features and measured joint trajectories in a shared latent representation. During training, a teacher conditioned on recorded futures provides a reference action response, and dual-response transfer trains the causal predictor to match it through the teacher and the executing policy. All components are trained jointly, and deployment uses only causally predicted futures. On seven HumanoidArena tasks, $ζ_0$ built on $Ψ_0$ and GR00T N1.7 reaches 63.6% and 79.5% mean success, 18.8 and 9.0 points above these bases. On six real-world tasks, it reaches 78.3% and 85.0%, gains of 16.7 and 10.0 points. On GR00T, its 79.5% tops all compared seven-task joint policies. Project page: https://chenyizhi123.github.io/zeta0-project/

[350] RSLaA: Self-Reconfiguring Roadside LiDARs as Agents for 3D Traffic Perception cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Yang Ma, Yichen Sun, Yubing Zheng, Zhongxiang Feng, Zeyang Cheng

TL;DR: 论文提出RSLaA框架，将路侧激光雷达（RSL）视为可自适应调整位姿的智能体，在每个决策时间窗内根据动态交通场景调整自身朝向/位置，以提升3D交通感知。由于决策时无真值，框架仅利用历史观测构建的概率占据栅格计算代理指标（surrogate）来预测候选位姿在下一窗口的感知性能；作者构建了共仿真基准对比5种代理指标，发现多视角覆盖指标J_mv最可靠，并基于此实现两种自适应配置方法：滚动时域（MPC）优化器和基于MAPPO的集中训练-分散执行多智能体强化学习方案。

Details

Motivation: 现有工作通常基于道路几何与聚合交通统计一次性优化RSL配置并此后固定，但交通流本质上是动态的，平均最优的布设在任一具体时刻可能远非最优；同时路侧基础设施部署成本高昂，因此希望在不增加传感器的前提下通过动态重配置提升感知覆盖与质量。

Result: 在10个地点、89个六小时交通场景（共890次评估）上，自适应配置相比静态部署一致地提升了综合感知得分，表明将RSL视为智能体能够带来收益。

Insight: 创新点在于：把路侧激光雷达建模为可自主重配置的智能体而非一次性静态布设；在决策时无真值条件下，用历史观测的概率占据栅格推导代理指标来预测下一窗口感知性能，并通过共仿真基准系统性地验证代理指标的可靠性（选出J_mv）；进而结合MPC与MAPPO两种自适应求解方案。可借鉴之处在于以可验证代理指标替代在线真值进行闭环配置优化的思路。

Abstract: Cooperative perception with roadside LiDARs (RSLs) extends the sensing range of autonomous vehicles and resolves onboard-sensor occlusions, particularly at curves and intersections. Because infrastructure deployment is costly, existing work optimizes RSL configurations once, against road geometry and aggregated traffic statistics, and treats them as fixed thereafter. Traffic flow, however, is inherently dynamic, and a placement optimal on average can be far from optimal at any given moment. We introduce RSLaA (Roadside LiDARs as Agents), a framework in which each RSL adaptively adjusts its pose to the evolving traffic scene over decision-time windows. Since ground truth is unavailable at decision time, the framework centers on surrogate metrics computed solely from a probabilistic occupancy grid of historical observations, which predicts the next-window perception performance of candidate poses. We construct a co-simulation benchmark pairing five candidate surrogates with detector-agnostic ground-truth perception labels at every decision window, identifying the multi-view coverage metric J_mv as the most reliable predictor. Upon this validated surrogate we build two adaptive configuration methods, a receding-horizon (MPC) optimizer and a lightweight MAPPO-based multi-agent reinforcement learning scheme with centralized training and decentralized execution. Across 10 sites and 89 six-hour traffic scenarios (890 evaluation runs), adaptive configuration consistently improves the composite perception score over static deployment. Our results indicate that RSLs could be benefitted from being treated as agents.

[351] More Than Picturing the Future: Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning for Generalizable Robot Manipulation cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Xin Zhang, Yushuo Hou, Anqi Zhao, Moyun Liu, Xingwei Zhao

TL;DR: 论文面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的隐式推理，指出继承自视觉语言模型的“预测未来帧”式视觉隐变量会绑定训练场景外观，导致场景变化时性能骤降。为此提出运动导向隐式推理（Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning），让视觉隐变量从整帧外观转向动作应引发的场景演化，并在多个机器人操作基准上显著提升分布内与分布外成功率。

Details

Motivation: 现有VLA模型通过视觉预见进行隐式推理虽高效，但每个隐变量对齐孤立未来帧，服务理解而非动作，容易过拟合训练场景外观；论文希望让隐式视觉推理捕捉场景如何朝目标演化，而非未来帧看起来像什么，从而提升机器人操作的泛化性。

Result: 相对SOTA隐式VLA模型LaST0，方法在SimplerEnv-WidowX上将平均成功率从37.5%提升到55.2%（分布内），从22.4%提升到30.2%（分布外）；在AgileX Piper双臂平台上从60.8%提升到90.8%（训练场景），环境变化下从6.7%提升到37.5%。

Insight: 创新点在于将视觉隐变量从整帧预测重定向为运动/交互导向推理：语义隐变量先按具身思维链确定“做什么、怎么做”，再条件化地由粗到细预测全局场景、被操作物体与目标构成的交互区域以及机器人状态。可借鉴之处是用动作诱发的场景演化和交互区域作为隐式推理核心，减少对训练场景外观的依赖。

Abstract: Latent reasoning lets Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models deliberate at a fraction of the cost of explicit chain-of-thought, increasingly through visual foresight, which we show to be indispensable for predicting actions. Yet this paradigm is inherited from Vision-Language Models, where it serves understanding rather than action: each latent is aligned with an isolated future frame, often enriched with further modalities of that frame. We find that this binds the policy to the appearance of its training scenes, so that it degrades sharply once the scene changes. We argue that visual latents for action should capture not what a future frame looks like, but how the scene evolves toward the goal. We therefore propose Motion-Oriented Latent Reasoning, which redirects visual latents from the whole frame to the interaction that the action must bring about. Semantic latents, following the stages of embodied chain-of-thought, first establish what to accomplish and how. Conditioned on them, motion-oriented latents anticipate each future step from coarse to fine: from the global scene, to the interaction region spanned by the manipulated object and its destination, to the robot state. Relative to the state-of-the-art latent VLA LaST$_0$, our method raises the mean success rate on SimplerEnv-WidowX from 37.5% to 55.2% in distribution and from 22.4% to 30.2% under out-of-distribution shifts, and on an AgileX Piper dual-arm platform from 60.8% to 90.8% in training scenes and from 6.7% to 37.5% under environmental changes.

[352] Contact Harness: Enabling VLM Agents to Perform Contact-Rich Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Shilin Shan, Yuxuan Hu, Chuhao Zhou, Yimeng Dong, Bohan Hou

TL;DR: 论文提出 Contact Harness 框架，利用可复用、优化后的技能引导 VLM 代理结合视觉、力/触觉反馈评估接触状态并选择后续动作，同时用实时力反馈的柔顺执行机制调节接触运动。该方法无需模型微调、任务演示或仿真训练，并在真实机器人和仿真任务上验证了接触丰富操作能力。

Details

Motivation: VLM 代理已能零样本控制真实机器人，但仅靠视觉难以可靠判断接触丰富操作中的接触状态；力和触觉信号虽有帮助，却语义模糊，需要结合物理意义、任务阶段和视觉证据进行解释。

Result: 在 Rokae 和 Franka 机器人上使用 GPT-6 Astra 零样本评估，单一 prompt skill 在 15 类连接器上达到 90.7% 全插入率；四个额外接触任务平均成功率达 100%；六个仿真任务成功率为 96.7%，显著高于微调演示的预训练 VLA 基线（最高 68.3%）。

Insight: 核心创新是将可复用优化技能与 VLM 代理结合，用于多模态接触状态评估，并通过柔顺执行机制利用实时力反馈调节接触运动；无需微调、演示或仿真训练，为接触丰富操作提供了一种实用的 agent-based 部署范式。

Abstract: Agents built on pretrained VLMs have demonstrated zero-shot control of real robots, but vision alone is often insufficient for reliable contact-state assessment in contact-rich manipulation. Force and tactile feedback provide complementary information, but their semantic ambiguity makes them difficult for agents to use directly. These signals must be interpreted according to their physical meaning, together with task phase and visual evidence. We propose Contact Harness, which uses reusable, optimized skills to guide a VLM agent in assessing contact states from multimodal feedback and selecting subsequent actions. A compliant execution mechanism regulates in-contact motions using real-time force feedback. The framework requires no model fine-tuning, task demonstrations, or simulation training. We conduct zero-shot real-robot evaluations using GPT-6 Astra on Rokae and Franka robots. With a single prompt skill, Contact Harness achieves a full-insertion rate of 90.7% across 15 connector types, with further evaluations on a real PC under variations in lighting, background, and position. Across four additional contact-rich tasks, including whiteboard wiping, writing, peeling, and pivoting, Contact Harness achieves an average success rate of 100%. On six simulated tasks, Contact Harness reaches 96.7% success, compared with at most 68.3% for pretrained VLA baselines fine-tuned on task demonstrations, showing the potential of agent-based manipulation for contact-rich real-world deployment.

[353] Action Windows Are Inherently Temporal: A Benchmark for Time-Sensitive Robotic Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Haoxiang Zhan, Haoqin Hong, Congcong Zhu, Jingrun Chen

TL;DR: 论文提出 AWAIT 仿真基准，用于评估 VLM agent 在时间敏感机器人操作中能否在有限动作窗口内完成任务，并同时计入决策时间与执行时间。评估发现 agent 难以识别动作窗口的开启时刻，且连续决策和动作可能耗尽窗口，即使每次决策耗时短于窗口时长。

Details

Motivation: 现有 VLM agent 机器人操作基准对时间敏感任务覆盖不足；现实物理过程会形成有限的成功干预窗口，决策与执行共享时间预算，agent 需要判断窗口何时开启并及时干预。

Result: 摘要未给出具体定量指标或 SOTA 对比；评估定性地揭示了识别窗口开启的困难，以及连续决策和运动可能耗尽动作窗口的问题。

Insight: 创新点在于将动作窗口的时序性、决策耗时和执行耗时统一纳入仿真基准评测，强调 agent 不仅要做对动作，还要在正确时间窗口内完成干预；客观上有助于诊断 VLM agent 的时序规划与实时决策短板。

Abstract: Vision-language model (VLM) agents have surpassed learned-policy baselines on existing robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, these agents still struggle with time-sensitive everyday tasks that existing benchmarks for VLM agents cover only partially. In these tasks, evolving physical processes create finite windows for successful intervention. These action windows are inherently temporal and impose a shared time budget on decision making and physical execution. Coordinating intervention within this budget requires agents to determine when the window opens. We introduce AWAIT, a simulation benchmark that evaluates task completion within action windows while accounting for decision and execution time. Our evaluation reveals difficulties in recognizing window onset and shows that successive decisions and movements can exhaust an action window even when each decision takes less than the window duration. Project page: https://eyja42.github.io/await-site/.

[354] Agent on Guard: Self-Improving Runtime Intervention for Robust Robotic Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Gengming Cui, Mingfei Han, Jiawei Zhang, Mozheng Liao, Yunkai Guo

TL;DR: 论文提出 Agent on Guard（AoG），一个分层框架，用于改进冻结机器人基础策略与编程智能体之间的协作。AoG 通过物理经验学习何时让智能体介入恢复、何时交还基础策略，并联合优化干预时机、恢复技能和交接条件，从而提升鲁棒机器人操作的成功率与效率。

Details

Motivation: 机器人基础策略具备执行能力但缺乏失败推理与恢复能力，编程智能体可构造恢复行为，但二者结合的关键在于判断干预是否有效以及策略能否可靠恢复。由于物理世界在推理过程中持续演化，恢复窗口可能转瞬即逝，因此需要让决策与物理时间同步。

Result: 在 RoboDojo-Sim 上，AoG 达到 50.57% 成功率和 57.26 任务分数，分别超过最强评估基线 11.22 个百分点和 10.68 分；相较 GPT-6 Astra 智能体，端到端回合时延降低 80.4%，在线 token 消耗降低 85.1%。

Insight: 创新点在于将恢复调度与物理时钟对齐，并利用下游任务进展、失败复现、最终结果和资源消耗等长期信号，联合优化干预时机、恢复技能与移交条件，把临时智能体恢复方案转化为可复用的协作能力。

Abstract: Robot foundation policies provide learned execution capabilities, while programming agents can reason about failures and construct recovery behaviors. Combining them effectively requires learning when intervention helps and when the policy can reliably resume. This challenge is inherently temporal: the physical world continues to evolve during reasoning, and a useful recovery may become infeasible before a decision takes effect. We introduce Agent on Guard (AoG), a hierarchical framework that improves collaboration between a frozen base policy and a programming agent through physical experience. An evolving outer planner allocates control as the physical state evolves, aligning decisions with the physical clock with attention to observation freshness, remaining recovery windows, and the time required for reasoning, recovery, and subsequent execution. Coupled inner loops jointly refine intervention timing, recovery skills, and handoff conditions. Rather than judging recovery by local correction alone, AoG uses downstream task progress, failure recurrence, final outcomes, and resource consumption to improve both recovery behaviors and scheduling. This turns temporary agent solutions into reusable collaboration capabilities that complement the frozen policy. On RoboDojo-Sim, AoG achieves a success rate of 50.57% and a task score of 57.26, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 11.22 percentage points and 10.68 points, respectively. It also reduces end-to-end episode latency by 80.4% and online token consumption by 85.1% relative to the GPT-6 Astra agent.

[355] LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Tianle Zeng, Hanjing Ye, Bingyi Xia, Yuchen Zhou, Zibo Zhang

TL;DR: 论文提出LeadVLA，一种面向机器人领航的结构化多模态策略：在显式路径参考下学习路线推进节奏和局部残差，以兼顾路线执行与对跟随者的响应；同时构建基于Unreal Engine的闭环数据生成基础设施LeadInfra和包含108个完全留出闭环回合的基准LeadBench。

Details

Motivation: 现有机器人领航系统通常依赖显式状态、规划器或模块化接口来协调跟随者理解与物理路线执行，而端到端轨迹预测容易将路线执行与跟随者响应耦合纠缠；论文旨在直接且可控地学习这种耦合关系。

Result: 在LeadBench上，LeadVLA在受评估的机器人策略中取得最高任务成功率39.6%，并保持较好的路线保真度和跟随者响应性；还能在无需真实世界策略微调的情况下迁移到未见真实环境。

Insight: 创新点在于将领航策略分解为显式Path参考、Pace路线推进和Residual局部自适应，避免端到端预测的耦合纠缠；同时配套可配置闭环数据生成基础设施与标准化基准，提升问题可训练性和可测量性。

Abstract: Robot leading requires executing a route while continuously adapting to a designated follower. Existing robot-leading systems often mediate follower understanding and physical route execution through explicit states, planners, or modular interfaces; directly learning this coupling through end-to-end trajectory prediction can instead entangle route execution with follower response. We introduce LeadVLA, a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit Path reference while learning a Pace for route progress and a Residual for local follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation. To make this problem trainable and measurable, we develop LeadInfra, a configurable Unreal Engine-based closed-loop data-generation infrastructure from which we instantiate an approximately 4M-sample training corpus, and LeadBench, a standardized benchmark with 108 fully held-out closed-loop episodes. LeadVLA achieves the highest task success (39.6%) among evaluated robot policies on LeadBench while maintaining strong route fidelity and follower responsiveness, and transfers to unseen real-world environments without real-world policy fine-tuning. Project Page: https://louiszengCN.github.io/LeadVLA_PAGE/

[356] Seeing Together, Acting Apart: Shared Environmental Understanding for Multi-Robot Navigation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Haihong Hao, Lei Chen, Mingfei Han, Chenglong Yan, Dong An

TL;DR: 论文提出一种与策略无关的共享环境理解表示，将多机器人各自局部的第一视角观测聚合为共享潜在世界模型，使协作从策略空间转移到表示空间，从而支持基于共享环境上下文的去中心化决策。作者进一步提出SEER框架，通过共享记忆组织多机器人观测，利用时空相似性检索相关上下文，并用预测性潜在世界模型编码，最终以token形式注入下游导航智能体。

Details

Motivation: 多机器人具身系统通常依赖动作协调、轨迹共享或联合策略学习来实现协作；论文关注能否在决策之前先通过构建共享环境理解来促成协作，并解决部分观测下多机器人协同导航缺乏共享上下文的问题。

Result: 实验表明SEER能够捕捉与动作相关的环境结构，并在专门VLN智能体和通用视觉语言模型智能体上持续提升导航性能，同时保留单智能体能力；摘要未给出具体benchmark名称和定量指标。

Insight: 创新点在于提出策略无关的共享环境理解表示，将多机器人协作前移到表示空间，并通过共享记忆、时空相似性检索和预测性潜在世界模型为下游导航智能体提供可注入的共享上下文。客观看，其可借鉴之处是无需联合策略即可实现去中心化协作的表示层共享机制。

Abstract: Multi-robot embodied systems are typically designed to collaborate by coordinating actions, sharing trajectories, or learning joint policies. We ask a complementary question: can collaboration emerge before decision-making, by first building a shared understanding of the environment? We introduce Shared Environmental Understanding, a policy-agnostic representation that aggregates partial egocentric observations from multiple robots into a shared latent world model. This shifts collaboration from the policy space to the representation space, enabling decentralized decision-making with shared environmental context. To this end, we propose Shared Environment Encoding and Retrieval (SEER), a framework that organizes multi-robot observations into a shared memory, retrieves relevant context via spatio-temporal similarity, and encodes it using a predictive latent world model. The resulting representations are injected into downstream navigation agents as tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that SEER captures action-relevant environmental structure and consistently improves navigation performance across both specialized VLN agents and general vision-language model agents, while preserving single-agent capabilities.

Details

Motivation: 自我中心人类操作数据为训练灵巧机器人策略提供了可扩展资源，但由于人类与机器人之间的具身差距，机器人能多有效地从中学习仍不清楚，论文旨在通过受控研究厘清缩放这些数据对VLA和WAM预训练的实际效果与局限。

Result: 实验得出三个主要发现：数据多样性、轨迹对齐和详细语言注释是有效迁移的关键因素；缩放自我中心数据对末端执行器平移预测的增益大于细粒度手指运动；WAM在自我中心数据有限时表现更好，而VLA随数据量增加增益更大。

Insight: 论文创新在于系统控制地研究自我中心数据缩放对VLA和WAM的影响，并区分动作预测组件和模型类型；客观来看，其贡献在于提供了处理和使用自我中心数据训练VLA和WAM的实用指导，并明确了缩放数据的收益与局限。

Abstract: Egocentric human manipulation data offer a scalable resource for training dexterous robot policies. However, how effectively robots can learn and benefit from these data remains unclear due to the embodiment gap between humans and robots. We present EgoStudy, a systematic, controlled study of egocentric data for robot learning. Holding the robot dataset fixed, we vary the scale and diversity of egocentric data, data processing strategies, and co-training configurations. We investigate three questions: (1) Which data processing and pretraining choices most effectively exploit egocentric data? (2) Which components of robot action prediction benefit most from scaling these data? (3) How do scaling effects differ between vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs)? Our experiments yield three main findings. First, data diversity, alignment between trajectories, and detailed language annotations are key factors in effective transfer. Second, scaling egocentric data yields larger gains in predicting end-effector translation than in predicting fine-grained finger movements. Third, WAMs perform better when egocentric data are limited, whereas VLAs exhibit greater gains as the amount of egocentric data increases. Together, these findings provide practical guidance on processing and using egocentric data to train VLAs and WAMs, while clarifying the benefits and limitations of scaling these data.

Motivation: 异步执行能通过在执行当前动作块时生成下一动作块来降低 VLA 推理延迟，但新动作块依赖过期观测，延迟越大性能越差。作者发现这种不匹配在专家演示上不明显，却在策略自身延迟 rollout 中显著出现，尤其在失败片段中。

Insight: 创新点在于识别异步 VLA 的过期观测问题应通过策略自身延迟 rollout 上的 on-policy 自蒸馏解决，并让同步教师监督延迟学生匹配整个去噪过程；部署时无需额外模块，兼顾实时性与性能。

Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies incur substantial inference latency due to their large vision-language backbones and iterative denoising. Asynchronous execution reduces this latency by generating the next action chunk while executing the current one, but the new chunk is conditioned on a stale observation, degrading performance as the delay increases. We investigate this mismatch by comparing actions predicted from observations at planning and execution times. We find that these predictions differ little on expert demonstrations but diverge substantially on the policy’s own delayed rollouts, particularly in failed episodes. Motivated by this observation, we propose DelayOPSD, which trains an asynchronous policy to imitate its synchronous counterpart on the policy’s own rollouts. Specifically, a synchronous teacher, obtained from the same policy using the observation at execution time, supervises a delayed student that observes only the earlier frame and the actions still being executed. The student learns to match the teacher throughout its own denoising process. Under a 10-step delay, training SmolVLA on demonstrations achieves only 70.2% success, comparable to naive asynchronous execution (70.4%), whereas training on its own rollouts improves success to 78.7%. Across LIBERO and Kinetix, DelayOPSD achieves the highest average success among the compared methods, without introducing additional modules at deployment. On a real robot, it further improves success from 46% to 62%.

Yihao Shen, Yuxuan Chen, Xuantong Liu, Jun Gao, Weijian Luo

TL;DR: 论文提出RoboHarness-Zero，一种解耦机器人“大脑”（VLM）和“策略”（VLA）的harness框架，让VLM零样本规划与监控，VLA执行连续控制，从而提升VLA策略在组合任务上的成功率，且对新任务准备少、对新策略无需重新设计。

Motivation: VLA策略能执行单个技能但无法完成需要组合多个技能的任务，失败常因选错目标或进度跟踪丢失。现有harness需要任务和策略特定准备，迁移性差；理想harness应减少准备、无需重新设计、保留原有能力。

Insight: 宣称创新点：首次构建无需任务准备、无需策略重新设计、保留独立能力的harness；通过解耦VLM规划和VLA控制，利用VLM零样本选择目标和跟踪进度，后备使用生成代码。客观分析：创新在于明确分离VLA和VLM角色，VLM作为高层规划器，VLA作为低层执行器，监督规则固定且接口轻量，提高了通用性和迁移性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can execute individual skills but fail to complete tasks that require combining several of them. In our audit of Xiaomi-Robotics-1, an estimated 43% of failures involve choosing the wrong target or losing track of task progress. Wrapping a frozen VLA in a vision-language model (VLM) harness is a natural remedy. Existing harnesses can gain substantially from task- and policy-specific preparation, raising the question of how much of that gain transfers to a new task or policy. An ideal harness should (i) need minimal preparation for a new task, (ii) need no redesign for a new policy, and (iii) preserve standalone capabilities the policy already has. To the best of our knowledge, our \ours{} is the first harness built this way. Its premise is that choosing targets and tracking progress are easy for a VLM such as GPT-6 without task preparation, while the frozen VLA already handles continuous, contact-rich motion. The frozen VLA therefore executes continuous control while the VLM plans zero-shot and monitors execution; when progress stalls or targets drift, the VLM first rephrases the instruction and, only as a fallback, executes short generated code over generic motion primitives before returning fine control to the VLA. The supervision rules stay fixed across policies, requiring only a thin interface adapter and an automatically profiled skill configuration per policy. On 200 RoboCasa365 scenes, \ours{} with GPT-6 Astra raises the success rate of frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1 from \textbf{\color{blue}57.5%} to \textbf{\color{blue}70.5%} and preserves \textbf{\color{blue}90.4%} of its standalone successes (104/115) while rescuing 37 of 85 failures. On a shared 50-scene subset, the same rules add 8 to 10 percentage points to each of four other frozen policies, while existing preparation-based harness systems often fail to transfer to a new policy.

[360] SWEEP-Bench: Do Embodied Policies Act on the Speed They See? cs.RO | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Hiroaki Honda, Koya Sakamoto, Shu Morikuni, Yusuke Iwasawa, Taiki Miyanishi

TL;DR: 论文提出 SWEEP-Bench，一个包含 80 个传送带操作任务、16 类技能和 13 种传送带速度的仿真基准，用于评估具身策略是否能根据所看到的物体运动速度调整动作。作者微调八种视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型，比较单帧与多帧历史观测，并分析速度信息对策略成功率的影响。

Details

Motivation: 现有机器人操作基准很少系统测量策略在多样任务和不同速度下对运动物体的适应能力，论文希望揭示策略是否会按实际看到的速度行动，而非只依赖训练数据中的平均速度。

Result: 实验发现六个模型的成功率在中间速度达到峰值，失败表明其动作更匹配平均演示速度；加入两帧历史观测可使三个模型成功率提升 10-40 个百分点，线性探针显示这些模型也最容易解码传送带速度；给四个模型输入真值速度均有提升，而图像估计速度保留了大部分增益。

Abstract: Robot policies must adapt to the speed of moving objects, yet existing benchmarks rarely measure this ability across diverse tasks and speeds. We introduce SWEEP-Bench, a simulation benchmark with 80 conveyor-belt manipulation tasks spanning 16 skill categories, each evaluated at 13 belt speeds (0.10-0.40 m/s). Objects are transported through physical contact with a visibly moving belt. Each task has a static counterpart, and each evaluation episode uses the same randomized scene at all 13 speeds. We fine-tune eight vision-language-action and world-action models on demonstrations spanning the full speed range, comparing observations from the current frame alone with those including two past frames. For six models, the success rate peaks at intermediate speeds, and their failures indicate that they tend to produce actions suited to the average demonstration speed rather than to the actual one. Past frames raise the success rate by 10-40 percentage points for three models, and linear probes show that the belt speed is also most linearly decodable from these three. Adding ground-truth speed input to four of the models improves all of them, and a speed estimated from the images keeps most of this gain. These results show that SWEEP-Bench exposes speed-dependent failures and suggest that past frames help only policies from which the speed is most decodable, such as those pretrained on multiple frames. Project page: https://damin3927.github.io/SWEEP-Bench

[361] HIVE-Bench: Evaluating Patch-Level Visual Representations for Egocentric Robot Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Details

Motivation: 现有机器人学习常比较预训练视觉模型，但多基于第三人称图像池化后的单个向量；而实际双手策略从机器人相机读取密集patch token。论文希望建立更贴近该使用方式的patch级视觉表征评测基准。

Result: 在24个第一视角双手任务上，保留patch token明显优于池化；适配对测试的每个编码器-策略组合都有帮助；共享策略以少得多的更新保留大部分独立策略成功率。动作/逆动力学读出是训练策略前最强的可用指标之一，而识别、深度和对应性指标不能可靠迁移，且没有离线统计量能稳定替代真实rollout。

Insight: 创新点在于面向机器人第一视角操作的patch级视觉表征统一评测，系统比较20个编码器并引入共享策略、任务共享与多因素扫描。客观看，其价值在于揭示池化会掩盖关键空间信息，并提出动作相关读出比通用视觉指标更贴近下游控制表现。

Abstract: Pretrained vision is a common start for robot learning, but most comparisons still score one pooled vector from a third-person image. Bimanual policies instead read dense patch tokens from cameras on the robot. We introduce HIVE-Bench: one shared flow-matching policy reads 20 encoders from seven families on 24 egocentric bimanual tasks, across adaptation, task sharing, and sweeps of data, model size, and layer. Keeping the patches matters. Averaging each view to one token removes most of the success, adaptation helps every pair we test, and one shared policy keeps most of the success of separate policies at a fraction of the updates. The same tokens are then scored with statistics, state and object readouts, published vision scores, and an inverse-dynamics readout. That readout of the commanded motion is one of the strongest measurements available before a policy is trained. Recognition, depth, and correspondence do not transfer reliably. Fine-tuning can improve the action readout even when other measurements move the other way, and no statistic is stable enough to replace a rollout before any deployment.

[362] DexLatentWorld: 3D Cross-Embodiment Latent Action World Models for Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

TL;DR: 论文提出 DexLatentWorld，一种基于3D点云观测和跨本体潜动作的机器人操作世界模型。它从重定向的人类操作演示中学习连续潜动作表示，并用对比目标对齐不同本体间的运动表示。统一潜动作空间直接用于模型预测控制，通过粒子式未来预测恢复可执行机器人命令，无需本体特定动作解码器。方法支持未见机器人形态和夹爪几何的零样本操作，并在仿真与真实任务上取得较高成功率。

Motivation: 现有机器人世界模型通常依赖昂贵且难以扩展的动作标注交互数据，并且往往绑定特定机器人本体，难以迁移到未见过的机器人形态。论文旨在从无机器人动作标签的重定向人类演示中学习可跨本体迁移的潜动作世界模型。

Abstract: World models facilitate planning and control in robotic manipulation by enabling agents to anticipate the consequences of their actions. However, they typically rely on action-labelled interaction data that is costly to acquire and difficult to scale. These models are also often tied to the specific embodiment they were trained on, limiting transferability to previously unseen robot morphologies. We introduce a 3D latent-action world model that learns continuous action representations directly from point-cloud observations of retargeted human manipulation demonstrations. A contrastive objective is used to encourage consistent representations of motion across embodiments. The resulting unified latent action space serves directly as the search space for model-predictive control, where sampled latent actions condition particle-based future predictions. Executable robot commands are then recovered from the predicted geometric motion without requiring an embodiment-specific action decoder. Through extensive evaluations, we demonstrate that the learned latent actions exhibit controllable and compositional motion, transfer to unseen robot embodiments, and support zero-shot manipulation with unseen gripper geometries. Following task-agnostic adaptation, our model achieves 90%, 92%, and 60% success on reaching, grasping, and placing, respectively, compared with DexWM’s reported 72%, 58%, and 28%. Finally, we demonstrate zero-shot real-world manipulation with an unseen dexterous hand, achieving an 86% success rate across 50 trials on five diverse tasks involving pushing, grasping, and lifting everyday objects. These results highlight the potential of geometry-grounded latent actions as a unified, transferable interface for world-model-based robotic manipulation. Project materials, including demonstration videos and source code, are available at https://vinaymohan0409.github.io/DexLatentWorld/.

[363] CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Yiping Li, Haohua Que, Zhipeng Bao, Wenjie Zhao, Qianwen Li

TL;DR: 论文提出 CoSel，一种“将协同作为选择”的端到端驾驶框架。它保持原有自车规划器及其仅使用自车信息的输入不变，另外训练一个协同预测器，利用自车、路侧单元和网联自动驾驶车辆的观测预测周围智能体及其未来运动；随后用这些预测评估规划器生成的候选轨迹，在安全时保留原选择，在共享信息揭示额外风险时选择最接近的安全替代轨迹。

Motivation: 现有协同端到端方法将共享信息注入规划器，并依赖协同驾驶示范学习如何使用这些信息；但真正需要共享信息改变驾驶决策的时刻在数据中很少，监督信号不足。论文认为协同不一定要由规划器学习，而可通过预测周围智能体运动并从候选轨迹中选择响应来实现。

Result: 在闭环评测中，CoSel 在 V2Xverse 上取得 70.7 的驾驶分数，比最佳对比协同方法高 7.5 分；在 MDrive 上取得最高的平均驾驶分数 85.8。在自车检测缺失情况下，72 个场景中 CoSel 的碰撞数仅从 17 增至 19，而现有协同端到端模型从 19 增至 32。

Insight: 创新点在于将协同能力与规划器解耦，把共享信息的作用转化为对候选轨迹的安全评估与选择，并保证每次安全干预都可追溯到触发它的共享证据。客观来看，该设计避免了稀有的协同决策监督问题，提升了模块化性、可解释性和在自车感知退化时的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle’s awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it. The moments in which shared information should change a driving decision are rare in such data, providing limited supervision for learning this behavior. We argue that cooperation need not be learned by the planner. Instead, reacting to shared information requires predicting how surrounding agents will move and selecting a response from the candidate trajectories of an ego planner. We introduce CoSel, a cooperation-as-selection framework that leaves the planner and its ego-only input unchanged. A separately trained cooperative predictor uses observations from the ego vehicle, roadside units, and connected automated vehicles to predict surrounding agents and their future motion. CoSel evaluates the planner’s candidate trajectories against these predictions, preserves the planner’s choice when it remains safe, and selects the closest safe alternative when shared information reveals additional risk. Each safety intervention is traceable to the shared evidence that triggers it. In closed-loop evaluation, CoSel achieves a driving score of 70.7 on V2Xverse, outperforming the best compared cooperative method by 7.5 points, and the highest average driving score of 85.8 on MDrive. Under missing ego detections, the collision count of CoSel increases only from 17 to 19 in 72 scenarios, compared with 19 to 32 for an existing cooperative end-to-end model.

[364] Foresight Forcing: Learning Spatial Foresight for Robotic Manipulation cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Mishuo Han, Zhixuan Liang, Zhaoyuan Wan, Wendi Chen, Jiarui Chen

TL;DR: 论文提出 Foresight Forcing（F²），一种面向机器人操作的世界动作模型。它利用冻结的 3D 基础模型从当前与未来观测中提取稠密 3D 特征变化，作为空间过渡监督，并将其蒸馏为可从当前观测、语言指令和本体状态预测的空间过渡查询，从而在部署时无需未来观测或 3D 教师即可辅助动作生成。

Motivation: 现有世界动作模型虽预测未来视觉观测，但训练目标通常未显式建模潜在 3D 几何变化，导致空间关系变化监督不足。论文旨在让策略学习几何感知的空间前瞻表示，以改善机器人操作中的动作预测和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation policies can improve action prediction by anticipating how objects move and how their spatial relationships change. World Action Models (WAMs) learn to predict future visual observations, but their training objectives typically leave the underlying 3D geometric transitions implicit. To alleviate this problem, we introduce Foresight Forcing ($\mathcal{F}^{2}$), a WAM that learns a spatial transition representation from changes in a pretrained 3D feature space. During training, a frozen 3D foundation model extracts patch-wise feature differences from aligned current and future observations that provide dense supervision for geometry-aware feature transitions. We distill these targets into spatial transition queries, which are progressively refined from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioceptive state, and use them alongside current visual features to generate actions. At deployment, the policy predicts the queries without future observations or the 3D teacher. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin2.0 demonstrate strong manipulation performance and improved robustness, including 95.01% average success on RoboTwin2.0 Full. On six real-world manipulation tasks, $\mathcal{F}^{2}$ achieves a mean task score of 85.8%.

Abstract: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence. Yet unlike software engineering, where massive executable environments power post-training, robotics remains constrained by small, manual benchmarks and in-distribution evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K, 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and quality assurance pipeline. Each runs in an isolated, Harbor-compatible harness that hides privileged states and grading logic to mirror real-world sensing. From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen tasks to establish RoboUniverse-Verified, an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark. Evaluating 11 closed- and open-source models reveals a huge gap: frontier models reach 85.8% success, while open-source baselines lag at 2.6% to 10.0%, bottlenecked by low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control. Finally, we collect about 17K multi-turn trajectories totaling 0.79B tokens with GPT-6 Astra and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, yielding RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. Our model achieves substantial zero-shot gains on RoboUniverse-Verified, lifting the success rate from 0.8% to 21.2%, while achieving zero-shot task completions across LIBERO-MAX, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Franka arm. Abstract: A generalist manipulation policy should perform new tasks, operate in unfamiliar scenes, and transfer skills across robot embodiments. We present Wrist Video Policy (WVP), a closed-loop manipulation framework that learns how manipulation unfolds through video prediction and recovers executable motion through geometric estimation. Our key idea is to represent robot motion through wrist-camera trajectories, which determine the corresponding end-effector poses through a fixed hand-eye transformation. We pair a video generator that predicts future wrist views with a pose estimator adapted from a pretrained 3D model to recover the corresponding camera trajectories. Model stitching maps the generator’s predicted latents directly into the estimator’s intermediate feature space, bypassing RGB decoding. This decomposition allows task knowledge to expand through broad human and robot video data while reusing geometric motion estimation across tasks and embodiments. The resulting pose estimator transfers across Franka Panda, PiPER-X, and Galaxea R1 Pro without further fine-tuning. Across tabletop and laundry-room settings, WVP generalizes to tasks ranging from precise grasping and inserting to handling deformable objects, achieving a success rate of over 50% in zero-shot out-of-distribution evaluations. Our project page is at https://wrist-video-policy.github.io.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for instruction-conditioned robot control, yet their understanding of task-relevant 3D relations and how these relations evolve during manipulation remains largely implicit. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{WeaveVLA}, a framework that enhances VLA action generation by explicitly modeling task-relevant relative 3D relations and maintaining relational context across observations. WeaveVLA employs a task-conditioned sparse graph neural network to encode relative 3D relations among objects, the gripper, and nearby references. Pair-specific recurrent edge states integrate geometric evidence across observations to maintain evolving spatial context. A learned-query readout summarizes the updated graph representations into compact relational tokens, which condition the action expert alongside the original vision-language context. An auxiliary geometry reconstruction objective further encourages spatial structure preservation. We instantiate WeaveVLA on StarVLA-GR00T and $π_{0.5}$, achieving over 98% average success on LIBERO with both backbones. On LIBERO-Plus, WeaveVLA improves success from 74.9% to 82.0% and from 85.7% to 87.8%, respectively, with additional improvements on CALVIN D$\rightarrow$D. On three real-world tasks, the StarVLA-GR00T-based variant improves average success from 55.6% to 70.0% under standard conditions and from 33.3% to 53.3% under OOD perturbations, surpassing the $π_{0.5}$ baseline in both settings.

Abstract: When two musicians in an ensemble play the same instrument, they sound alike and their instruments look alike. Audio-only separators, and audio-visual separators that rely on appearance, cannot tell them apart. What still differs is how each player moves, and when. We study same-instrument per-player separation: a user clicks one musician in a video and receives that musician’s sound alone, even when other players in the video play the same instrument. Our model follows the clicked player and describes them with high level video features and the velocities of body and hand keypoints. A pretrained music separator attends to these tokens through cross-attention. Earlier motion-based separators were scored only on synthetic mixtures of solo videos. We give the first per-player evaluation of same-instrument separation on real ensemble recordings. On 58 players in URMP, each sharing an instrument with at least one other player in the piece, our model reaches a median SDR of 5.3 dB, while four released separators, audio-only and audio-visual, stay at or below 0.3 dB. The gap is wider on same-instrument duets, and our model also beats the audio-visual baselines on their own MUSIC benchmark. Tests show that the gain comes from movement: replacing the video with a still frame removes it, and so does shifting the video by a fraction of a second against the audio.

Motivation: 交互式应用（如直播、游戏、交互式世界模型）会持续接收视频，需要音频实时跟随生成；但现有视频到音频模型多为双向模型，必须观察完整视频片段后才能生成声音，不适合流式场景。

Abstract: Video-to-audio generation synthesizes sound that matches a video in content and timing, with applications ranging from film post-production to live streaming, games and interactive world models. Interactive applications receive video continuously and need the sound to follow it in real time, yet most existing video-to-audio models are bidirectional and must observe an entire clip before producing any sound. We propose LiveAudio, a streaming video-to-audio framework that generates high-quality and synchronized audio in real time while the video is playing. In contrast to prior streaming models trained from scratch, LiveAudio converts a bidirectional model into a streaming generator so as to build on its audio quality and synchronization. LiveAudio generates audio block by block, and each block depends only on the video that has already been played. The streaming generator is obtained from the bidirectional model through progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, so that each block needs only a few sampling steps. Experiments on VGGSound show that LiveAudio outperforms existing streaming models in audio quality and synchronization, and surpasses the bidirectional model it starts from in synchronization. On a single A100 GPU, it runs in real time with a real-time factor of 0.79 and a time to first frame of 143 ms. Audio samples are available at https://streamaudio.github.io.

[370] CAST: A Deployed Speech-to-Text Cascade for Closed Captioning of Entertainment Television cs.SD | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Aditya Mishra, Thanish Bolla, Bidisha Sharma, Balaji Pitchaikannu, Surbhi Sinha

Abstract: Despite rapid progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), caption generation for long-form entertainment video remains challenging for content dense in music and effects, rich in accents, crosstalk, and noise. The transcript quality depends on segmentation and surrounding modules as much as the acoustic model. A single pass voice activity detection (VAD) can miss faint, low-energy voice while forwarding near-silent segments that induce hallucination and repetition in an autoregressive decoder. These competing errors motivate a hierarchical VAD that revisits rejected segments under semantic and acoustic retention checks. We present Captioning ASR Stack for Television (CAST), an integrated speech-to-text pipeline for closed captioning (CC) combining frozen Whisper large-v3 with segmentation, language identification, lyrics routing, and targeted hallucination detection and repair on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU. On 100 in-house assets spanning 60.46 hours, CAST reduces normalized WER from 6.99% to 5.36% and subtitle edit rate from 254.2 to 221.9 min/hour against the WhisperX pipeline, and improves deletion rate by 11% on public datasets. We also present the behavior of each stage in the pipeline. CAST entered the production speech-to-text (STT) stage of our CC pipeline in late August 2026; we report the evaluation evidence and path to full-scale operation.

Motivation: 现有SMD评估主要依赖通用计算机视觉的保真度指标，难以反映解剖合理性、数据集覆盖、元数据完整性、亚组一致性和文档质量等临床相关属性，论文希望弥补这一评估缺口。

Abstract: The growing use of synthetic medical imaging datasets (SMD) in the development and evaluation of machine learning models has motivated interest in systematic methods to assess dataset quality across different imaging modalities. Common evaluation strategies rely heavily on fidelity-oriented metrics developed for general computer vision and may not capture clinically relevant properties such as anatomical plausibility, dataset coverage, metadata completeness, subgroup consistency, or documentation quality. We present the ScoreCard Toolkit that operationalizes six of the seven dimensions found within the 7Cs approach for SMD evaluation across Congruence, Coverage, Completeness, Consistency, Constraint, and Comprehension. The ScoreCard Toolkit provides a modular pipeline for preprocessing, feature extraction, metric computation, visualization, and structured scorecard generation. This approach complements standard fidelity-based evaluation by exposing quality characteristics not captured by those measures alone, including constraint violations, anatomically implausible shape artifacts, and metadata-related consistency issues. The toolkit supports appearance, texture, and shape features and is designed to accommodate additional feature representations, including radiomic features, deep-learning embeddings, and foundation-model representations. We demonstrate the end-to-end workflow across three imaging modalities: synthetic digital pathology whole-slide image patch data, synthetic digital mammography, and synthetic head CT. Across all three modalities, the resulting scorecards reveal dataset-specific quality characteristics, such as distributional biases and coverage gaps that may impact their effectiveness for model development or testing. ScoreCard provides a practical, extensible, and modality-agnostic approach for evaluating and transparently reporting SMD quality.

[372] Which Vertebral Landmark Errors Change a Cobb Angle? Geometry-Weighted Supervision for Radiographic Landmark Regression eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Zizhao Peng

Details

Motivation: 现有椎体角点定位网络可降低像素误差，却可能旋转用于测量脊柱曲率的线，导致标志点精度与Cobb角一致性不匹配。论文旨在把下游几何测量对标志点误差的敏感性纳入训练监督，解决像素误差与角度测量一致性脱节的问题。

Result: 在372张前后位X光片五折图像级实验中，三seed角点集成的合并对称百分比误差从坐标监督的18.45%降至几何加权的17.20%，加入软成对角项后为16.89%，相对坐标监督配对差为-1.56个百分点（95%图像bootstrap区间[-2.51,-0.61]）。单seed运行中旋转残差误差下降36.1%，但归一化角点误差从2.60%升至2.71%，显示标志点保真度与几何reader一致性之间存在可测权衡。

Insight: 摘要宣称的创新点是从三角度reader几何推导训练损失，利用正交Hadamard基分解椎体角点位移自由度，仅对影响左右弦旋转的方向额外加权，并加入软成对角项。客观来看，其可借鉴之处在于将下游几何测量的角度敏感性显式嵌入landmark回归监督，而不是只优化像素或坐标误差，从而暴露并量化标志点精度与Cobb角一致性之间的权衡。

Abstract: A network that localizes vertebral corners can reduce pixel error while rotating the line used to measure spinal curvature. We derive a training loss from the geometry of a three-angle reader. Of the eight corner-displacement degrees of freedom of a vertebral quadrilateral, one local direction rotates its left-to-right chord. The angular sensitivity in this direction is inversely proportional to chord width. An orthonormal Hadamard basis lets us give this residual extra weight during training while retaining supervision on the other seven directions. In five-fold image-level development experiments on 372 anteroposterior radiographs, we compared three objectives across 45 fits of the same landmark network. The three-seed corner ensemble reduced pooled symmetric percentage error from 18.45% with coordinate supervision to 17.20% with geometry weighting. Adding a soft pairwise-angle term yielded 16.89%, a paired difference of $-1.56$ percentage points from coordinate supervision (95% image-bootstrap interval $[-2.51,-0.61]$). The interval for the increment from adding the soft term included zero. In a single-fold comparison, direct unit-chord supervision also reduced error, and its difference from geometry weighting was uncertain. Across single-seed runs, rotational residual error fell by 36.1% while normalized corner error rose from 2.60% to 2.71%. Perturbing one vertebra at a time also showed when a small rotation changes the selected end pair. These results identify a measurable trade-off between landmark fidelity and agreement with a specified geometric reader. The evaluation concerns an internal image-level split and landmark-derived target angles.

[373] Generalizable Variable-Rate Adaptation for Image Coding for Machines eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Yui Tatsumi, Hiroshi Watanabe

TL;DR: 论文面向机器视觉图像编码（ICM），提出一种与任务损失无关的蒸馏框架，将预训练的固定码率ICM模型适配为可变码率模型。该方法以冻结的固定码率模型为教师，学生模型通过重要性自适应量化和蒸馏优化学习连续码率控制，同时保留任务相关潜在信息。实验表明单模型可实现连续码率调节，并取得与固定码率模型有竞争力的识别性能。

Details

Motivation: 现有ICM模型多针对固定工作点训练，难以直接扩展到可变码率压缩；且不同任务和模型设计的训练目标不同，导致通用适配困难。论文希望在不依赖原始任务特定损失和下游任务标签的情况下，实现可变码率ICM。

Result: 基于现有ICM模型的实验表明，所提方法能够用单一模型实现连续码率控制，并在识别性能上与固定码率模型相比具有竞争力；摘要未给出具体数据集、指标数值或SOTA结论。

Insight: 创新点在于提出损失无关的蒸馏式可变码率适配框架，用冻结固定码率ICM教师引导学生模型，并结合重要性自适应量化保留任务相关潜在成分。其可借鉴之处在于将任务损失与码率适配解耦，降低对任务标签和特定模型设计的依赖，提升可变码率ICM适配的通用性。

Abstract: Image Coding for Machines (ICM) aims to preserve task-relevant information for machine vision under limited bitrates. However, most ICM models are trained for a fixed operating point, and extending them to variable-rate compression is challenging because their training objectives differ across tasks and model designs. In this paper, we propose a loss-agnostic distillation framework for variable-rate ICM. A pretrained fixed-rate ICM model is used as a frozen teacher, while a student model learns variable-rate behavior through importance-adaptive quantization and distillation-based optimization. This enables continuous bitrate control with a single model while preserving task-relevant latent components, without requiring the original task-specific loss or downstream task labels. Experiments based on existing ICM models demonstrate that the proposed method provides continuous bitrate control and achieves competitive recognition performance compared with the fixed-rate models.

[374] A high-speed and high-resolution 3D velocity map imaging system with a neuromorphic camera physics.ins-det | cs.CV | nucl-ex | physics.chem-phPDF

Sulaiman Abubakar, Blessed Oguh, Akaninyene Udoikono, Hackim Musah, Suk Kyoung Lee

TL;DR: 论文展示了一种基于神经形态（事件驱动）相机的高速高分辨率三维速度映射成像系统。该系统将事件驱动相机与微通道板成像探测器结合，用于检测单个离子/电子，实现约2微秒延迟，并将动量成像速度提升到100 kHz以上，同时保持高空间分辨率、多击中能力和高时间分辨率。

Details

Motivation: 传统基于帧相机的三维速度映射成像受帧率限制，速度通常只有几kHz，难以满足高速、高计数率单粒子动量成像需求，因此需要降低检测延迟并提高系统吞吐。

Result: 系统实现2微秒检测延迟，动量成像速度超过100 kHz，而传统帧相机系统仅限几kHz；同时保持高空间分辨率、良好的多击中能力和高时间分辨率。

Insight: 创新点在于将神经形态事件驱动相机引入三维速度映射成像，利用事件触发低延迟特性突破传统帧相机帧率瓶颈。客观来看，核心贡献是事件驱动传感与VMI系统的跨学科仪器集成与适配，而非提出新的机器学习算法。

Abstract: An improved camera-based 3D-velocity map imaging (VMI) system was demonstrated with a neuromorphic camera. We show a machine vision event-driven camera can achieve an unprecedented latency of 2 microseconds when detecting single ion/electron with a microchannel plate imaging detector, which boosts the speed of the momentum imaging system to more than 100 kHz, while the system with a conventional frame camera is limited to a few kHz. The high spatial resolution of the camera offers additional performance boost while maintaining excellent multi-hit capability and a high time resolution.

[375] MAS-BIT: A Multi-Agent System for End-to-End BraIn-to-Text Decoding q-bio.NC | cs.CLPDF

Xinjie Zhang, Linyang He, Yizi Zhang, Yuesheng Ma, Nima Mesgarani

TL;DR: 论文提出 MAS-BIT，这是首个用于皮层内记录端到端脑到文本解码的多智能体框架。系统协同神经智能体、音素智能体和仲裁智能体，通过基于 token 嵌入的潜在通信整合互补证据并生成最终文本，在 Brain-to-Text ‘24 和 ‘25 基准上取得领先的端到端解码性能。

Details

Motivation: 语音脑机接口希望通过神经活动直接恢复交流能力，但端到端解码器在准确率上长期落后于级联系统。论文旨在缩小这一差距，并探索多智能体协作在端到端脑到文本解码中的潜力。

Result: MAS-BIT 在 Brain-to-Text ‘24 和 ‘25 上达到端到端解码 SOTA，词错误率分别为 6.929%、’25 公开测试集 3.606%（私有测试集 3.892%）。其在 ‘25 公开集上超过已发表的 BIT 级联系统，在 ‘24 上缩小差距，且无需集成独立训练模型或外部语言模型重打分。

Insight: 创新点在于将端到端脑到文本解码建模为多智能体协作：神经智能体、音素智能体和仲裁智能体分别提供互补证据，并通过 token 嵌入的概率加权组合进行潜在通信，保留候选 token 假设。该可微分接口支持句子级监督联合训练神经编码器与专家智能体，并支持跨参与者训练。

Abstract: Speech brain-computer interfaces aim to restore communication by translating neural activity into text, yet end-to-end decoders have historically trailed cascaded systems in accuracy. We introduce a Multi-Agent System for BraIn-to-Text (MAS-BIT), the first multi-agent framework for end-to-end brain-to-text decoding from intracortical recordings. MAS-BIT coordinates three specialized agents: a neural agent that interprets continuous neural representations, a phonetic agent that decodes soft phoneme posteriors, and an arbitration agent that integrates their complementary evidence with direct access to neural representations to generate the final transcription. The expert agents communicate with the arbiter through token-embedding-based latent communication, constructing continuous messages as probability-weighted combinations of token embeddings. These messages retain alternative token hypotheses and provide a differentiable interface through which sentence-level supervision jointly trains the neural encoders and specialized agents across participants. MAS-BIT achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end decoding performance on the Brain-to-Text ‘24 and ‘25 benchmarks, with word error rates of 6.929% on ‘24 and 3.606% on the ‘25 public test set (3.892% on the private test set). These results surpass the published BIT cascade on the ‘25 public set and narrow the gap on ‘24, without ensembling independently trained models or using external language-model rescoring.
